We further introduce Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD), which reparameterizes the diffusion network to predict actions on the robot action manifold while retaining DDPM-based residual supervision. Experiments on three contact-rich manipulation tasks show that FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes. Code and videos are available at https://fa-rdp.github.io.

</details>


### [133] [PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28623)
*Lizhi Yang,Junheng Li,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PAC-MAN 是一个面向人形机器人躲避球任务的感知感知 CBF-RL 框架，将控制屏障安全与部署现实的机载感知耦合，在 Unitree G1 机器人上实现了零样本部署。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文涉及"onboard sensing"（机载感知）和"lightweight"（轻量策略）概念，但场景是人形机器人躲避球（humanoid dodgeball），与遥感卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱等遥感场景完全无关；也不涉及目标检测（object detection）任务，而是机器人运动控制与安全避障。虽然提到"lightweight Link-CBF policy"和"onboard camera"，但这是机器人本体上的感知，并非星上部署或边缘推理。属于泛机器人/泛机器学习方法，与本课题方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为人形机器人躲避球控制，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或模型压缩技术，阅读价值很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：人形机器人躲避球（whole-body humanoid dodgeball）的避障运动控制；应用场景：机器人运动控制与安全导航；传感器类型：头戴式相机（head-mounted camera）获取 segmentation-masked depth；目标类别：飞来的球（ball）。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 框架为 PAC-MAN，结合 Control Barrier Function (CBF) 与 Reinforcement Learning (RL)。策略仅以 segmentation-masked depth 作为输入；训练时 CBF guidance 表示每个身体链段的 clearance；引入 adversarial motion prior 正则化躲避反射。包含 Joint-CBF 和 Link-CBF 两种变体，以及 ball-tracking gimbal 和 privileged runtime filter 等感知增强方案。

Lightweight method: 摘要提到"lightweight Link-CBF policy"，表明策略本身是轻量的，但未说明具体轻量化手段（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS 等）。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟等部署指标。轻量化主要体现在策略输入简单（仅 segmentation-masked depth）和策略结构轻量，而非模型压缩技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上零样本部署（zero-shot deployment），使用固定机载相机（fixed onboard camera）即可实现躲避，容忍不完美感知，95% 的投掷成功率。但摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。部署场景是机器人本体，而非卫星在轨或边缘设备。

Datasets and metrics: 使用受控的 any-link contact benchmark，包含两种投掷模式：单次投掷（single throws）和部署循环（deployment loop，机器人走回站点并在投掷间恢复）。评价指标为躲避成功率（95% on real-world throws）和与 privileged state oracle 的差距（within a few points）。摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 在受控基准上与 privileged state oracle 对比，固定机载相机单独即可实现有效躲避；2) 发现 CBF 结构可用性依赖感知可观测性——Joint-CBF 在精确球状态时表现最佳，在固定相机观测下作为训练引导时性能下降，通过 ball-tracking gimbal 或 privileged runtime filter 可恢复；3) 在 Unitree G1 上零样本部署 Link-CBF 策略，容忍不完美感知，95% 投掷成功率，使用语义分割躲避不同球。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：模型参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟、能耗等部署指标；未说明轻量化具体技术手段；未涉及遥感/卫星场景；未涉及目标检测任务。核心局限是与本课题方向（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化）基本无关。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不同，仍有少量可借鉴思路：1) "感知感知的安全控制"理念——在训练时使用 privileged 信息（如 CBF guidance），部署时仅依赖轻量感知输入，这种"训练时特权、部署时轻量"的范式与 knowledge distillation 的思想有相通之处，可迁移到遥感目标检测的 teacher-student 蒸馏设计中；2) 固定相机（fixed onboard camera）在真实部署中容忍不完美感知的设计思路，对星上部署时传感器噪声鲁棒性有参考价值；3) 语义分割辅助不同目标泛化的做法，可类比遥感场景中多类别目标检测的语义先验。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.

</details>

### [134] [More Data, Worse Decisions? Preference Reversals in Neural Networks under Gram Incompatibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27255)
*Yanli Yan,Yuanzheng Li,Yong Zhao,Hongbo Guo,Shoudong Han*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在合并多源数据重新拟合后，是否保持基于案例决策理论（CBDT）组合公理所要求的偏好排序一致性，并提出Gram几何失配度量、几何导向正则化与三阶段审计框架。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/决策理论范畴，讨论多源数据池化重拟合后的偏好一致性与可靠性问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。仅其"几何导向正则化"和"模型可靠性审计"思想在方法论层面可能有间接借鉴，但与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于决策理论与机器学习可靠性交叉领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感、目标检测或任何压缩加速方法，仅方法论层面有极有限的间接启发，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多源数据池化重拟合下的偏好一致性与决策可靠性分析。应用场景：负载竞价代理（load-based bidding proxy）、医疗决策代理、金融决策代理。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 固定表示（fixed-representation）神经网络 + 普通最小二乘（OLS）输出头。核心关注逆Gram几何（inverse-Gram geometry）在池化重拟合中的变化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 实验采用负载竞价代理（load-based bidding proxy）、医疗决策代理和金融决策代理三类代理任务。评价指标包括：偏好保留率（preservation rates）、描述性准确率（descriptive accuracy）、一致性（consistency）、几何（geometry）与危害（harm）操作点。

Experiments: 实验揭示了稳定与易反转的池化区间（stable and reversal-prone pooling regimes）：负载审计在代理效用下识别出可测量的非零类"源共识相对有害决策"；跨域审计显示相当程度的失配可能对应截然不同的保留率；几何导向目标占据不同的描述准确率-一致性-几何-危害操作点。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显缺口包括：未涉及遥感/卫星场景；未涉及目标检测任务；未涉及任何模型压缩或轻量化方法；未提供部署相关指标；实验仅基于代理任务而非真实视觉任务。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但可借鉴两点方法论思想：(1) "几何导向正则化"（geometry-oriented regularization）的思路——在训练中显式约束特征几何，类似思想可用于轻量化检测模型蒸馏时保持教师-学生特征空间几何一致性；(2) "三阶段审计"（three-stage audit）框架——对模型决策进行系统化可靠性追踪，可类比用于评估轻量化后检测模型相对原始模型的精度退化与决策反转（如目标漏检/误检模式变化）。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Neural networks increasingly combine data across populations, time periods, and operating conditions to improve generalization. This raises a reliability question: whether a model refitted on pooled data preserves an action ordering supported by both sources. Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) formalizes this requirement through its composition axiom, which requires source-supported preferences to survive their union. We study when this property holds for fixed-representation neural networks with ordinary least squares (OLS) output heads. First, we show that pooled refitting recomputes the inverse-Gram geometry used to weight source evidence, which can reverse shared preferences, and derive exact and approximate preservation conditions. Next, we introduce a scale-invariant Gram mismatch measure for prioritizing candidate pools and geometry-oriented regularization for shaping source geometry during training. Finally, we develop a three-stage audit that traces strict pairwise reversals through decision changes to task-defined utility loss. Experiments spanning a load-based bidding proxy and medical and financial decision proxies reveal stable and reversal-prone pooling regimes: the load audit identifies a measurable nonzero class of source-consensus-relative harmful decisions under the proxy utility, while cross-domain audits show that comparable mismatch can correspond to sharply different preservation rates. Geometry-oriented objectives occupy distinct descriptive accuracy-consistency-geometry-harm operating points. Together, the framework makes compositional reliability measurable and operational through screening, analytic certification, geometry-oriented training, and decision-consequence auditing.

</details>


### [135] [Expected Survival-Time Bounds for Robust Optimization Over Time under Isotropic Gaussian Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27280)
*Pavel Novoa-Hernández*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究进化动态优化中"随时间鲁棒优化"(ROOT)范式下已部署解的期望生存时间，在各项同性高斯环境动态下推导了生存时间的下界与多步上界，并用蒙特卡洛实验验证。

Research relevance: 1分——与本研究方向基本无关。论文属于进化计算/动态优化理论领域，研究对象是"随时间鲁棒优化"(ROOT)中解的生存时间(survival time)理论分析，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。虽然文中出现"deployed solution"和"deployment"等词汇，但这里的"部署"指的是优化解在动态环境中的持续有效性，与星上/边缘部署(edge deployment)毫无关系。

Reading priority: 1分——与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于进化计算理论领域，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：进化动态优化(evolutionary dynamic optimization)中ROOT范式的理论分析。应用场景：动态优化问题中解的持续有效性评估，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。本文是理论分析论文，将生存时间建模为离散首次逃逸问题(discrete first-exit problem)，在各项同性高斯环境动态(isotropic Gaussian environmental dynamics)假设下推导期望生存时间的下界和上界。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。本文不涉及剪枝(pruning)、量化(quantization)、知识蒸馏(knowledge distillation)、NAS、轻量网络等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。本文的"deployment"指优化解在动态环境中的持续有效性，而非星上/边缘硬件部署。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 无真实数据集。采用Monte Carlo仿真验证理论预测，考察对建模假设和参数不确定性的敏感性。评价指标为期望生存时间(expected survival time)，即部署解在未来环境中继续满足质量阈值的环境数量。

Experiments: 主要实验为Monte Carlo仿真，验证理论推导的生存时间下界与上界。结果显示：在缓慢变化环境中期望生存时间按Θ(σ⁻²)尺度增长；在高维环境中趋近最小值1（即仅能维持一个未来环境变化）。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术方法。2. 理论假设(各项同性高斯环境动态)较为理想化，实际动态优化场景可能不满足。3. 摘要未说明该框架如何扩展到非高斯或各向异性环境动态。4. 摘要未说明该理论对实际优化算法设计的直接指导作用。

Ideas for my research: 几乎无可借鉴点。唯一可能的概念性启发是：论文强调"部署解的持续有效性"这一思想，类比到在轨遥感场景，可思考"模型在轨运行期间面对数据分布漂移(data distribution shift)时的持续有效性"问题——即星上模型在长期运行中面对光照、季节、传感器退化等环境变化时，其检测性能能维持多久。但本文提供的数学框架(生存时间分析)与深度学习模型部署场景差异过大，难以直接迁移。

Abstract: Robust Optimization Over Time (ROOT) is a recent branch of evolutionary dynamic optimization that seeks solutions capable of remaining effective across multiple consecutive environments. Unlike the traditional track-the-moving-optimum (TMO) paradigm, which reoptimizes after every environmental change, ROOT explicitly values persistence. Although the field has grown considerably, most contributions remain algorithmic and empirical, leaving several fundamental properties poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. One such property is survival time, defined as the number of future environments in which a deployed solution continues to satisfy a prescribed quality threshold. While survival time is widely used as a measure of temporal robustness, little is known about how its expected value depends on environmental dynamics, deployment quality, or problem characteristics. This paper studies expected survival time for a fixed deployed solution under isotropic Gaussian environmental dynamics. Modeling survival as a discrete first-exit problem, we derive a rigorous lower bound and a computable multi-step upper bound. The analysis shows that expected survival scales as $Θ(σ^-{2})$ in slowly varying environments and approaches its minimum value of one future change in high dimensions. A comprehensive Monte Carlo study validates the theoretical predictions, examines sensitivity to modeling assumptions and parameter uncertainty, and illustrates how the bounds can support deployment decisions after optimization. The resulting framework provides an analytical characterization of deployment lifetime and identifies when a required deployment horizon can be guaranteed, ruled out, or remains analytically unresolved.

</details>


### [136] [An analysis of binary isotonic regression: degrees of freedom and implications for calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27301)
*Raphael Rossellini,Rina Foygel Barber,Zhimei Ren,Jake A. Soloff*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究等渗回归（isotonic regression）在二值样本上的最坏情况自由度，并利用该结果推导等渗回归校准后Expected Calibration Error (ECE)的分布无关上界。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于统计学习/概率校准理论，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于统计学习理论方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化课题基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：概率预测校准（probabilistic prediction calibration）与等渗回归的理论分析。应用场景：通用统计推断与机器学习模型后处理校准，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（仅假设二值标签 Y∈{0,1}）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。核心研究对象是isotonic regression（等渗回归）这一经典非参数回归/校准方法，属于后处理（post-processing）方法而非端到端网络模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。本文讨论的是等渗回归的自由度（degrees of freedom）理论界，与轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文为纯理论分析，未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标为degrees of freedom（自由度）和Expected Calibration Error (ECE)。实验设置：二值样本（binary samples），Y∈{0,1}，分布无关（distribution-free）设定。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验。主要理论贡献为：1) 给出等渗回归在二值样本上最坏情况自由度的sharp有限样本刻画；2) 利用解析数论得到前导项为 (3/(4π²)^(1/3))·n^(2/3) 的sharp界，改进此前结果；3) 推导出等渗回归ECE的首个非平凡分布无关保证。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：本文仅针对二值标签（Y∈{0,1}）和等渗回归这一特定后处理方法，理论结果对多分类、回归任务或深度检测模型的适用性未说明；且与遥感目标检测、在轨部署完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接联系是：概率校准（calibration）对遥感目标检测模型的置信度评估有一定价值，等渗回归作为后处理校准方法可提升检测框置信度的可靠性，但其理论分析（自由度、ECE界）对轻量化部署帮助不大。若关注检测模型置信度校准，可参考等渗回归作为校准后处理工具，但本文理论深度与工程应用距离较远。

Abstract: Isotonic regression is a canonical tool for estimating monotone functions and calibrating probabilistic predictors. We provide a fully sharp finite-sample characterization of its worst-case degrees of freedom on binary samples. Specifically, we identify the binary sequences that maximize the number of distinct fitted values produced by isotonic regression. We develop a sharp bound on the degrees of freedom with a leading term of $\frac{3}{(4π^2)^{1/3}} n^{2/3}$ using analytic number theory, improving on previous bounds.
  We then apply this result to calibration. Calibration is a central requirement for probabilistic prediction, and isotonic regression is a widely used post-processing method for improving calibration. Building on deterministic degrees-of-freedom bounds, we derive, to our knowledge, the first nontrivial distribution-free guarantee on the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of isotonic regression. This ECE bound is fully model-free and distribution-free, only assuming $Y \in \{0,1\}$.

</details>


### [137] [HOMER: Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation in Hilbert Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27532)
*Kisung You,Boram Cho*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出HOMER（Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation），一种基于径向Huber中心的鲁棒均值估计方法，用于在重尾数据下实现高效且稳健的统计推断。

Model architecture: HOMER通过径向Huber中心（radial Huber center）聚合分块均值（block means），包含canonical和pseudo-Huber两种形式。canonical形式在二次区域内恢复样本均值，pseudo形式随阈值增大趋近样本均值。建立了Hilbert空间多数定理（majority theorem）和MOM阶偏差界。

Abstract: Heavy tails weaken high-confidence control for the empirical mean. Geometric median-of-means (MOM) also lacks a threshold that moves toward mean efficiency. We propose \emph{HOMER}, or Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation. HOMER aggregates block means through a radial Huber center. Its canonical and pseudo-Huber forms bound each block score and interpolate between median-like robustness and the empirical mean. We establish a Hilbert-space majority theorem and a MOM-order deviation bound under a finite second moment. Canonical HOMER recovers the sample mean inside its quadratic region. Pseudo-HOMER approaches the sample mean as the threshold grows. It also admits asymptotic linearity and consistent sandwich covariance estimation around the population block-Huber target. Under a finite third moment, fixed finite-dimensional projections support mean inference at the usual parametric rate. This result requires growing block sizes and counts, with block sizes increasing faster. Heavy-tailed simulations show that HOMER remains stable when a minority of block summaries is displaced. On clean Gaussian data, both versions closely approach the empirical mean's efficiency. Finite-block sandwich intervals undercovered, especially for skewed functional data. Further studies show failure when contamination affects most blocks or compromises ordinary within-block means.

</details>

Abstract: Wavelength selection is one of the important preprocessing methods in near-infrared spectroscopy to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability of spectral data. We formulate wavelength-region selection for sugar content estimation as a binary black-box optimization problem and propose a method based on Bayesian optimization. The proposed method constructs a sparse quadratic surrogate model and sequentially extracts interested wavelength regions by Thompson sampling. Minimizing an acquisition function is performed as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem by simulated or quantum annealing. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy of partial least squares regression and yields more consistent wavelength regions than genetic-algorithm-based selection and simulated annealing. Under one-bit local perturbations, the selected wavelength regions show minimal fluctuations in root mean square errors between observed and predicted values of a validation set. This local stability suggests that our method converges to a smoother error landscape and avoids isolated overfitted solutions. These results indicate that combinatorial Bayesian optimization is a useful framework for robust feature selection in spectroscopic prediction tasks.

</details>

Abstract: Engression (Shen and Meinshausen, 2024) learns a conditional distribution by fitting a generative model $Y = f(X,\varepsilon)$ under the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule. We provide a theoretical error analysis of engression implemented with deep neural networks. We decompose the excess risk into three components: the approximation error, the stochastic error, and the Monte Carlo error. Based on this decomposition, we establish convergence rates under the assumption that the target conditional generator admits a compositional smoothness structure.

Abstract: Local differential privacy (LDP) protocols are vulnerable to poisoning attacks. Existing research have proposed efficient defense strategies for single-item users. However, in practice, a user may possess multiple items. The defense against poisoning attacks for multi-item users is challenging, because due to larger output spaces, the adversary can conduct more powerful attacks without being detected. In this paper, we address the robust sparse vector mean estimation problem, in which each user has a vector with $m$ nonzero coordinates. We propose Randomized Projection with Clipping (RPC). Firstly, the server sends a random binary vector to each user. The user then projects its local data on the vector, and clip the value to restrict the attacker's capability. To handle clipping bias, we propose a correction method based on a careful analysis that gives an exact expression of the bias. As a result, bias-variance tradeoff is no longer needed, thus the clipping threshold can be further reduced to shrink the output space and enhance robustness. We provide a rigorous theoretical guarantee of the estimation error under all possible attacks. Numerical experiments show that under trusted environments, our new method achieves comparable or better performance than existing methods, indicating that our method is already an efficient estimator in its own right. Under untrusted environments, our method is also significantly more robust to poisoning attacks.

</details>

Ideas for my research: 1. 对抗训练与泛化权衡的理论分析思路可间接启发：在轨模型轻量化过程中，若引入对抗训练增强鲁棒性，需注意其可能带来的泛化损失，可借鉴"噪声去偏"思想设计更稳健的轻量化训练策略。2. 本文的泛化误差界分析框架（source smoothness、kernel spectrum）可类比迁移到轻量化模型（如剪枝/蒸馏后模型）的泛化性能理论分析中，但需要大量改造。3. 总体而言，借鉴价值有限，不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Adversarial training has emerged as a powerful approach for protecting models against adversarial attacks in a broad range of real-world applications. In this paper, we study adversarial training in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) framework through the associated kernel integral operator. We first derive source-uniform generalization error bounds for the RKHS adversarial training estimator in terms of the robustness level, sample size, source smoothness, and kernel spectrum. On a fixed polynomial-spectrum model, we further establish a matching lower bound showing that the optimally balanced generalization rate can be slower than the minimax prediction benchmark. This result reveals a loss of statistical accuracy in adversarial training. Our analysis shows that this loss arises from the interaction between adversarial robustness and observation noise: the noise contribution in the mixed robustness term slows the approximation rate, although the same term reduces the estimation complexity. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage noise-debiased procedure that estimates and removes the noise contribution from the mixed term. The resulting estimator improves the generalization rate and attains the minimax polynomial rate, up to a logarithmic factor, when the robustness level is selected at the stated sample-dependent order. Our results characterize the generalization behavior of adversarial training in a nonparametric framework and provide a new interpretation and a principled solution for the trade-off between adversarial robustness and generalization. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [142] [On a joint simultaneous learning of relevant feature subsets and subspaces in regression-like problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28080)
*Illia Horenko*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出熵最优流形回归（EOMR）方法，扩展熵最优流形聚类以联合识别非平稳非线性回归问题中的特征子集与子空间，在混沌动力学和托卡马克等离子体预测任务上以极低复杂度超越多种SOTA机器学习工具。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛机器学习/回归方法研究，面向混沌动力学与等离子体物理预测，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。其"线性复杂度迭代与内存"和"极低参数模型"思想对轻量化有一定方法论借鉴意义，但并非遥感场景，也未涉及目标检测。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于物理动力学回归预测领域，仅在线性复杂度与极简模型蒸馏思想上有微弱的方法论参考价值，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：非平稳非线性回归预测（regression）。应用场景：混沌动力学系统预测（Lorenz-96系统）与托卡马克等离子体边缘物理（Hasegawa-Wakatani模型）。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器。目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: EOMR基于熵最优流形聚类（EOMC）扩展，联合识别特征子集与子空间，最终为Hasegawa-Wakatani示例蒸馏出仅含8个参数的线性、因果、弱平稳自回归过程来描述主导Essential Orthogonal Function（EOF）动力学。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 核心轻量化思想：线性扩展的迭代与内存复杂度（linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities），以及通过熵最优子空间/子集选择蒸馏出极简模型（仅8个参数的自回归过程）。这属于特征选择与模型蒸馏层面的轻量化，而非传统剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）或知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量（除8参数自回归模型外）、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性指标。线性复杂度特性理论上有利于部署，但缺乏具体部署验证。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Lorenz-96混沌系统（强混沌F=8与极强混沌F=12两个regime）、Hasegawa-Wakatani托卡马克等离子体模型数据。评价指标：均方根预测误差（root mean squared prediction errors）与模型复杂度（model complexities）。对比方法：梯度提升随机森林、深度神经网络、Transformer类工具TabPFN v0.3。

Experiments: EOMR在Lorenz-96（F=8和F=12）与Hasegawa-Wakatani两个基准上，相比梯度提升随机森林、深度神经网络和TabPFN v0.3，均方根预测误差低数个数量级，模型复杂度也低数个数量级。对Hasegawa-Wakatani，EOMR蒸馏出仅8参数的线性自回归模型即可描述主导EOF动力学。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于物理动力学预测领域；2. 摘要未说明方法在图像/视觉任务上的适用性；3. 未提供FLOPs、延迟、能耗等部署指标；4. 未涉及目标检测任务或遥感数据；5. 对比的TabPFN v0.3等工具并非目标检测领域的SOTA。

Ideas for my research: 1. 其"线性扩展的迭代与内存复杂度"思想可借鉴到遥感目标检测模型的轻量化设计中，作为复杂度约束的参考；2. 熵最优子空间/子集联合选择的思想可用于遥感特征通道剪枝或特征选择，减少冗余波段/通道；3. 蒸馏出极简参数模型（8参数）的思路可类比于将大检测模型蒸馏为极轻量学生网络，但需结合遥感目标检测的具体任务重新设计；4. 整体借鉴价值有限，主要作为方法论参考。

Abstract: We extend a recently introduced Entropy-Optimal Manifold Clustering (EOMC) to allow for a joint simultaneous identification of subsets and subspaces of relevant features in nonstationary and nonlinear regression problems. It is shown that the proposed extension - that we coin as Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression (EOMR) - allows a robust learning with linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities. EOMR is compared to the most complete set of state-of-the-art tools from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) that is available to the author, on the very challenging problems from chaotic and fluid dynamics: (i) on predicting the Lorenz-96 systems dynamics in strongly- and very-strongly chaotic regimes (with forcing parameter being $F=8$ and $F=12$, respectively); and, (ii) on a data from the Hasegawa-Wakatani model on the edge of the tokamak plasma. It is demonstrated that the proposed benchmarks (i) and (ii), indeed, are the very challenging problems for the state of the art ML and AI tools - since both the general-purpose gradient boosted random forests and deep neuronal networks, as well as transformer-based AI tools like TabPFN v.03 (more spezialised for large-dimensional small data learning problems) - result in orders of magnitude inferior root mean squared prediction errors, and orders of magnitude larger model complexities, when compared to the EOMR. For a Hasegawa-Wakatani example, EOMR distills a very simple entropy-optimal and skilful description of the leading Essential Orthogonal Function (EOF) dynamics, given by linear, causal and weakly-stationary autoregressive process described by just 8 parameters.

</details>


### [143] [Uncertainty quantification for trustworthy deep learning: Methods and measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28248)
*H. Martin Gillis,Thomas Trappenberg*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 一篇关于深度学习不确定性量化（UQ）方法的系统性综述，聚焦集成方法和近似贝叶斯方法，并统一了"生成预测分布的方法"与"总结不确定性的度量"两个层面。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是泛机器学习领域的不确定性量化综述，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或轻量化部署。虽然UQ方法与深度学习模型相关，但摘要中完全没有提及遥感场景、目标检测任务或模型压缩/加速技术。其"efficient ensemble approximations"和"single-pass methods"虽涉及效率，但目标是降低UQ计算开销，而非面向边缘/星上部署的模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文是UQ领域的综述，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。仅在"为轻量检测模型增加不确定性估计"这一间接需求上可能有参考价值，但优先级很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification, UQ）综述。应用场景：safety-critical domains（安全关键领域），非遥感场景。传感器类型：摘要未说明。目标类别：摘要未说明（不涉及具体目标检测类别）。

Model architecture: 将UQ方法分为五个家族：Bayesian neural networks（贝叶斯神经网络）、Monte Carlo Dropout、deep ensembles（深度集成）、efficient ensemble approximations（高效集成近似）、last-layer or single-pass approaches（末层或单次前向方法）。同时涉及evidential/prior networks、conformal prediction（保形预测）、post-hoc calibration（事后校准）等相邻工作。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提到的"efficient ensemble approximations"和"single-pass methods"属于降低UQ计算开销的方法，但这是针对不确定性估计的效率优化，并非面向边缘/星上部署的模型剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏或NAS等轻量化技术。摘要未说明具体轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。虽然"efficient ensemble approximations"暗示对计算效率的关注，但未给出任何量化数据。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标方面涉及uncertainty measures及其decompositions（如entropy decomposition与pairwise divergence measures），以及calibration（校准）评估，但未给出具体指标名称或实验设置。

Experiments: 作为综述论文，摘要未给出具体实验结果或对比方法。仅说明对每个方法家族考察theoretical motivation、implementation、empirical performance和limitations，并整合了evaluation methodology以统一比较基准。摘要未说明消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于泛机器学习综述。2. 摘要未涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化技术。3. 摘要未提供任何定量实验结果。4. 摘要未说明UQ方法在具体视觉任务（如目标检测）上的应用效果。5. 摘要未提及在资源受限环境下的部署可行性。

Ideas for my research: 1. 虽然该综述不直接相关，但"efficient ensemble approximations"和"single-pass methods"的思路可借鉴到遥感在轨目标检测的轻量化设计中——例如在轻量检测模型上引入不确定性估计，用于在轨场景下的低置信度目标过滤或主动重访决策。2. "last-layer approaches"（末层方法）与轻量化模型结合成本低，可在不显著增加计算量的前提下为在轨检测提供置信度。3. 若未来在轨检测需要处理分布偏移（如光照、云遮挡），UQ方法可辅助判断模型何时失效。4. 该综述的"方法-度量分离"框架可用于系统化评估轻量检测模型的不确定性质量。

Abstract: The deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical domains demands reliable estimates of predictive confidence, yet conventional architectures lack principled uncertainty quantification. This survey provides a structured, critical review of methods for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) in deep learning, scoped to ensemble-based and approximate Bayesian approaches and the measures used to summarize their outputs. Relative to existing UQ surveys, our contribution is depth on efficient ensemble approximations and single-pass methods, and a unified treatment that separates the method producing a predictive distribution from the measure that summarizes its uncertainty. We organize methods into five families: Bayesian neural networks, Monte Carlo Dropout, deep ensembles, efficient ensemble approximations, and last-layer or single-pass approaches. We situate adjacent work on evidential and prior networks, conformal prediction, and post-hoc calibration, together with the decision-time tasks of out-of-distribution detection and selective prediction. For each, we examine theoretical motivation, implementation, empirical performance, and limitations. We then review ensemble diversity theory and uncertainty measures and their decompositions, contrasting the entropy decomposition with pairwise divergence measures, and consolidate evaluation methodology so that our qualitative comparisons share a common basis. We close with a brief treatment of uncertainty in large language models and open research directions, including efficient epistemic measures for classification, last-layer diversity, diversity and calibration under shift, and hybrid architectures.

</details>


### [144] [Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning for Longitudinal Causal Inference with Irregular Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28567)
*Mengfei Ran,Yifeng Shen,Ruijie Guan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning (DR-FRL)，一种将不规则纵向历史数据（如实验室值、生理信号、传感器流）转化为目标定向状态表示的交叉拟合工作流，用于因果推断中的观测历史策略估计。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于因果推断与纵向数据表示学习领域，面向ICU临床终点预测（VitalDB），与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。仅"image-derived summaries"一词提及图像衍生摘要，但并非遥感图像，也不涉及目标检测或模型压缩。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于因果推断/统计学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：纵向因果推断（longitudinal causal studies）、观测历史策略估计（observed-history regimes）；应用场景：ICU临床终点预测（VitalDB数据集）；传感器类型：实验室值（laboratory values）、生理信号（physiologic signals）、传感器流（sensor streams）、图像衍生摘要（image-derived summaries）；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: DR-FRL包含：functional and temporal encoders（将点云和先前历史映射为状态表示）、nuisance heads（估计outcome、treatment、censoring函数）、EIF-targeted validation/calibration/overlap/tail/ablation诊断模块。采用cross-fitted工作流，基于Efficient Influence Function (EIF) 目标化表示学习。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法，也未讨论实时推理、边缘部署或星上部署。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向统计推断而非嵌入式/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：VitalDB（ICU临床数据库）；模拟实验（simulations）用于验证高维功能混杂、信息性测量、弱支持、重尾伪结果等场景。评价指标：均值估计的渐近线性性（asymptotic linearity）、EIF-targeted诊断（validation、calibration、overlap、tail、ablation）。

Experiments: 模拟实验显示在高维功能混杂、信息性测量、弱支持、重尾伪结果场景下DR-FRL有增益；VitalDB审计显示对于ICU处置终点，标量实验室摘要已携带大量终点相关信息（negative finding）。未与目标检测或轻量化方法对比。

Limitations: 与本研究方向基本无关。摘要未说明模型复杂度、推理效率、部署可行性；未涉及遥感图像、目标检测或模型压缩；其核心贡献在统计因果推断理论（EIF、渐近线性、Catoni聚合），对遥感在轨检测轻量化课题无直接可借鉴内容。

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴性有限。唯一可能的间接启发：其"cross-fitted"和"EIF-targeted validation"思想体现了对表示质量进行系统化诊断的思路，类比到轻量化检测中可考虑对压缩后模型进行多维度诊断（如calibration、tail性能），但整体与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向关联微弱。

Abstract: Longitudinal causal studies often record histories as irregular functional fragments: laboratory values, physiologic signals, sensor streams, and image-derived summaries measured at unequal and informative times. Standard doubly robust estimators usually require scalar summaries, whereas sequence learners optimize prediction losses that need not stabilize the efficient influence function. We propose Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning (DR-FRL), a cross-fitted workflow that turns irregular histories into estimand-targeted states for observed-history regimes. Functional and temporal encoders map point clouds and prior histories into states; nuisance heads estimate outcome, treatment, and censoring functions; and EIF-targeted validation, calibration, overlap, tail, and ablation diagnostics assess whether the state supports the estimating equation. If the selected state preserves the nuisance information needed by the EIF, representation error enters the same second-order product remainder as ordinary nuisance error, and the mean estimator is asymptotically linear under explicit rate, overlap, calibration, and stability conditions. Catoni aggregation is treated separately as a bounded-influence point estimator, not a replacement for Wald inference. Simulations show gains when functional confounding is high-dimensional, measurement is informative, support is weak, or pseudo-outcomes are heavy-tailed. A VitalDB audit shows that DR-FRL can use irregular laboratory point clouds and deliver a useful negative finding: for this ICU-disposition endpoint, scalar laboratory summaries already carry much endpoint-relevant information.

</details>

### [145] [Characterization of Continuous Electromagnetic Manifolds via Calculus of Variations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27396)
*Kuranage Roche Rayan Ranasinghe,Miguel Rodrigo Castellanos,Giuseppe Thadeu Freitas de Abreu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于变分法(calculus of variations)的框架，用于任意MIMO阵列几何形状的连续电磁流形表征与波束成形，通过Gauss-Legendre求积和连续馈电函数克服了现有离散矩矩阵方法的三个根本局限。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文属于电磁学/天线阵列/无线通信领域，聚焦于MIMO阵列的波束成形与近场辐射建模，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测、模型压缩或星上部署。相关性评分为1分。

Experiments: 在MATLAB Antenna Toolbox上对线性和平面几何形状进行全波验证，确认相对于SotA基线在近场精度上的一致提升，且计算成本相当。推导了无约束场强最大化和近场方向图合成的闭式最优波束成形器，建立了与离散和广义匹配滤波器的精确类比。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：该工作聚焦于电磁波束成形理论，与遥感目标检测、图像处理、模型压缩完全无关；未涉及任何遥感场景、目标检测任务或轻量化部署问题。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：其"连续馈电函数作为离散端口网络的无限维极限"这一数学思想，在概念上类似于将离散网络映射到连续/超参数空间的思想（类似NAS中的连续松弛），但这一类比非常牵强，实际借鉴价值极低。

Abstract: We present a novel calculus of variations (CoV)-based framework for the characterizing of, and beamforming over, continuous electromagnetic manifolds of arbitrary multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) array geometries. Building upon the discrete moment-matrix formulation of the state-of-the-art (SotA), the proposed framework simultaneously overcomes three of its fundamental limitations: (i) the point-source approximation error incurred by the near-field radiation operator; (ii) the confinement of the beamforming space to the N-dimensional subspace dictated by the hardware port count; and (iii) the generalization to arbitrary array geometries. To this end, each mesh element is modeled as a two-dimensional planar patch whose spatially averaged Green's function is evaluated via Gauss-Legendre (GL) quadrature, yielding a strictly more accurate near-field representation at negligible additional cost, while a continuous feeding function w(p) in L^2(S_T), introduced as the infinite-dimensional limit of the N-port network, lifts the optimization onto a hardware-decoupled current subspace of dimension K >> N. As an application example, we employ the proposed CoV-based framework to derive closed-form optimal beamformers for both unconstrained field-strength maximization, and a near-field pattern synthesis under a power density (PD) and region constraints, establishing their exact analogy to the discrete and generalized matched filters. Full-wave MATLAB Antenna Toolbox validation confirms consistent near-field accuracy gains over the SotA baseline for both linear and planar geometries at comparable computational cost.

</details>


### [146] [Radar-Aided Near-Field Beam Prediction via Beam Map Learning for XL-MIMO V2I Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27643)
*Jiali Nie,Yu Han,Yuanhao Cui,Xiaojie Li,Shi Jin,Chao-Kai Wen*

Task and scene: 任务类型：近场波束预测（near-field beam prediction）；应用场景：XL-MIMO车联网（V2I）通信系统；传感器类型：被动雷达（passive radar）与通信信号；目标类别：不涉及目标检测，预测对象为通信波束方向。摘要未说明具体目标类别。

Model architecture: 采用轻量级encoder-decoder卷积神经网络（lightweight encoder-decoder CNN），将雷达Bartlett谱（radar Bartlett spectra）映射为通信波束图（communication beam maps）。引入Gaussian soft supervision（高斯软监督）以保持波束空间的连续性。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及"lightweight"（轻量级）网络设计以降低波束训练开销，但未给出具体量化数据，也未涉及星上/边缘部署场景。

Experiments: 在Sionna ray tracing仿真数据集上进行实验，结果表明所提方法在Top-k accuracy、distance-based accuracy、beam loss和spectral efficiency等指标上持续优于基线方法。摘要未说明具体对比方法及数值结果。

Abstract: Near-field beam training in extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) systems incurs high overhead due to large range-angle codebooks and rapid channel variation. This paper proposes a passive radar-aided framework for near-field beam prediction based on radar-to-beam map learning. By exploiting the spatial correlation between radar observations and communication signals, the proposed method maps radar Bartlett spectra to communication beam maps using a lightweight encoder-decoder convolutional neural network. Gaussian soft supervision is further introduced to preserve beam-space continuity. Simulations on a synchronized Sionna ray tracing radar-communication dataset show that the proposed method consistently improves Top-k accuracy, distance-based accuracy, beam loss, and spectral efficiency.

</details>

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：仿真数据（extensive simulations）+ 室外原型（outdoor prototype）。评价指标：DoA估计精度（仰角/方位角误差，1°以内）、频谱清晰度（cleaner spectra），对比基线为matrix-completion和least-squares方法，以及full-aperture benchmark。

Abstract: Large-aperture reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) enable high-resolution 2D direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation, but existing approaches still tie hardware cost and control overhead to aperture size. To decouple the effective sensing aperture from the number of physically deployed RIS elements, we present V-RIS, a framework for virtual-aperture surface-field reconstruction and DoA estimation. V-RIS uses only four corner subarrays and a single-antenna receiver to reconstruct the virtual-aperture surface field from receiver observations collected under multiple RIS phase configurations, and then performs DoA estimation on the reconstructed virtual-aperture surface field. Our key observation is that, under far-field illumination, the discretized RIS surface field satisfies finite-order spatial recurrences along both aperture axes. We enforce data-level consistency through the RIS-coded receiver observations and propagation consistency through the far-field spatial recurrence, while using a four-corner deployment geometry that retains both contiguous local elements and long aperture baselines. To improve robustness in practical receiver observations, we adopt a bias-invariant receiver-domain loss that suppresses quasi-static hardware distortions and configuration-invariant multipath contributions. Extensive simulations show that V-RIS approaches the DoA accuracy of a full-aperture benchmark while producing cleaner spectra than matrix-completion and least-squares baselines. An outdoor prototype further validates the design: with only 25\% programmable elements, V-RIS keeps both elevation and azimuth errors within $1^\circ$ of the ground truth.

</details>

Abstract: We propose a multi-chirp affine frequency division multiplexing (MC-AFDM) scheme for joint delay-Doppler estimation with Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQRs). The work is motivated by the fact that RAQRs, while offering superior sensitivity and advantageous sensing capabilities, suffer from an optical ambiguity due to Doppler shifts in doubly-dispersive (DD) channel caused by target mobility, which precludes the reliable estimation of delay-Doppler parameters. To resolve this optical ambiguity and unleash the potential of RAQRs in DD channel, the proposed MC-AFDM employs multiple distinct AFDM post-chirp signals to overcome the rank-deficiency problem of the classical single-chirp AFDM (SC-AFDM), thereby enabling accurate delay-Doppler estimation of multiple targets. Our analysis reveals that the edge distribution of the multiple post-chirp parameters can further improve estimation accuracy by minimizing the condition number. Building on the proposed MC-AFDM waveform, we design a sequential signal processing algorithm based on orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) and least squares (LS), and we derive the theoretical lower bounds for delay and Doppler estimation. Numerical results show that the proposed MC-AFDM improves range and velocity estimation accuracy by up to two orders of magnitude compared to the classical SC-AFDM, and approaches its theoretical bounds through post-chirp optimization, validating the quantum-induced advantage of RAQRs for high-resolution quantum wireless sensing.

</details>

Experiments: 通过仿真验证了所提出的PA-SA-HB（功率分配-子阵列激活-混合波束成形）方案：相对等功率全阵列方案功耗降低最高达93%，相对PA-FA-HB方案降低最高达18%。摘要未给出具体仿真参数、信道模型细节或更多消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，属于无线通信物理层优化问题；2. 摘要未说明仿真场景规模、用户数量、阵列尺寸等关键参数；3. 未涉及任何计算模型压缩或推理加速方法；4. 功耗优化针对发射端通信硬件，而非星上计算载荷。

Ideas for my research: 1. "子阵列激活/动态资源调度"思想可类比到星上计算资源的动态调度——在轨目标检测时可依据任务负载动态激活/关闭部分计算单元（如NPU核、FPGA逻辑块）以降低功耗，值得借鉴其"按需激活"的能耗管理思路；2. 其"两阶段联合优化"框架（功率分配+资源激活）可类比为"模型精度-计算资源"的联合优化，即在轨检测中联合优化模型精度与推理能耗；3. 但整体而言，该论文对遥感目标检测模型轻量化的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: This paper examines the power consumption (PC) efficiency of a mixed near- and far-field (MF) simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system underpinned by a hybrid beamforming (HB)-based modular extra-large multiple-input-multiple output (XL-MIMO) array. Multiple information decoding (ID) and energy harvesting (EH) users are served by multiple constituent subarrays in both the near-field (NF) and far-field (FF) region of the transmit array. A novel decision method is proposed for accurate classification of different field users using Frobenius norm-based frequency correlation of the least square (LS) channel estimates. The NF spatial non-stationarities (SnS) effects entail distinct electromagnetic (EM) visibility regions (VRs), which can be customized to employ strategic activation of the constituent XL-MIMO subarrays. We formulate a two-tier joint optimization problem to minimize the overall PC, considering the power allocation (PA) for both ID and EH users in addition to the subarray activation (SA). This challenging mixed-integer problem is transformed into computationally tractable formulations, accompanied by the development of well-optimized algorithms. Our simulation results demonstrate an overall PC reduction for our proposed PA-SA-HB scheme by up to 93% against the equal PA with full array (FA) and up to 18% with respect to the PA-FA-HB case.

</details>


### [150] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Base Station Placement in TDOA-Based Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28002)
*Bastian Perner,Pratik Gajanan Raut,Maximilian Lübke,Norman Franchi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于射线追踪辅助的多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，用于5G/6G网络中基站（BS）布局优化，以提升TDOA定位精度。

Research relevance: 1分，基本无关。论文聚焦于5G/6G通信网络中的基站布局优化与设备定位（TDOA localization），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化或星上部署。仅有的弱关联在于使用了强化学习（RL）这一通用机器学习方法，但该方法与遥感目标检测轻量化方向没有直接借鉴价值。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于无线通信网络优化领域，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：基站（BS）布局优化以提升TDOA设备定位精度；应用场景：5G/6G蜂窝网络、大学校园环境；传感器类型：无线通信信道（Channel Impulse Response, CIR），非遥感传感器；目标类别：设备定位，非视觉目标检测。

Model architecture: 采用Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL)框架，每个agent使用Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)算法，基于射线追踪（ray-tracing）生成的Channel Impulse Responses (CIRs)进行训练，每个agent协同放置一个基站，共享奖励函数同时优化定位精度与覆盖范围。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化网络设计，也未涉及边缘/星上部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理性能。论文关注的是基站布局策略本身，而非模型部署效率。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：基于某大学校园的详细3D模型生成的CIR数据，覆盖5个校园区域（campus segments），具有不同的传播特性；评价指标：定位Mean Absolute Error (MAE)、定位精度与覆盖率的组合奖励；对比基线：基于GDOP的几何方法（含mean-optimized几何基线）。

Experiments: 在5个校园区域上评估，学习策略达到与GDOP几何方法相当的定位精度，平均MAE相对更强的mean-optimized几何基线降低约3%；在个别区域提升明显（最高约14%），在其他区域误差相当或略高。行为具有区域依赖性（segment-dependent）。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关；2. 方法仅在校园场景验证，泛化性存疑；3. 提升幅度有限（平均仅3%），且部分区域性能不升反降，作者也承认需要进一步工作实现一致性增益；4. 摘要未说明计算开销、训练成本、推理效率等部署相关信息。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但可借鉴的点有限：1. 多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架中"共享奖励函数联合优化多个目标"的思想，若未来在轨多星协同目标检测场景中需要联合优化检测精度与能耗，可参考其奖励设计思路；2. 射线追踪仿真生成训练数据的思路，与遥感中利用仿真数据（如合成SAR图像）增强训练集有方法论上的相似性。但总体而言，对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Accurate localization of devices is a key capability for emerging 5G and 6G networks and depends on effective base station (BS) placement. Conventional geometry-based approaches such as Geometric Dilution of Precision (GDOP) ignore realistic propagation effects such as Non-Line of Sight (NLOS) shadowing and multipath-induced Time of Arrival (TOA) bias caused by buildings. This paper proposes a ray-tracing-assisted Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework for environment-aware BS placement in Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) localization systems. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agents are trained on Channel Impulse Responses (CIRs) generated from a detailed 3D model of a university campus. Each agent cooperatively places one BS while optimizing a shared reward that combines localization accuracy and coverage. The approach is evaluated on five campus segments with varying propagation characteristics. Results show that the learned policy achieves localization accuracy comparable to conventional GDOP-based placement, lowering the average localization Mean Absolute Error (MAE) by about 3 % relative to the stronger (mean-optimized) geometric baseline. The behavior is segment-dependent, with a clear improvement on individual segments (up to about 14 %) and comparable or slightly higher error on the others. These findings indicate that incorporating site-specific propagation data into the placement process can match and selectively improve upon purely geometric strategies, motivating further work toward consistent gains.

</details>


### [151] [A Stochastic Optimization Framework for RIS-Aided Wireless Network Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28018)
*Davide Gagliardi,Alessio Zappone,Domenico Ciuonzo,Marco Di Renzo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于连续交叉熵(CE)和Metropolis-Hastings(MH)的随机优化框架，用于可重构智能表面(RIS)辅助无线网络的配置优化，在保持性能的同时将执行时间最多降低10倍。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文主题是可重构智能表面(RIS)辅助无线通信网络的优化问题，属于无线通信领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化均无直接关联。唯一的间接联系是"优化算法降低执行时间"这一思想与轻量化追求效率的目标有方法论上的相似性，但场景完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为RIS辅助无线通信网络的随机优化，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，仅优化效率思想有极弱的间接参考价值，不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：RIS辅助无线网络的随机优化（achievable-rate maximization和energy-efficiency maximization）。应用场景：未来无线通信网络（6G等）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络模型结构。核心是优化算法框架：基于连续版本的交叉熵(CE)方法和Metropolis-Hastings(MH)方法，处理连续变量，并通过relaxation和projection适配离散设置。应用于近无源RIS(nearly-passive RIS)和有源RIS(active RIS)两种架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。论文的"轻量化"体现在优化算法层面——通过随机优化方法（CE和MH）替代确定性算法，将执行时间(execution time)最多降低10倍，属于计算效率优化而非模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及执行时间最多降低10倍，但未给出具体硬件平台或实时性指标。与星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标包括：achievable rate（可达速率）、energy efficiency（能量效率）、execution time（执行时间）、convergence guarantees（收敛性保证）和efficiency analysis（效率分析）。数值实验对比了state-of-the-art确定性算法。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验设置和对比方法名称。数值结果表明：所提方法在性能上与SOTA确定性算法相当或更优，同时在代表性场景中执行时间最多降低10倍。提供了理论分析（收敛性保证和效率分析）。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。主要缺口包括：1) 与遥感/目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2) 未提供具体硬件部署指标（FLOPs、延迟、能耗等）；3) 未说明在真实RIS硬件上的验证情况；4) 未讨论大规模散射元素数量下的扩展性边界。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景无关，但以下方法论思想可间接借鉴：1) 随机优化方法（CE和MH）在处理大规模非凸优化问题时的效率优势，可类比思考在轨目标检测模型搜索或超参优化中的随机策略；2) "连续化+relaxation+projection"的处理思路，可类比轻量化中的连续松弛剪枝或量化方法；3) 在保证性能的前提下追求执行时间降低的思路，与轻量化目标一致。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) are a promising technology for improving the spectral and energy efficiency of future wireless networks, which make use of metasurfaces. However, optimizing RIS configurations typically leads to large-scale, non-convex problems whose complexity grows significantly with the number of scattering elements and the adoption of advanced metasurface architectures. In this paper, we develop a stochastic optimization framework for RIS-aided wireless networks based on continuous versions of the ($a$) cross-entropy (CE) and ($b$) Metropolis-Hastings (MH) methods. Unlike existing stochastic approaches that mainly focus on discrete optimization, the proposed framework directly handles continuous variables and can be readily applied to discrete settings through relaxation and projection. We provide a theoretical characterization of the proposed algorithms, including convergence guarantees and efficiency analysis. The framework is applied to ($i$) achievable-rate maximization with nearly-passive RISs and ($ii$) energy-efficiency maximization with active RISs. Numerical results show that the proposed methods achieve performance comparable to, or better than, state-of-the-art deterministic algorithms, while reducing execution times up to 10 times in representative scenarios.

</details>


### [152] [Fractional Doppler Effects on OTFS-NOMA HetNets with Mixed-Mobility Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28059)
*Wafa Hedhly,Leila Musavian,Nikolaos Thomos*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究6G异构网络中OTFS-NOMA系统在混合移动性条件下的分数多普勒效应及其对检测性能的影响，并分析NOMA功率分配优化对缓解多普勒间干扰的作用。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦6G车载异构网络的无线通信物理层技术（OTFS调制、NOMA多址、多普勒效应），完全不涉及遥感、卫星对地观测、目标检测或模型轻量化。虽然"卫星"和"检测"等词在摘要中出现，但分别指"卫星通信场景"和"信号检测"，与遥感图像目标检测（object detection）含义完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，属于6G无线通信物理层研究，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：6G车载异构网络（HetNets）中OTFS-NOMA系统的性能分析；应用场景：高移动性（HM）与低移动性（LM）用户共存的无线通信网络；传感器类型：不适用（无线通信物理层）；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络架构。系统采用OTFS调制用于高移动性用户，低移动性用户符号嵌入时频（TF）域，使用最小均方误差（MMSE）检测器，并采用NOMA功率分配策略。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。本文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等均未提及），属于无线通信信号处理层面的性能分析。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。本文讨论的是无线通信系统的频谱效率和用户服务数量，不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标为频谱效率（spectral efficiency）和服务的用户数量（number of users served），属于通信系统性能指标，而非目标检测的mAP、FPS等指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验设置。研究验证了分数多普勒对OTFS-NOMA系统性能的显著影响，并展示了NOMA功率分配在缓解IDI效应方面的作用。

Limitations: 本文明确说明其目的是分析分数多普勒的影响而非提出新的OTFS检测算法，属于系统性能分析类工作。与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化方向完全无交集，无可借鉴的检测或压缩方法。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：本文对"干扰/噪声对检测性能影响"的系统性分析方法论（即先建模干扰源、再分析影响、最后提出缓解策略）可类比到遥感图像中噪声/云遮挡对目标检测性能影响的分析思路，但关联非常间接。

Abstract: Heterogeneous networks (HetNets) are considered a promising approach to meet the increasing throughput requirements of 6G vehicular networks. The integration of orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation and non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) has demonstrated significant improvements in the reliability of wireless networks under mixed-mobility. Applying this combination in HetNets helps accommodate high-mobility (HM) and low-mobility (LM) users while effectively addressing high Doppler shifts. However, in practical scenarios, fractional Doppler arises from the mismatch between the actual Doppler frequency and its discrete representation on the DD grid. This effect leads to inter-Doppler interference (IDI) that can significantly degrade detection performance. In our work, we investigate the effect of fractional Doppler on OTFS-NOMA systems under mixed-mobility conditions and analyze how NOMA power allocation can be optimized to mitigate the resulting performance degradation. OTFS modulation is used for the HM user, while the LM users' symbols are embedded in the time-frequency (TF) domain. Minimum mean square error (MMSE) detection is utilized under multiple assumptions regarding the knowledge of the IDI parameters. We investigate the impact of optimizing NOMA power allocation on the overall system performance. The purpose of this work is to analyze the impact of fractional Doppler in OTFS-NOMA systems in HetNets rather than proposing new detection algorithms for OTFS modulation. The results validate the significant performance impact of fractional Doppler on the system and demonstrate the role of power allocation in mitigating IDI effects in terms of spectral efficiency and number of users served.

</details>


### [153] [Beamforming and Phase Shift Design for STAR-RIS Assisted Secure Sensing and Communication in ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28081)
*Haijun Zhang,Shuqing Wu,Xiaoqi Zhang,Zijun Wu,Xu Ma,Yuzheng Ren*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于STAR-RIS的ISAC框架，通过联合优化发射波束成形和STAR-RIS相移，在感知点目标（窃听者）与安全通信之间取得折中，采用BCD混合算法求解。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于无线通信领域的Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC)与Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS)研究，虽然涉及"sensing"和"target detection"，但这里的"感知"是指无线信号对点目标的探测（如定位/测距），并非遥感影像中的目标检测（object detection in remote sensing imagery）。论文不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及任何模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、边缘部署等压缩加速技术。属于泛无线通信/信号处理方向，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"课题相关性很弱。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于无线通信/ISAC领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：ISAC（通感一体化）中的感知-通信折中优化；应用场景：未来无线网络（6G），基站与多用户通信同时探测点目标；传感器类型：无线通信天线阵列（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：点目标（被建模为窃听者），非遥感影像目标。

Model architecture: 系统架构：配备多天线的基站（Base Station）+ 同时透射和反射的可重构智能表面（STAR-RIS）+ 单天线用户。算法框架：混合Block Coordinate Descent (BCD)算法，交替更新发射波束成形（transmission beamforming）和STAR-RIS相移（phase shifts），内部使用Successive Convex Approximation (SCA)、Penalty Dual Decomposition (PDD)和Projected Gradient Method (PGM)。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型轻量化方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等），其"优化"是针对通信-感知联合问题的数学优化，而非神经网络模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。其优化对象是无线通信系统的波束成形和RIS相移，与在轨计算部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 评价指标：Cramer-Rao Bound (CRB)用于评估点目标（窃听者）的感知精度；Secrecy Rate用于量化通信链路的安全等级。摘要未说明具体数据集（该方向通常使用仿真而非真实数据集）。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验结果。仅描述了提出的联合优化问题及BCD-based求解算法框架，未给出数值仿真结果、对比方法或消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，属于无线通信信号处理领域；2. 摘要未提供任何实验数据、收敛性分析或复杂度分析；3. 仅考虑单点目标（窃听者）场景，未扩展到多目标或实际遥感场景；4. 未涉及任何深度学习模型或轻量化技术。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可从方法论层面提取两点：1) BCD + SCA + PDD + PGM的交替优化框架，若未来研究涉及"感知-通信-计算"联合优化（如星上计算资源与通信带宽的联合分配），该框架有参考价值；2) CRB作为感知精度下界的评价思路，可类比用于评估轻量化模型在遥感目标检测中的性能下界。但整体上对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication(ISAC), as a rapidly advancing technique, introduces a fresh approach for achieving secure communication and intelligent sensing for future wireless networks. An ISAC framework empowered by simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surfaces(STAR-RIS) is explored in this paper, where a base station equipped with multiple antennas establishes wireless links to users each with a single antenna during the detection of a point target. The point target, regarded as an eavesdropper, trying to intercept users' information. Cramer-Rao bound(CRB) serves as evaluation criterion to assess sensing accuracy of point eavesdropper, whereas the secrecy rate is employed to quantify the security level of the communication link. To optimize sensing-communication tradeoff, a joint optimization problem is constructed. To approach the formulated problem, a hybrid Block Coordinate Descent(BCD)-based algorithm is developed, which alternately updates the transmission beamforming and STAR-RIS phase shifts, using successive convex approximation(SCA) technique, penalty dual decomposition (PDD) framework and projected gradient method(PGM).

</details>


### [154] [When Linear RUL Labels Disagree with Vibration Degradation: A Stage-Aware Target and Dual-Scale Predictor Evaluated on XJTU-SY and IMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28115)
*Behrad Mousaei Shir-Mohammad,Seyed Reza Tavakoli,Mohammad Mohammadi,Siavash Ahmadi,Babak Hossein Khalaj,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向轴承剩余使用寿命(RUL)预测的"阶段感知退化目标"设计框架，将目标设计从预测中分离，用CNN-LSTM与Transformer融合预测退化状态，并在XJTU-SY和IMS数据集上验证。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：剩余使用寿命(RUL)预测/退化状态估计（regression/时序预测）。应用场景：工业设备健康管理（轴承故障预测）。传感器类型：振动传感器（vibration signals）。目标类别：机械轴承（bearing）退化状态。与遥感目标检测无关。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文提到"compact CNN-LSTM"，但未给出参数量、FLOPs、剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等任何轻量化或模型压缩手段。轻量化并非本文关注点。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。该工作面向工业离线健康管理场景，不涉及星上或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：XJTU-SY轴承数据集（bearing-wise hold-out，排除所有以5结尾的轴承用于预处理、训练、早停和融合的拟合）；IMS轴承数据集（3条官方失效轨迹用于目标形状独立评估）。评价指标：RMSE（0.0608）、MAE（0.0392）、R-squared（0.9617）、BIC差异（128.8-368.1）、moving-block bootstrap区间。

Experiments: 在XJTU-SY轴承留出集上，融合预测器获得RMSE=0.0608、MAE=0.0392、R²=0.9617，其中Transformer贡献了大部分精度。在IMS三条失效轨迹上，阶段感知曲线相比最佳锚定线性拟合将RMSE降低3.6-18.2%、MAE降低3.1-31.1%，平均降低10.2%和15.0%。BIC差异支持阶段感知表示，但moving-block bootstrap区间跨越零，证据仍属描述性。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，属于机械健康管理领域。2. 作者自述证据仍为描述性（descriptive），因为只有3条官方IMS运行轨迹可用，不构成普适的非线性物理失效定律。3. 未提供模型复杂度、推理速度等部署指标。4. 未涉及目标检测、图像/遥感数据处理。

Ideas for my research: 尽管领域不同，但有以下可借鉴的通用方法论思路：1) "将目标设计从预测中分离"（separate target design from prediction）的思想——在遥感目标检测中，可类比为将标签/标注设计（如旋转框角度定义、小目标尺度定义）与检测网络训练解耦，设计更合理的回归目标。2) 阶段感知（stage-aware）建模思想——遥感在轨场景中目标退化/成像质量变化也可分阶段建模。3) 多模型融合（CNN-LSTM + Transformer + OWA）的集成策略可迁移到遥感检测的轻量级多分支融合。4) 严格的hold-out验证协议（排除特定样本）值得在遥感数据集划分中借鉴。但这些均为间接的方法论启发，非直接可复现的技术。

Abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) studies commonly treat the label as fixed, although clock-linear labels may decline while measured vibration remains nearly stable and then changes rapidly near failure. We separate target design from prediction. A development-only pipeline constructs an oriented vibration health indicator, identifies chronological early, middle, and late stages, and fits a continuous linear-quadratic-exponential degradation-state target. A compact CNN-LSTM and Transformer learn the target from causal feature sequences, and validation-fitted Ordered Weighted Averaging combines their outputs. In a bearing-wise XJTU-SY hold-out, all bearings ending in 5 are excluded from fitted preprocessing, training, early stopping, and fusion. The fused predictor obtains an RMSE of 0.0608, an MAE of 0.0392, and an R-squared value of 0.9617, with the Transformer providing most of the accuracy. Target shape is assessed independently on three documented IMS failed-bearing trajectories. Against the best anchored linear fit to the same vibration-derived reference, the stage-aware curve reduces RMSE by 3.6-18.2% and MAE by 3.1-31.1%; the mean reductions are 10.2% and 15.0%, respectively. Conservative BIC differences of 128.8-368.1 favor the stage-aware representation, whereas moving-block bootstrap intervals cross zero. Thus, stage-dependent targets better describe the evaluated vibration-derived degradation states, but the evidence remains descriptive because only three official IMS runs are available. The study establishes a measurement-oriented target-validity framework, not a universal nonlinear law for physical time-to-failure or robust cross-domain prediction.

</details>


### [155] [Reduced-Observation Approximation of Near-Field Gaussian Covariance Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28201)

Abstract: Near-field covariance matrices are central to local- ization, covariance-aware estimation, and linear MMSE filtering in large-aperture arrays, but Gaussian position uncertainty requires costly numerical averaging of nonlinear spherical-wave steering vectors. This letter proposes a low-complexity framework for two-dimensional near-field Gaussian covariance approxima- tion. By writing the quadrature covariance as RQ = HHH ,
the dominant covariance spectrum is obtained from a reduced observation representation, avoiding full MxM eigendecom- position. A self-calibrated non-reference spectral-error estimator is further introduced using only grid-to-grid dominant-spectrum differences. Numerical results show accurate convergence track- ing and substantial complexity reduction.

</details>


### [156] [CRLB-Driven Beamforming and Power Allocation for Multi-BS Cooperative ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28224)

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。局限性包括：1）面向地面蜂窝ISAC网络而非星载平台；2）处理的是无线信号目标定位而非遥感图像目标检测；3）不涉及任何深度学习模型压缩或加速技术；4）未提供参数量、FLOPs等部署关键指标。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可考虑以下间接启发：1）CRLB/PEB/VEB作为感知精度的理论下界度量思想，可类比用于遥感目标检测中定位精度的理论分析；2）SDR、SOCP等凸优化工具在资源受限下的复杂度-性能权衡思路，可类比于轻量化模型在精度与速度间的权衡设计；3）两阶段分解降低复杂度的思想（将联合优化分解为顺序求解）可类比于检测模型的分阶段轻量化策略。但整体上对遥感在轨目标检测课题的直接借鉴价值较低。

Abstract: This paper presents a Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB)-driven beamforming (BF) and power allocation (PA) framework for cooperative integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) networks, where a set of multi-antenna base stations (BSs) jointly serve multiple users and simultaneously perform multi-static target estimation. In our design, we investigate how the position error bound (PEB) and velocity error bound (VEB) can be exploited and incorporated into BF and PA optimization. The design leveraging PEB and VEB as metrics directly characterizes sensing accuracy. First, we propose a semidefinite programming (SDP)-based BF, where the PEB and VEB constraints are handled by double Schur complements, and the rank-1 constraints of the BF covariance matrices are relaxed by semidefinite relaxation (SDR), whose tightness is proved using the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions. Addressing the complexity, we further develop a two-stage PA algorithm, where the communication and sensing beams are formed by the regularized zero-forcing (RZF) and null-space projection (NSP) methods, respectively, and the communication and sensing PAs are solved sequentially by second-order cone programming (SOCP). Although the PA algorithm sacrifices the degrees of freedom, its performance shows a slight gap compared to BF in the simulation, while the execution time of around 25 ms demonstrates its applicability in dynamic environments.

</details>


### [157] [Improved Frequency Tracking with Adaptive Moments for Narrowband Interference Mitigation in GNSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28395)

Task and scene: 任务类型：GNSS接收机干扰抑制（interference mitigation）中的频率跟踪（frequency tracking）。应用场景：个人隐私设备（PPD）对GNSS接收机的有意干扰对抗。传感器类型：GNSS接收机（非遥感成像传感器）。目标类别：干扰信号（swept narrowband jammers），非遥感目标。

Abstract: Personal privacy devices (PPDs) typically emit strong tones or swept narrowband signals to jam nearby GNSS receivers and deliberately cause loss of lock. Excision methods deployed on receivers mitigate such interferers by tracking their instantaneous frequency and removing those components in either the time domain (e.g., notch filtering) or a transform domain (e.g., Fourier-domain excision). For effective mitigation without degrading the GNSS signal, the excision location must be precise; misplacement can sometimes harm performance even more than leaving the interferer unmitigated. Trackers are therefore evaluated for both dynamic tracking performance, especially against fast-sweeping jammers, as well as steady-state estimation jitter, reflecting a fundamental tracking speed versus variance trade-off. We propose a new frequency tracking algorithm that provides a better trade-off than existing methods using first and second moments of the gradient for a complex first-order IIR notch filter under a standard output power minimization objective. We first describe the algorithm, which is inspired by the Adam optimization method widely used for optimizing neural network parameters, and its relation to existing adaptive notch filter (ANF) update rules. Next, we analyze performance over a wide range of simulated and recorded interference events, including publicly available datasets, and benchmark against state-of-the-art methods including frequency-locked-loop (FLL) based designs. Finally, we analyze resource utilization and latency, and quantify the effects of quantization and pipeline delays on the proposed method and on representative state-of-the-art baselines. Our proposed Adam-based method shows marginally higher resource usage than a vanilla ANF while providing better suppression under most scenarios.

</details>


### [158] [Real-time Pre-Correlation GNSS Interference Classification with Lightweight Learned Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28404)
*Burak Soner,Can Aksoy,Erkin Halaçlı*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于虚拟自适应陷波滤波器瞬时频率特征的轻量级射频干扰分类算法，在资源受限的嵌入式平台上实现实时GNSS RFI分类。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文涉及轻量化算法和嵌入式实时部署，但应用场景是GNSS射频干扰分类，与遥感卫星目标检测无关。虽然涉及"卫星"（GNSS卫星信号）和"轻量化/嵌入式部署"，但既不是遥感成像，也不是目标检测任务，属于泛信号处理/泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感卫星目标检测方向基本无关，属于GNSS信号处理领域。虽然涉及轻量化和嵌入式部署，但任务类型（分类而非检测）、传感器（GNSS而非遥感成像）和应用场景均不匹配，仅"轻量级特征设计"和"资源受限平台实测"两个方法论层面有微弱借鉴价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：射频干扰（RFI）分类，用于GNSS安全关键应用中的干扰缓解对策选择。应用场景：GNSS接收机在轨/地面嵌入式平台上的实时干扰分类。传感器类型：GNSS射频信号（非遥感成像传感器）。目标类别：窄带和宽带非平稳RFI干扰类型。摘要未说明具体干扰类别数量。

Model architecture: 采用紧凑型学习分类器，包括梯度提升决策树（gradient-boosted decision trees, GBDT）等。输入特征包括：1）从虚拟自适应陷波滤波器（adaptive notch filter, ANF）的瞬时频率预测中提取的新型轻量级特征；2）来自先前文献的频谱特征。摘要未说明具体网络结构或特征维度。

Lightweight method: 轻量化主要体现在：1）设计轻量级输入特征（从ANF瞬时频率中提取），降低特征计算开销；2）采用紧凑型学习分类器（如GBDT）而非深度神经网络，在严格的计算和内存预算下实现高精度预测；3）在资源受限的嵌入式平台（EDGE Microwave HEDGE8008 CRPA平台）上评估资源利用率。摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏或NAS等经典模型压缩方法。

Onboard deployability: 论文明确面向资源受限的嵌入式平台（EDGE Microwave HEDGE8008紧凑型CRPA平台）进行实时RFI分类，强调实时性（防止失锁）和紧凑算法。测量了模型及文献中代表性方法的资源利用率。摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗数值。

Datasets and metrics: 评估覆盖广泛的模拟和实测RFI事件，包括近期研究中的公开数据集。评价指标为分类准确率（classification accuracy）。摘要未说明具体数据集名称、样本数量或详细指标。

Experiments: 主要实验：1）对比新特征（ANF瞬时频率特征+频谱特征）与仅用频谱特征的分类精度，验证新特征对窄带和宽带非平稳RFI的改进；2）在紧凑CRPA平台上测量模型与文献代表性方法的资源利用率。摘要未说明具体对比方法列表和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1）与遥感卫星目标检测完全无关，属于GNSS信号处理领域；2）摘要未提供具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟等量化部署指标；3）未涉及深度神经网络压缩技术（剪枝/量化/蒸馏）；4）分类任务而非检测任务，无目标定位/框回归；5）摘要未说明模型在真实在轨环境下的验证情况。

Ideas for my research: 1）"轻量级特征设计"思路可借鉴：与其压缩模型，不如从源头设计计算开销低的输入特征，这一思路可迁移到遥感目标检测中设计轻量级预处理/特征提取模块；2）在资源受限平台上进行资源利用率实测的方法论可借鉴，用于评估星上部署可行性；3）GBDT等紧凑分类器在严格计算预算下的精度-效率权衡分析思路，对轻量化检测器设计有参考价值；4）"虚拟自适应滤波器特征+频谱特征"的多特征融合策略，可类比遥感中多光谱/多源特征融合的轻量化设计。

Abstract: Radio-frequency interference (RFI) remains a significant threat to GNSS in safety-critical applications. Since no single mitigation method is effective for all interferers, reliable classification is needed to select appropriate countermeasures during operation. To prevent loss of lock, RFI classification must run in real time, typically on resource-constrained embedded platforms, necessitating lightweight algorithms. While prior works realize this with simple rule-based algorithms for detecting and characterizing certain types of interferers, this approach does not scale to the broad space of all possible RFI techniques, and data-driven learned algorithms are a better fit. To satisfy these constraints, this work considers pre-correlation RFI classification with an emphasis on compact algorithms that still provide high accuracy. We first introduce a new set of lightweight input features derived from the instantaneous frequency predictions of a virtual adaptive notch filter (ANF). We observe improved classification accuracy for both narrowband and broadband non-stationary RFI by combining these new features with other spectral features from prior literature. Next, we benchmark compact learned classifiers such as gradient-boosted decision trees for accurate prediction under tight compute and memory budgets. The evaluation spans a broad set of simulated and recorded RFI events, including publicly available datasets from recent studies. Finally, we measure resource utilization for our models and for representative methods from the literature, on a compact CRPA platform (EDGE Microwave HEDGE8008).

</details>
