Reading priority: 1分。论文属于LLM智能体强化学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。仅在"自蒸馏"方法论层面有极间接的借鉴价值，不建议作为核心阅读文献。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型智能体（LLM agent）的强化学习训练与自蒸馏。应用场景：通用智能体环境（agentic environments），非遥感/卫星场景。传感器类型：不适用（文本/轨迹数据）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 核心框架为GRSD（Group-Reflective Self-Distillation），包含三个关键组件：(1) on-policy group反思机制——策略对每个验证轨迹进行反思；(2) stop-gradient snapshot——对成功与失败rollout的反思结果进行对比，构建group-level privileged guidance；(3) self-teacher——基于该guidance细化turn-level credit assignment，通过调制outcome-based advantages来保持verifier确定的学习方向。整体基于RLVR（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards）框架。

Lightweight method: 涉及"self-distillation"（自蒸馏）概念，但这里的蒸馏不是用于模型压缩或轻量化，而是用于从策略自身的验证rollout中提取引导信号以增强稀疏奖励。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS、实时推理或边缘部署等轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何部署相关指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等均未提及），且研究对象为LLM智能体，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要提到在"multiple agentic environments and model scales"上进行实验，但未给出具体数据集名称、评价指标或实验设置细节。摘要未说明。

Experiments: 实验表明GRSD在多个智能体环境和多种模型规模下持续优于竞争基线（competitive baselines），并在未见任务上具有更好的泛化能力（generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks）。但摘要未提供具体数值结果、对比方法名称或消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，属于LLM智能体强化学习领域；(2) 摘要未提供具体实验数据、数据集、指标和模型规模细节；(3) 方法依赖verifier提供的可验证奖励，在遥感目标检测场景中缺乏直接映射；(4) 摘要未说明计算开销、训练成本或推理效率。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但"self-distillation"和"group-level privileged guidance"的思想有一定方法论借鉴潜力：(1) 在遥感目标检测模型的知识蒸馏中，可借鉴"从自身预测结果中反思并生成引导信号"的思路，构建自蒸馏框架以减少对大型教师模型的依赖；(2) "stop-gradient snapshot"对比成功/失败样本的思想，可用于遥感小目标检测中难样本挖掘与训练信号增强；(3) "turn-level credit assignment"的细粒度信用分配思想，可类比到检测任务中逐像素/逐锚框的细粒度监督信号设计。但这些借鉴属于间接方法论迁移，需谨慎评估其适用性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts. For each prompt, the policy reflects on each verified trajectory in an on-policy group, and a stop-gradient snapshot contrasts the resulting reflections from successful and failed rollouts to construct group-level privileged guidance. Conditioned on this guidance, a self-teacher refines turn-level credit assignment by modulating outcome-based advantages while preserving the verifier-determined learning direction. Experiments across multiple agentic environments and model scales demonstrate that GRSD consistently outperforms competitive baselines and generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks.

</details>


### [234] [Distilling Answer Set Programming Theories from Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28086)
*Nelson Higuera Ruiz,Markus Hofmarcher,Claudiu Leoveanu-Condrei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究利用神经符号方法让大语言模型在给定agent框架和求解器在环的条件下，从零开始自动蒸馏出完整正确的Answer Set Programming (ASP)理论，并在VQA基准（CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER）上评估了9种不同规模模型的性能。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于神经符号推理、ASP理论自动生成和VQA视觉问答任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/轻量化。属于泛视觉问答与符号推理领域，与本课题弱相关（1分）。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于神经符号推理与VQA领域。除非对"检测器+符号规则"协同推理感兴趣，否则无需深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：Answer Set Programming (ASP) 理论自动蒸馏（neurosymbolic approach）；应用场景：Visual Question Answering (VQA)；传感器类型：不适用（使用CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER三个公开VQA基准数据集）；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。研究涉及9种大语言模型：四个前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, DeepSeek V4 Pro）、两个中端模型（DeepSeek V4 Flash, gpt-oss-120b）、三个开源权重模型（qwen3.6-27b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3.5-9b）。采用固定agent harness配合solver in the loop的神经符号框架。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏（指模型压缩意义上的distillation）、NAS等轻量化方法。虽然文中使用"distill"一词，但指的是从LLM中蒸馏出ASP理论，而非模型压缩中的知识蒸馏。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。仅提及模型规模（从9B到前沿闭源模型）作为研究变量，但未给出具体部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER三个VQA基准。评价指标：准确率（accuracy），以百分比表示（如CLEVR上100%，GQA上92.8%-98.8%，CLEVRER上92.7%-95.3%）。实验设置：给定单个prompt和空文件作为起点，模型有1小时时间限制来推导完整理论，协议为dataset-agnostic。

Experiments: 主要结果：三个前沿模型在CLEVR上达到100%，在GQA上达到92.8%-98.8%；在CLEVRER上Sonnet、Opus、DeepSeek V4 Pro得分92.7%-95.3%。GPT-5在CLEVR上达98.7%，但在GQA上降至41.8%，在CLEVRER上为86.7%。加入其他数据集的手写参考理论后，三个前沿模型变化最多±3.4个百分点，但GPT-5的准确率下降3-19个百分点。论文发布了代码、prompt和蒸馏出的理论。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1）论文仅针对VQA领域，未涉及遥感或目标检测场景；2）未提供任何模型压缩、推理加速或部署相关指标；3）依赖大语言模型（最大为前沿闭源模型），计算资源需求高，与在轨轻量化目标相悖；4）GPT-5在不同数据集上的性能波动较大，说明方法的鲁棒性存在疑问。

Ideas for my research: 虽然整体弱相关，但可借鉴的点有限：1）"solver in the loop"的神经符号框架思想可类比于在轨推理中"检测器+后处理规则"的协同设计，即用符号规则约束检测输出，提升可解释性和可靠性；2）"dataset-agnostic"的协议设计思路可用于设计跨传感器（光学/SAR/高光谱）通用的轻量化检测框架；3）模型规模与任务能力的关系研究（9B到前沿模型）可类比于轻量化研究中"模型容量-精度-速度"的权衡分析。但总体借鉴价值较低。

Abstract: Writing Answer Set Programming (ASP) theories from scratch is a difficult and time-consuming task. We take a neurosymbolic approach to study whether a model can distill complete and correct theories, given a fixed agent harness with the solver in the loop. The protocol is dataset-agnostic: with a single prompt and an empty file as the starting point the model is given a 1-hour time limit to derive a complete theory. We chose VQA as the application domain, three benchmarks (CLEVR, GQA, CLEVRER), as these are publicly available and non-trivial. In order to study the model scale required for solving this task we nine different models: four frontier (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, DeepSeek V4 Pro), two mid-tier (DeepSeek V4 Flash, gpt-oss-120b), and three open-weights (qwen3.6-27b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3.5-9b). Three of four frontier models reach 100% on CLEVR and 92.8%-98.8% on GQA; on CLEVRER, Sonnet, Opus, DeepSeek V4 Pro score 92.7%-95.3%. GPT-5 reaches 98.7% on CLEVR but drops to 41.8% on GQA and to 86.7% on CLEVRER. Adding handwritten reference theories from other datasets moves the other three frontier models by at most +/-3.4 pp but reduces GPT-5's accuracy by 3-19 pp. We release the code, prompts, and theories distilled.

</details>


### [235] [Diversifying Personalized Research Ideation against AI-Induced Homogenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28087)
*Rui Xu,Yunke Wang,Linwei Tao,Wenjie Xuan,Yong Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DivAlign，一个四阶段流水线，用于在AI辅助科研选题中生成去同质化且保持研究者对齐的研究方向建议。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文主题是AI辅助科研选题（research ideation），属于自然语言处理/推荐系统/人机交互领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。既没有遥感/卫星场景，也没有object detection、pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、FLOPs等任何相关技术内容。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为AI辅助科研选题推荐，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：AI辅助科研选题生成（research ideation）；应用场景：科研社区研究方向推荐；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明。

Model architecture: DivAlign四阶段流水线：1) 提取细粒度研究者画像（fine-grained researcher profiles）；2) 生成画像条件化的候选研究方向（profile-conditioned candidate directions）；3) 沿三个对齐维度（Executability, Comprehensibility, Growth Potential）打分；4) 呈现研究者局部方向并降低社区层面的冗余。摘要未说明具体底层模型结构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要中未出现任何模型压缩、加速或轻量化方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 自建benchmark：来自5个子领域的95位AI研究者。评价指标：平均成对相似度（average pairwise similarity）、最近邻相似度（nearest-neighbor similarity）、研究者方向匹配度（researcher-direction fit score）。

Experiments: 与粗粒度单次选题（coarse single-shot ideation）相比，平均成对相似度从0.331降至0.294，最近邻相似度从0.704降至0.608；与独立top-choice变体相比，最近邻相似度从0.663降至0.608，同时保留99.9%的研究者方向匹配度。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关；2) 摘要未说明模型规模、推理成本、可扩展性；3) 仅基于95位研究者的benchmark，规模有限；4) 摘要未说明对真实科研产出的下游验证。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极低。唯一可能的间接启发是：其"去同质化+保持对齐"的思想可类比于在模型压缩中平衡"轻量化程度"与"精度保持"的权衡，但这是非常牵强的类比。对本课题（遥感在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可直接复现或借鉴的技术点。

Abstract: AI-assisted research ideation has emerged as a promising paradigm for accelerating scientific discovery, with systems now capable of generating research directions conditioned on papers, topics, or lightweight researcher contexts. Yet current systems largely optimize individual suggestions in isolation. This leaves two blind spots. First, coarse researcher representations may elicit mainstream directions that appear broadly feasible, but lack sufficient researcher-specific grounding. Second, independent recommendations can concentrate a community's portfolio around recurring high-probability themes. To address these blind spots, we propose DivAlign, a four-stage pipeline for alignment-preserving de-homogenization. DivAlign extracts fine-grained researcher profiles, generates profile-conditioned candidate directions, scores them along three alignment dimensions (Executability, Comprehensibility, and Growth Potential), and surfaces researcher-local directions while reducing redundancy across the community portfolio. On a benchmark we construct from 95 AI researchers across five subfields, DivAlign reduces community-level redundancy while preserving researcher-direction fit. Compared with coarse single-shot ideation, it lowers average pairwise similarity from 0.331 to 0.294 and nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.704 to 0.608. Compared with the independent top-choice variant, DivAlign reduces nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.663 to 0.608 while retaining 99.9% of the researcher-direction fit score. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ruixxxx/DivAlign.

</details>


### [236] [PerturbMap: Cross-Context Transfer of Single-Cell Perturbation Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28090)
*Panpan Cui,Yiqi Liu,Wenhao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PerturbMap，一种通过结合接收者局部低秩基与跨上下文ridge专家传输的扰动效应预测方法，用于单细胞扰动图谱中缺失上下文效应的预测。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于计算生物学/单细胞基因组学领域，处理的是Perturb-CITE-seq单细胞扰动图谱数据，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测或遥感场景理解。更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理或边缘部署等轻量化方法。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于单细胞基因组学领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感数据、目标检测任务或任何模型压缩/加速方法。除非对低秩分解或跨域知识迁移的抽象方法论感兴趣，否则无需阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：单细胞扰动效应预测（single-cell perturbation effect prediction），即在缺失的细胞上下文（recipient context）中预测某个扰动（perturbation）的效应。应用场景：计算生物学、单细胞基因组学。传感器类型：不适用（数据为Perturb-CITE-seq单细胞测序数据）。目标类别：不适用（对象为细胞扰动效应）。

Model architecture: PerturbMap由三部分组成：(1) 接收者局部低秩基（recipient-local low-rank base）；(2) 通过源到接收者的ridge experts（source-to-recipient ridge experts）传输同一扰动的源上下文测量响应；(3) 基于验证锚点（validation anchors）估计的路由可靠性（route reliability）来确定proposal权重。整体采用"低秩基 + 跨上下文传输proposal + 加权融合"的架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或轻量网络设计。其核心关注点是预测精度而非计算效率或部署。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向生物信息学分析场景，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Perturb-CITE-seq melanoma cohort（黑色素瘤队列单细胞扰动测序数据）。评价指标：full-effect MSE（全效应均方误差）、condition-mean specificity diagnostic（条件均值特异性诊断）、top-10 counterpart retrieval by cosine（余弦相似度top-10检索）。对比方法：FedAvg、zero-response、raw-copy、calibrated-copy、identity-shuffled affine controls，以及centralized token-matched pooled reference。

Experiments: 主要结果：PerturbMap相比接收者局部低秩基在full-effect MSE上提升4.1%；相比FedAvg、zero-response、raw-copy、calibrated-copy、identity-shuffled affine controls均取得更低MSE；与使用更强训练接口的centralized token-matched pooled reference相比，MSE差距在2.82×10⁻⁶以内；同接收者top-10余弦检索从低秩基的74.5%提升到80.5%。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：(1) 方法依赖paired training perturbations来拟合ridge experts，对训练数据配对要求较高；(2) 仅在单一数据集（Perturb-CITE-seq melanoma cohort）上验证，泛化性未知；(3) 未涉及计算效率、内存占用等部署指标；(4) 与遥感/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但其"低秩基 + 跨域传输 + 路由可靠性加权"的框架思想在方法论层面有一定抽象借鉴价值：(1) 低秩分解（low-rank base）思想与模型压缩中的低秩近似（low-rank approximation）有概念上的相通之处，可启发在遥感检测模型中利用低秩约束进行参数压缩；(2) 跨上下文传输（cross-context transport）与知识蒸馏中"教师到学生"的知识迁移在抽象层面有相似性，可类比思考如何将大模型知识迁移到轻量模型；(3) 路由可靠性加权（route reliability weighting）可类比于多分支轻量网络中的动态路由或专家混合（MoE）中的门控机制。但这些均为非常间接的方法论类比，实际借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases rarely measure every intervention in every cellular context: a query perturbation is often observed in one or more source contexts but missing in the recipient context where its effect is needed. Ignoring those measured responses discards query-specific experimental evidence, whereas copying or weakly calibrating them across contexts risks transferring the wrong signal. We propose PerturbMap, which predicts a missing recipient-context effect by combining a recipient-local low-rank base with accepted proposals that transport the same perturbation's measured source responses through source-to-recipient ridge experts fit on paired training perturbations, with proposal weights determined by route reliability estimated on validation anchors. On the Perturb-CITE-seq melanoma cohort, PerturbMap improves full-effect MSE by 4.1\% over a recipient-local low-rank base and achieves lower MSE than FedAvg, zero-response, raw-copy, calibrated-copy, and identity-shuffled affine controls. It remains within $2.82\times10^{-6}$ MSE of our centralized token-matched pooled reference, which uses a stronger training interface. A condition-mean specificity diagnostic shows the same direction: same-recipient top-10 counterpart retrieval by cosine increases from 74.5\% for the low-rank base to 80.5\% for PerturbMap.

</details>


### [237] [An Instrument to Evaluate Governance Proposals: AI Policy Analysis at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28094)
*Paulo Carvao,Claudio Mayrink Verdun,Isabel Adler,Jeffrey Zhou*

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验结果。论文主要贡献为：(1) 基于经验grounded rubrics的多维政策评估；(2) 结合专家反馈与计算验证的透明混合方法；(3) 以领域训练的rubric-calibrated模型作为基准，比较不同通用LLM在政策分析上的表现。无任何目标检测或模型压缩相关的实验。

Abstract: This paper introduces a policy analysis framework for systematic, transparent assessment of AI governance proposals in an evolving and contested regulatory landscape. AI policy debates often collapse into binary positions that obscure underlying tradeoffs and normative assumptions. The framework structures policy analysis around multiple policy attributes, allowing users to surface priorities and tensions without prescribing outcomes. We use a mixed-methods approach that integrates qualitative insights from subject matter experts with computational text analysis to inform the design of policy attribute rubrics. This quantifies the relative emphasis of different policy objectives and presents them through comparative visualizations that support interpretability and cross-policy comparison. The paper also examines the use of commercial LLMs for rubric-based policy analysis, benchmarking their outputs against a domain-trained rubric-calibrated model with explicitly defined analytical assumptions. Rather than assessing policy effectiveness or desirability, the framework focuses on relevance and alignment across attributes. By making analytical assumptions explicit, including attribute selection, rubric construction, and weighting schemes, the framework enables users to evaluate whether its embedded priorities align with the users' own normative commitments. The approach is jurisdiction-agnostic and intended to support policymakers, analysts, and researchers navigating complex AI governance environments.
  Contributions: (1) multidimensional policy assessment through empirically grounded rubrics that surface tradeoffs rather than resolving them; (2) a transparent hybrid methodology combining feedback from subject-matter experts with computational validation; and (3) use of domain-trained rubric-calibrated models as a benchmark for comparing different general-purpose large language models.

</details>


### [238] [SciDataSailor: Deep Scientific Data Exploring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28098)
*Jiyong Rao,Yicheng Qiu,Chi Zhang,Chunfeng Song,Runkai Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Deep Scientific Data Exploration智能体任务范式及SciDataSailor框架，利用MCTS合成工具交互轨迹，用于科学数据集的探索、整合与分析。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/LLM agent方向，聚焦科学数据集的智能探索与问答，并非遥感/卫星目标检测或轻量化研究。虽然摘要提到数据集涵盖"earth sciences"（地球科学），但这是数据来源层面的关联，与遥感图像目标检测、在轨部署、模型压缩等核心方向无直接关系。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM agent在科学数据探索领域的应用研究，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：科学数据探索与问答（scientific data exploration, QA）；应用场景：科学数据集仓库的导航、文件解析、跨文件证据整合与结论生成；传感器类型：不适用（处理的是结构化科学数据文件，非遥感图像）；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: SciDataSailor框架基于Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)进行轨迹合成，包含四个机制：difficulty-stratified exploration seeds（难度分层探索种子）、dual-feedback first-play urgency（双反馈首步紧迫性）、hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation（分层策略到工具动作生成）、entropy-guided branching（熵引导分支）。构建了SciDataSailor-SFT-2K用于监督微调，SciDataSailor-Bench用于评估。底层依赖LLM agent的planning、reasoning和tool use能力。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏或轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：SciDataSailor-Bench包含627个meta-information summarization任务和586个scientific question-answering任务，覆盖27个数据集，横跨life、earth和physical sciences。评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验结果和对比方法。仅介绍了框架构建和benchmark设计，未给出性能数据。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1) 该工作聚焦科学数据文件探索，与遥感图像目标检测任务完全无关；2) 未涉及任何模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署考量；3) 即使涉及earth science数据，也是结构化数据而非遥感影像。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：1) 若未来研究方向涉及遥感数据集的自动化整理、标注或元数据管理，其agentic exploration思路可参考；2) MCTS用于轨迹合成的思想在AutoML/NAS领域有类似应用，但本论文未涉及NAS；3) 整体而言，对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接可借鉴点很少。

Abstract: Scientific datasets are commonly organized as hierarchical repositories containing heterogeneous and interdependent files, making their inspection, integration, and analysis labor-intensive and reliant on domain expertise. Although large language model (LLM) agents have advanced substantially in planning, reasoning, and tool use, existing research has largely overlooked their ability to interact with real scientific data assets through executable environments. We introduce Deep Scientific Data Exploration, an agentic task paradigm in which agents navigate repositories, interpret heterogeneous files and schemas, execute analyses, integrate cross-file evidence, and produce conclusions grounded in executed observations. To operationalize this paradigm, we present SciDataSailor, a framework for synthesizing tool-interactive trajectories by balancing broad exploration with targeted exploitation. SciDataSailor instantiates trajectory synthesis as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with four task-specific mechanisms: difficulty-stratified exploration seeds, dual-feedback first-play urgency, hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation, and entropy-guided branching. Using this framework, we construct SciDataSailor-SFT-2K for supervised fine-tuning and SciDataSailor-Bench for evaluation, with the latter comprising 627 meta-information summarization tasks and 586 scientific question-answering tasks across 27 datasets spanning the life, earth, and physical sciences.

</details>


### [239] [MIND: Lightweight and Effective Memory Injection Defense for LLM Agents via Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28103)
*Dongyi Liu,Haixing He,Xiaobao Wu,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MIND（Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising），一个面向LLM智能体记忆注入攻击的轻量级防御框架，利用意图感知信息瓶颈提取紧凑的意图-行为表征来识别恶意记忆。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文研究的是LLM（大语言模型）智能体的memory injection attack（记忆注入攻击）防御问题，属于自然语言处理/LLM安全领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测完全无关。唯一的弱关联在于"lightweight"（轻量）这一概念——论文提出了一个轻量级防御框架以避免重复LLM审计的开销，但这与遥感模型轻量化（剪枝、量化、蒸馏等）在技术内涵和应用场景上完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文研究LLM智能体记忆注入攻击防御，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感数据、目标检测或任何模型压缩技术。除非对Information Bottleneck在特征压缩方面的理论感兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体记忆注入攻击防御（memory injection attack defense）。应用场景：多轮对话智能体（multi-turn conversational agents），如ReAct-StrategyQA。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：恶意记忆轨迹（malicious memory trajectories）。

Model architecture: MIND框架包含两个核心组件：(1) intent-aware Information Bottleneck (IB)——从初始用户意图和turn-level行为中提取紧凑的intent-behavior表征，保留意图相关的跨轮攻击信号，过滤任务无关和重复信息；(2) 轻量级检测器（lightweight detector）——从IB提取的表征中识别恶意记忆。

Lightweight method: 论文的"lightweight"体现在：通过Information Bottleneck压缩多轮上下文信息，避免对每一轮都进行重复的LLM审计（repeated LLM auditing），从而降低计算开销。这属于"信息压缩/冗余消除"层面的轻量化思路，而非传统模型压缩方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等）。摘要未说明具体的参数量、FLOPs或延迟数据。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文面向的是LLM智能体安全场景，不涉及星上/边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT、实时推理等遥感在轨部署相关指标。仅提到"inference efficiency"（推理效率）和"latency"（延迟）作为评估维度，但未给出具体数值。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ReAct-StrategyQA（论文中明确提到的实验数据集）。评价指标：ASR-r（attack success rate - 平均攻击成功率相关指标）、ASR-a、average accuracy（平均准确率）、latency（延迟）。摘要未说明其他数据集和更详细的实验设置。

Experiments: 在ReAct-StrategyQA上，MIND将mean ASR-r和ASR-a分别降低了55.4%和55.3%，同时在与未防御的智能体相比时保持了平均准确率和延迟。摘要未说明与其他防御方法的详细对比结果、消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测方向完全无关，属于LLM安全领域；(2) 摘要未说明模型的具体参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟数值等部署指标；(3) 仅在ReAct-StrategyQA一个数据集上报告了结果，泛化性存疑；(4) 未说明轻量检测器的具体架构和复杂度；(5) 未讨论在视觉/遥感任务上的可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有两个概念层面的思路可借鉴：(1) Information Bottleneck（信息瓶颈）思想——在遥感目标检测模型轻量化中，可以用类似的信息压缩思路来设计特征蒸馏或特征选择模块，在保持检测精度的同时压缩冗余特征通道；(2) "避免重复审计开销"的轻量化动机——类似于在轨场景中避免对每帧图像都运行完整检测网络，可考虑基于时序/场景变化的自适应推理（adaptive inference）策略。但这些仅是方法论层面的类比，直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Memory-augmented LLM-based agents are vulnerable to memory injection attacks: Agents may retrieve poisoned memory from attackers, which diverts their behavior from initial user intent and finally causes task failure. However, existing defense mechanisms either incur high computational cost or suffer from information redundancy in multi-turn contexts. To address these challenges, we propose Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising(MIND), a lightweight defense framework for memory injection attack. Our preliminary analysis reveals that benign and poisoned trajectories exhibit distinguishable relationships between the initial user intent and subsequent behavior. Building on this observation, MIND employs an intent-aware Information Bottleneck(IB) to extract compact intent--behavior representations from the initial intent and turn-level behavior. The IB preserves intent-relevant cross-turn attack signals while filtering task-irrelevant and repetitive information, and a lightweight detector identifies malicious memories from the resulting representations. As such, MIND mitigates information redundancy in multi-turn contexts while avoiding the overhead of repeated LLM auditing. Extensive experiments show that MIND reduces attack success rates while preserving task accuracy and inference efficiency. Notably, on ReAct-StrategyQA, MIND reduces mean ASR-r and ASR-a by 55.4% and 55.3%, respectively, while matching the undefended agent in average accuracy and latency.

</details>


### [240] [Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28109)
*Jiawen Tao,Miao Peng,Yaoming Li,Xiaokun Yuan,Mengzhou Wu,Wenhan Yu,Guoan Wang,Nuo Chen,Tong Yang,Maxm Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究合成教科书数据对语言模型预训练的影响，提出一个可扩展的合成数据流水线，通过将检索内容聚类、规划层级目录并组装成完整书籍（Full设置），证明"书籍级组织"这一因素比单纯的内容生成或局部改写风格更能提升下游性能（平均+1.09），并通过受控实验分离出文档打包、文档长度、结构化合成等设计因素的作用。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文属于自然语言处理/大语言模型预训练数据合成方向，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。唯一可借鉴之处在于其"数据组织/结构化合成"的思想，若迁移到遥感领域可类比为"如何组织遥感训练数据（如按场景、目标类别、传感器类型聚类组织）以提升检测模型训练效果"，但这属于间接的方法论启发，并非遥感场景本身。

Reading priority: 1分。本文是NLP大模型预训练数据合成方向的工作，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，无直接可复用的方法、模型或部署信息，仅作为方法论层面的泛化启发，阅读优先级极低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：语言模型预训练数据合成（synthetic pre-training data）。应用场景：NLP/LLM预训练。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 不涉及目标检测模型。文中提及的模型为Llama3-8B（用于验证合成数据效果的backbone语言模型）。核心贡献是数据合成流水线：从预训练语料中检索源材料（retrieval）→ 按主题聚类（clustering）→ 规划层级目录（hierarchical TOC planning）→ 组装成完整书籍（book assembly），产出686K本教科书、32B tokens、覆盖15,000+学科。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。摘要未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署，无参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：合成教科书语料（686K textbooks, 32B tokens, 15,000+ disciplines），替换mid-training mix中的自然书籍。评价指标：下游任务平均性能提升（+1.09 average）。受控实验设置包括：Split条件（内容匹配但每节独立成文档）、RandomConcat控制（长度匹配但跨书拼接）、Rephrase条件（检索池匹配但独立改写，无聚类/TOC/组装）。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 用合成教科书替换mid-training mix中的自然书籍，下游性能平均+1.09；2) Full vs Split：+1.02平均增益，分离出"文档打包"因素；3) Full vs RandomConcat：证明文档长度本身不足以解释增益；4) Full vs Rephrase：+1.17增益，证明结构化合成（聚类+TOC+组装）的价值；5) 在Llama3-8B上Full同样优于RandomConcat和Natural Books。

Limitations: 与本研究方向基本无关，主要局限在于：1) 完全面向NLP/LLM预训练，无任何遥感、目标检测、轻量化内容；2) 摘要未说明合成数据的计算成本、生成耗时等工程细节；3) 未讨论该方法对视觉/遥感任务的迁移可行性；4) 摘要未说明下游任务的具体类型和评估基准。

Ideas for my research: 尽管本文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化无直接关系，但其"数据组织影响模型训练效果"的核心思想可间接借鉴：1) 在遥感目标检测训练中，可类比思考"训练数据的组织方式"（如按场景类型、目标尺度、传感器模态聚类组织数据）是否影响小目标检测性能；2) 其受控实验设计方法论（Split/RandomConcat/Rephrase对照）可用于设计遥感数据增强或数据组织的消融实验；3) 若未来做遥感基础模型（foundation model）预训练，本文的"书籍级结构化组织"思想可迁移为"按地理区域/场景语义组织遥感图像序列"以提升预训练质量。但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Synthetic textbook data has improved language model pre-training, but prior work largely treats the benefit as a property of generated content or local rewriting style. We study a different factor: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. We contribute both a scalable synthesis pipeline and controlled evidence that this organization matters. The pipeline retrieves source material from a pre-training corpus, clusters it into topical units, plans hierarchical tables of contents, and assembles source-grounded sections into complete books (our Full setting), yielding 686K textbooks (32B tokens) across 15,000+ disciplines. Replacing natural books in a mid-training mix with this corpus improves downstream performance by +1.09 on average. Controlled comparisons then disentangle the relevant design factors. A content-matched Split condition holds generated text and tokens fixed but treats each section as an independent document; Full's +1.02 mean gain isolates document packaging. A length-matched RandomConcat control that joins sections from different books remains below Full, ruling out document length alone. A retrieval-pool-matched Rephrase condition independently rewrites individual retrieved documents under the same audience-by-style scheme, without clustering, TOC planning, or book assembly; Full's +1.17 gain demonstrates the value of structured synthesis. On Llama3-8B, Full likewise outperforms both RandomConcat and Natural Books, supporting book-level organization as a useful axis for synthetic pre-training data design.

</details>


### [241] [BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28110)
*Ruslan Khrulev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 BlueprintRepair，一种基于蓝图依赖图的定理证明修复接口，通过十种 schema 检查的局部操作让模型修改证明蓝图，并构建 BlueprintTrace 基准（142 个受控失败案例）比较三种修复接口在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.6-Flash 上的表现。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于形式化数学定理证明（Lean proving system）中的蓝图修复接口设计，属于形式化验证/自动推理领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩部署。相关性评分：1 分。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文主题为形式化定理证明中的蓝图修复，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：形式化定理证明中的蓝图修复（blueprint repair）。应用场景：Lean 证明系统、依赖图（dependency graph）上的局部编辑。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 核心是 BlueprintRepair 修复接口，通过十种 schema-checked 局部操作（local operations）修改证明蓝图依赖图。操作需声明所编辑的节点，目标定理不可被更改；Lean 对每次应用变更做检查，接受的修复必须声明其证明使用的每个蓝图引理。对比了三种接口：typed edits（类型化编辑）、exact source patches（精确源码补丁）、complete module rewrites（完整模块重写）。使用模型为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.6-Flash。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS 等模型压缩或加速方法，也不涉及轻量网络设计。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。唯一与效率相关的信息是"每解决状态的最便宜成本"（typed repair 最便宜，patching 为其 1.30 倍，rewriting 为其 2.06 倍），以及 10,000 completion tokens 的预算约束，但这属于推理 token 成本而非部署资源指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：BlueprintTrace，包含 142 个受控失败案例（controlled failures），带有完整的接受与拒绝修复轨迹（accepted and rejected repair trajectories）。评价指标：解决的失败状态数量（solved states）、每解决状态的成本（cost per solved state）、在 10,000 completion tokens 预算内的覆盖率（coverage）。实验设置：在匹配的 source、feedback、model、budget 条件下比较三种接口，每个状态和接口各一个 episode。

Experiments: 主要结果：在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上，三种接口解决的局部化失败数量几乎相同；typed repair 每解决状态成本最低（patching 1.30x，rewriting 2.06x）；在 10,000 tokens 内 typed repair 几乎达到其最终覆盖率，而两种 free-form 接口明显落后。在 Qwen3.6-Flash 上，解决的状态更少，但 typed repair 仍最便宜，且在 proof-authoring 状态上领先，并重复了局部化模式。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，无法提供遥感目标检测或轻量化方面的任何信息。摘要未说明模型规模、推理效率、部署约束等。该工作属于形式化验证/LLM 推理领域，与遥感卫星在轨智能无交集。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能间接相关的思路是：论文中"typed edits 比 free-form 更高效"的结论体现了"约束搜索空间以提升效率"的思想，这与轻量化中"通过结构化约束（如结构化剪枝、量化感知训练）降低搜索/优化成本"有一定类比价值，但属于非常间接的启发。

Abstract: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled failures with complete accepted and rejected repair trajectories. We compare typed edits, exact source patches, and complete module rewrites under matched source, feedback, model, and budget, one episode per state and interface. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the three interfaces solve almost the same number of the benchmark's localized failures. Typed repair is the cheapest per solved state (patching is 1.30x as expensive, rewriting 2.06x), and within 10,000 completion tokens per task it reaches almost all of its final coverage, while both free-form interfaces are well behind. A second model, Qwen3.6-Flash, solves fewer states but keeps typed repair cheapest, puts it ahead on the proof-authoring states, and repeats the localized pattern.

</details>


### [242] [ConMem: Contribution-Aware Memory for Long-Horizon Manufacturing Inspection Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28126)
*Bingchen Liu,Yuanyuan Fang,Lei Liu,Guangyuan Dong,Xing Fu,Yuanyuan Gao,Shuyue Wei,Xin Li,Xiangtian Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ConMem，一种面向LLM辅助设备检测的贡献感知记忆框架，通过Shapley式贡献估计筛选高价值检测日志，在受限记忆预算下保留早期风险信号。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文面向钢铁设备检测（steel-equipment inspection）场景，属于工业设备维护领域，与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测无直接关系。虽然涉及"检测"（inspection）和"轻量化"（减少输入token、降低响应时间），但这里的检测是设备故障诊断而非目标检测（object detection），轻量化是LLM上下文记忆压缩而非模型压缩。属于泛机器学习/LLM应用方法，对遥感在轨目标检测的借鉴价值有限。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM辅助工业设备检测领域。虽然"贡献感知记忆筛选"思想有一定间接启发，但缺乏遥感场景、目标检测任务和模型压缩方法等核心要素，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM辅助的设备检测日志分析与早期风险筛查（human-in-the-loop early-risk screening）。应用场景：钢铁设备长期巡检（long-horizon steel-equipment inspection），跨多次检测周期的异构记录推理。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器，为工业检测日志文本数据。目标类别：设备故障/退化信号（如密封磨损seal-wear），非视觉目标。

Model architecture: ConMem框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 功能证据单元分割（functional evidence unit segmentation），将检测日志切分为功能角色感知的语义单元；(2) Shapley式贡献估计（Shapley-style estimation），评估每个记忆单元对下游诊断的贡献；(3) 受限记忆预算下的高价值证据保留（retain high-value evidence under constrained memory budget）。整体基于LLM（8K-context LLM baseline）构建RAG系统。

Lightweight method: 并非传统模型轻量化方法（无剪枝pruning、量化quantization、知识蒸馏knowledge distillation、NAS）。其"轻量化"体现在：通过贡献感知的记忆筛选，将输入LLM的token数量平均减少88.2%，响应时间降低86.6%。这是一种数据/上下文层面的压缩，而非模型参数或计算层面的压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅报告了响应时间降低86.6%和输入token减少88.2%。由于依赖LLM（8K-context），计算开销较大，不适用于星上/边缘部署场景。摘要未说明具体硬件平台。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：真实世界设备检测日志数据集（real-world dataset），摘要未说明具体数据集名称和规模。评价指标：QA准确率（76.0%）、输入token数量减少比例（88.2%）、响应时间降低比例（86.6%）。消融实验验证了功能角色感知分割和贡献估计的有效性。

Experiments: ConMem在真实数据集上达到76.0% QA准确率，超过最强直接对比基线。相比naive 8K-context LLM基线，平均输入token减少88.2%，响应时间降低86.6%。消融实验表明功能角色感知分割和基于贡献的价值评估有助于优先识别弱退化信号。实际部署验证ConMem在三个检测周期中保留了弱早期信号，提供早期密封磨损预警。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于工业设备检测领域；(2) 依赖LLM，计算资源需求大，不具备在轨部署可行性；(3) 摘要未说明模型规模、推理延迟的具体数值、硬件平台；(4) 未涉及视觉目标检测任务；(5) 数据集为文本日志，非遥感影像；(6) 轻量化仅体现在上下文压缩，非模型压缩。

Ideas for my research: (1) "贡献感知的样本筛选"思想可迁移：在遥感目标检测中，可借鉴Shapley式贡献估计来筛选对模型训练或推理最有价值的样本/特征通道，辅助剪枝或蒸馏时的重要性评估；(2) "受限预算下的信息保留"思路：在星上存储/带宽受限条件下，可借鉴其"在有限预算内保留高价值信息"的框架，用于在轨数据筛选与回传决策；(3) 弱信号优先保留策略：类似其保留早期弱退化信号的做法，在遥感小目标检测中可考虑对低置信度但高价值的小目标信号进行优先保留和上报。总体借鉴价值有限，属于间接启发。

Abstract: Long-horizon steel-equipment inspection requires reasoning over heterogeneous records accumulated across repeated inspection cycles. Existing retrieval-augmented generation systems treat historical logs as a static corpus and retain records without estimating their diagnostic value, failing to report early risk. To this end, we propose ConMem, a contribution-aware memory framework for LLM-assisted equipment inspection, supporting a human-in-the-loop early-risk screening system. Specifically, our ConMem first segments inspection logs into functional evidence units, then estimates each memory unit's contribution to downstream diagnosis through a Shapley-style estimation, and finally retains high-value evidence under a constrained memory budget. In experiments, we evaluate ConMem on real-world dataset and ConMem achieves 76.0% QA accuracy, exceeding the strongest directly comparable baseline. Relative to the naive 8K-context LLM baselines, it reduces the average number of input tokens by 88.2% and response time by 86.6%. Ablation studies also show that the functional-role-aware segmentation and contribution-based valuation are helping prioritize weak degradation signals for targeted field inspection. Practical deployments further confirm that ConMem retains the weak early signal across three inspection cycles, providing an early-stage seal-wear alert targeted for on-site inspectors.

</details>


### [243] [AgenticASR: Refining Speech Recognition in Real-World Scenarios via an Agentic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28175)
*Zixuan Jiang,Binghao Qiang,Jiaying Chi,Yanqiao Zhu,Kai Yu,Xie Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR)，一种面向语音转写文本的"音频到干净文本"任务框架，通过 ASR–Refiner 架构在流式语音中持续修正输出文本，去除口误、重复和自纠正，并配套发布双语评测基准 AASR-Bench。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1分）。该论文属于自动语音识别（ASR）与自然语言处理领域，研究对象是语音转写文本的清洗与修正，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关；也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉任务；更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署等轻量化/部署技术。仅"流式持续推理 + 质量-延迟权衡"这一概念与实时推理有极弱的抽象关联，但整体与本研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于语音识别/自然语言处理领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。仅当对"流式持续推理与质量-延迟权衡"这一抽象方法论感兴趣时，可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：自动语音识别（ASR）后的文本清洗与意图保持（spoken-to-written text normalization）。应用场景：语音转写、对话系统、流式语音处理。传感器类型：音频/语音信号（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：语音中的口误（disfluencies）、重复（repetitions）、假起始（false starts）、自纠正（self-corrections）。

Model architecture: ASR–Refiner 架构：由前端 ASR 模型（可替换多种 ASR front end）与 Refiner 模块组成。Refiner 在音频持续到达时，反复变换一个有界的 active context，并替换其对应的输出 span，实现流式持续输出与修订。摘要未说明 Refiner 的具体网络结构（如是否基于 Transformer、LLM 等）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速方法。仅讨论了 online vs offline inference 的 quality–latency trade-off，属于推理策略层面的权衡，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗、延迟等部署指标，也未涉及星上/边缘部署。仅提及 online 与 offline 推理存在质量-延迟权衡（quality–latency trade-off），但未给出具体数值。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：AASR-Bench，一个双语（bilingual）评测基准，采用细粒度原子评分规则（fine-grained atomic rubrics）。评价指标：AASR-Bench 分数；另有人类-AI 一致性研究（human–AI agreement study），验证 rubric 评分与独立专家评估的一致性。摘要未说明具体语音数据集规模、语言构成及基线 ASR 前端细节。

Experiments: 在多个 ASR front end 上，AgenticASR 均取得最高的 AASR-Bench 分数。消融实验（ablation）表征了 Refiner 容量（capacity）、上下文长度（context length）以及 online vs offline 推理的 quality–latency trade-off。摘要未给出具体数值对比。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴。2. 摘要未说明 Refiner 的模型规模、推理延迟、计算开销等关键工程指标。3. 摘要未说明 AASR-Bench 的规模、语言覆盖范围及评测细节。4. 摘要未讨论模型在资源受限设备上的部署可行性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管领域不同，但可抽象借鉴两点：1) "流式持续输出 + 有界上下文修订"（continual emission and revision over streams）的思想，可类比于在轨卫星对连续遥感图像流的实时目标检测中，如何利用历史帧信息对当前检测结果进行持续修正；2) "quality–latency trade-off" 的在线/离线推理权衡分析框架，可迁移到星上轻量化检测模型在"精度 vs 推理延迟/能耗"之间的权衡设计。但这两点均为方法论层面的弱类比，不构成直接技术借鉴。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved substantial gains in transcription accuracy, yet verbatim transcription does not necessarily produce readily usable text. It retains fillers, repetitions, false starts, and self-corrections that increase reading effort, obscure the speaker's final intent, and propagate unresolved or abandoned content to downstream tasks. Existing spoken-to-written methods process completed audio or transcripts but cannot revise emitted text when later speech changes how preceding content should be interpreted. We therefore formulate Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR), an audio-to-clean-text task that removes disfluencies, resolves self-corrections, and normalizes written form while preserving the speaker's final intent. AgenticASR implements this task through an ASR--Refiner architecture that repeatedly transforms a bounded active context and replaces its corresponding output span as audio arrives. This enables continual emission and revision over streams of arbitrary duration. We also introduce AASR-Bench, a bilingual benchmark with fine-grained atomic rubrics. Across multiple ASR front ends, AgenticASR attains the highest AASR-Bench scores among evaluated systems. A human--AI agreement study shows that rubric-based judgments align with independent expert assessments. Ablations characterize Refiner capacity, context length, and the quality--latency trade-off between online and offline inference. Together, these results establish AgenticASR as a practical framework for intent-preserving clean transcription during ongoing speech. Code, AASR-Bench, and a demo will be released at https://github.com/AnXMuy/AgenticASR.

</details>


### [244] [Old Tricks, New Models: How Simple Image Transformations Break Modern AI-based Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28187)
*Marco Alecci,Francesco Marchiori,Iyiola Emmanuel Olatunji,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Jacques Klein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对三个商业多模态内容审核API进行黑盒鲁棒性评估，发现简单的图像变换即可绕过这些基于大模型的审核系统，指出其不能作为独立安全边界。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。论文主题是"content moderation"（内容审核/安全过滤），属于多模态大模型安全与鲁棒性评估方向，与遥感、卫星、在轨目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。唯一可借鉴的是其"黑盒鲁棒性评估"方法论和"图像变换导致决策翻转"的观察，但这与遥感目标检测的鲁棒性研究关联也较间接。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为内容审核系统的鲁棒性评估，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。仅方法论层面的黑盒鲁棒性评估思路有极有限的间接参考价值，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图像内容审核（image moderation）鲁棒性评估；应用场景：在线内容安全过滤；传感器类型：自然图像（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：有害内容类别（harm categories），包括多模态内容和自残（self-harm）等。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。研究对象是三个商业多模态审核API（基于large foundation models），采用黑盒评估方式，不涉及内部网络结构设计。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及轻量化方法。论文不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 使用了多个数据集（datasets），涵盖多个harm categories；评估了七种简单的model-agnostic图像变换（如color inversion、grayscale conversion）；指标包括perceptual-similarity constraints和transformation intensities下的决策变化率（unsafe-to-safe decision changes）。具体数据集名称和指标数值摘要未说明。

Experiments: 主要发现：(1) 三个商业审核服务均可被无需梯度、替代模型或目标系统知识的廉价图像变换绕过；(2) 即使是固定的变换（如颜色反转、灰度化）也能在保持人类可识别内容的同时诱导unsafe-to-safe的决策翻转；(3) 鲁棒性在不同数据集和harm categories间差异显著，多模态内容和自残类别表现出明显脆弱性。结论是基础模型API不能替代传统审核分类器作为独立安全边界。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显局限包括：仅评估三个商业API（黑盒），未涉及开源模型或自建模型；仅测试图像变换类攻击，未覆盖对抗攻击、语义级攻击等；未讨论防御策略的具体实现。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的借鉴点有限，但可考虑：(1) 其"黑盒鲁棒性评估"方法论可迁移到遥感目标检测模型——评估轻量化后的遥感检测模型在图像变换（如光照变化、噪声、压缩伪影）下的鲁棒性退化；(2) "简单变换导致决策翻转"的观察提示：在轨部署的轻量化模型可能对卫星成像链路中的色彩/灰度变化更敏感，需在轻量化过程中考虑鲁棒性约束；(3) 其"分层部署"（layered pipeline）思想可类比为星上多级检测流水线设计。

Abstract: While automated content-moderation systems have become essential for screening harmful content at scale, conventional task-specific classifiers often provide limited policy cov- erage and contextual understanding. Recently, commercial multimodal moderation APIs built on large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of providing broader and more capable safety filters. In this work, we analyze whether this shift also yields more robust image moderation. We conduct a large-scale black-box evaluation on three established commercial image-moderation services and compare their robustness. By evaluating seven simple, model-agnostic image transformations across multiple providers, datasets, harm categories, perceptual-similarity constraints, and transformation intensities, we find that: (1) all three commercial services can be bypassed using inexpensive image transformations that require no gradients, surrogate models, or knowledge of the target system; (2) even fixed transformations such as color inversion and grayscale conversion induce unsafe-to-safe decision changes while preserving content that remains recognizable to humans; (3) their robustness varies substantially across datasets and harm categories, with multimodal content and self-harm exhibiting pronounced vulnerabilities. This yields the conclusion that replacing conventional moderation classifiers with foundation-model-based APIs does not, by itself, provide a reliable security boundary. Such systems must be evaluated under realistic transformations and deployed as one component of a layered moderation pipeline rather than as standalone safety filters.

</details>


### [245] [Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28227)
*Hanzhang Zhou,Panrong Tong,Xu Zhang,Quyu Kong,Chenglin Cai,Tianyu Xia,Gongjie Zhang,Jianan Zhang,Long Li,Long Chen,Lei Wang,Gaole Dai,Pengxiang Li,Liangyu Chen,Yue Wang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Qwen-UI-Agent 是一个面向真实设备的多平台 GUI 智能体，统一了 GUI 操作与 CLI 执行，通过 AutoResearch 数据飞轮和在线 RL 实现长程任务与跨平台工作流，在移动端、桌面端和浏览器端基准上取得 SOTA 性能。

Research relevance: 1 分，基本无关。该论文聚焦 GUI agent（图形用户界面智能体），面向移动端、桌面端、浏览器和 DeepSearch 等数字设备交互场景，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关。论文不涉及任何遥感目标检测任务，也不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS 或边缘/星上部署。虽然文中提到 "lightweight harness layer"，但这是指智能体系统的轻量级调度层，与神经网络模型压缩无关。

Reading priority: 1 分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于 GUI agent 领域的工作，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：GUI agent（图形用户界面智能体），涵盖 mobile use、computer use、browser use、DeepSearch 四类环境。应用场景为数字设备交互与自动化操作，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不涉及。目标类别：不涉及。

Model architecture: Qwen-UI-Agent 采用统一 action space，将 GUI 操作与 CLI 执行交错组合，并在单个模型 turn 内生成 batched actions。包含一个 lightweight harness layer 支持 proactive service initiation 和跨移动端/桌面端的有状态工作流。训练采用 AutoResearch 风格的数据飞轮（用 agent 构建任务和环境、诊断失败、规划后续迭代）以及在线 RL，支持超过 100 turns 的长轨迹训练，使用超过 10,000 个并发环境加速 rollout。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提到的 "lightweight harness layer" 是指智能体系统的轻量级调度/编排层，用于支持 proactive service initiation 和有状态工作流，并非神经网络模型压缩方法（如 pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS）。论文未涉及任何模型轻量化或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文面向的是数字设备 GUI 交互场景，不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性指标。虽然提到 "lightweight harness layer"，但未给出任何部署相关的量化指标。

Datasets and metrics: 评估基准：MobileWorld（82.1%）、MobileWorld-Real（92.2%）、AndroidDaily（97.5%）、OSWorld-Verified（79.5%）、OSWorld-v2（40.0% partial-progress）、WebArena（73.6%）、ScreenSpot-Pro（81.5%）。对比模型包括 Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol。这些均为 GUI agent 基准，与遥感目标检测数据集（如 DOTA、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10、SSDD、SAR 数据集等）无关。

Experiments: 在移动端基准上取得 SOTA（MobileWorld 82.1%、MobileWorld-Real 92.2%、AndroidDaily 97.5%），在桌面端和浏览器端任务上与前沿模型（Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol）相比具有竞争力。无任何遥感相关实验。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但就本研究方向而言，该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化完全无关，无可借鉴的遥感实验、数据集或部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能间接相关的思路是：论文中 AutoResearch 风格的数据飞轮（用 agent 自动构建任务、诊断失败、规划迭代）和在线 RL 训练范式，在方法论层面或许可以启发遥感模型的自适应训练或数据增强策略，但这属于泛机器学习训练范式，与轻量化本身无关。总体而言，不建议从该论文中提取遥感或轻量化相关技术。

Abstract: GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent spanning mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. Qwen-UI-Agent combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime. Its unified action space interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions in a single model turn. An AutoResearch-style data flywheel uses agents to construct tasks and environments, diagnose failures, and plan subsequent iterations. Online RL supports training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns, with over 10,000 concurrent environments accelerating rollout. A lightweight harness layer supports proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer.
  Across a broad suite of evaluations, Qwen-UI-Agent sets state-of-the-art performance on mobile-use benchmarks while delivering competitive performance on computer- and browser-use tasks against frontier models, including Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol. On mobile use, it achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use, it achieves 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified and a 40.0% partial-progress score on OSWorld-v2. On browser use and GUI grounding, it achieves 73.6% on WebArena and 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.

</details>


### [246] [CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28236)
*Sina Heydari,Amirreza Abbasi,Mohsen Hooshmand,Majid Ramezani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），通过联合优化对比学习和重构目标来精炼预训练BERT的句子嵌入，使其对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等语义保持型扰动具有不变性。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文属于自然语言处理（NLP）领域，研究句子嵌入的扰动不变性学习，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。虽然标题中有"lightweight"一词，但这里的"轻量"指的是模型结构上的轻量设计（对比去噪自编码器），并非面向边缘/星上部署的模型压缩或加速方法。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于NLP句子嵌入领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。仅在"扰动不变性特征学习"这一方法论层面有极有限的间接启发。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：句子嵌入表示学习（sentence representation learning）；应用场景：NLP文本表示；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 基于预训练BERT，引入对比去噪自编码器（Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder, CDAE），联合优化对比学习目标（contrastive objective）和重构目标（reconstruction objective），学习对语义保持型扰动（synonym substitution, masking, word dropout）具有不变性的嵌入表示。

Lightweight method: 摘要中"lightweight"指CDAE框架本身的轻量设计（在预训练BERT基础上增加轻量对比去噪模块），并非模型压缩方法。未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或边缘部署等轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。且该任务为NLP文本嵌入，与星上部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标为嵌入相似度（embedding similarity），对比基线包括原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE。使用多种扰动策略（perturbation strategies）及不同强度进行评测。

Experiments: 实验结果表明CDAE在多种扰动策略下能持续保持更高的嵌入相似度，且随着扰动增强，相比BERT和SimCSE的提升更加明显，验证了扰动不变性学习对提升句子嵌入稳定性的有效性。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。主要缺口：1）未涉及任何遥感/视觉任务；2）未提供模型复杂度、推理速度等部署指标；3）仅关注文本嵌入的鲁棒性，与目标检测无关；4）未说明在真实下游任务（如检索、分类）上的性能验证。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测方向基本无关，但"扰动不变性学习"（perturbation-invariant learning）的思想有一定启发：1）在遥感目标检测中，可借鉴"对输入扰动保持特征不变"的思路，增强模型对光照变化、云遮挡、传感器噪声等遥感图像扰动的鲁棒性；2）对比学习+重构的联合优化框架可迁移到遥感小目标检测的特征表示学习中，提升特征判别力；3）"轻量去噪模块"的设计思路可启发在检测骨干网络上附加轻量鲁棒性增强模块。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embedding remain sensitive to semantic preserving textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embedding by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objective to learn perturbation-invariant representation. We evaluate the proposed framework using multiple perturbation strategies with varying strengths and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbations, with the improvements becoming more pronounced as framework effectively enhances representation stability while preserving semantic information, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE

</details>


### [247] [AI and Authenticity in Islamic Research: A Critical Evaluation of Generative AI Reliability, Hallucination, and Source Fidelity in Quranic, Hadith, and Fiqh Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28237)
*Muhammad Sajjad Akbar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估六种主流生成式AI系统在伊斯兰宗教知识问答中的准确性、真实性、幻觉率与可靠性，属于生成式AI在宗教领域的实证评估研究。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关。论文主题为生成式AI在伊斯兰宗教知识领域的可靠性评估，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能，也不涉及目标检测或任何模型压缩/轻量化方法。属于泛AI应用评估类研究，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向无任何技术交集。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为生成式AI在伊斯兰宗教知识领域的可靠性评估，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，无任何技术借鉴价值，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：生成式AI（LLM）在宗教知识问答中的可靠性评估。应用场景：伊斯兰宗教教育、教法咨询、学术研究。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用。摘要未涉及任何视觉或遥感任务。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。仅提及"six leading generative AI systems"（六种主流生成式AI系统），但未列出具体模型名称（如GPT、Claude、Gemini等），也未描述任何网络结构或模型设计细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法。不包含pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：50个真实世界的开放式伊斯兰问题，涵盖Qur'anic interpretation（古兰经解读）、Hadith（圣训）、Fiqh（教法）、ethics（伦理）、pastoral advice（牧灵建议）及Madhhab-sensitive topics（教法学派敏感话题）。数据采集自澳大利亚和英国的参与者。评价指标：采用混合方法框架，评估domain accuracy（领域准确性）、citation verification（引文验证）、hallucinations（幻觉）、jurisprudential consistency（教法一致性）、uncertainty handling（不确定性处理）、source provenance（来源溯源）和geographical variation（地域差异）。

Experiments: 研究回答四个研究问题：(1) AI生成回答在主要伊斯兰知识领域的准确性与真实性；(2) AI系统产生幻觉、不完整引用或不可验证宗教参考的程度；(3) 模型处理教法分歧、Madhhab多样性和不确定性的一致性；(4) 当前AI系统是否足以用于宗教指导、伊斯兰教育和学术研究。主要结论：生成式AI作为入门级伊斯兰学习的辅助工具是有价值的，但在未经权威原始文献和合格学者验证的情况下，不应被视为宗教裁决或伊斯兰研究的权威来源。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，不存在可直接借鉴的技术内容。摘要本身也未说明其局限性（如样本量、模型版本、评估者偏差等）。从方法论角度看，其"幻觉评估"和"引用验证"框架对AI可靠性研究有一定参考价值，但与遥感目标检测轻量化无关。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无可借鉴的技术想法。唯一可能的间接启发是：该论文的"幻觉评估与引用验证"方法论框架，在概念上类似于模型部署前的可靠性验证思路——即轻量化模型在星上部署前也需要评估其在边缘场景下的输出可靠性（如检测置信度校准、误检率），但这一类比非常间接，技术层面无直接可复现内容。

Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used by Muslims for religious guidance, Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith explanation, jurisprudential rulings, and Islamic education. Despite its growing adoption, there is limited empirical evidence on whether current AI systems provide authentic, verifiable, and trustworthy Islamic knowledge suitable for high-trust religious contexts. This study evaluates six leading generative AI systems using fifty realistic open-ended Islamic questions covering Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith, Fiqh, ethics, pastoral advice, and Madhhab-sensitive topics. Responses were collected under real-world conditions from participants in Australia and the United Kingdom and analysed using a mixed-method framework examining domain accuracy, citation verification, hallucinations, jurisprudential consistency, uncertainty handling, source provenance, and geographical variation.
  The study addresses four research questions: (1) How accurate and authentic are AI-generated responses across major Islamic knowledge domains? (2) To what extent do AI systems produce hallucinations, incomplete citations, or unverifiable religious references? (3) How consistently do models handle jurisprudential disagreement, Madhhab diversity, and uncertainty? (4) Are current AI systems sufficiently reliable for religious guidance, Islamic education, and scholarly research?
  Overall, current generative AI systems are valuable as assistive tools for introductory Islamic learning but should not be treated as authoritative sources for religious rulings or Islamic research without verification against authenticated primary sources and qualified scholarly expertise. This study provides one of the first comprehensive empirical evaluations of AI reliability within Islamic knowledge, offering practical guidance for researchers, educators, AI developers, and the wider Muslim community.

</details>


### [248] [Operationally Guided Placement-Aware Learning for Industrial Online 3D Bin Packing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28257)
*Dheeraj Poolavaram,Aanchal Rajesh Chugh,Sebastian Dorn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OPAL框架，通过操作引导的候选生成器（OG-EMS）、xLSTM位置编码器和轻量级循环核心，解决工业在线三维装箱问题（3D-BPP），在BED-BPP基准上提升空间利用率。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于物流与工业码垛领域的在线三维装箱问题（3D-BPP），与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关。虽然论文中提到了"lightweight recurrent core"（轻量级循环核心），但这只是模型内部的一个轻量模块设计，并非面向边缘/星上部署的模型压缩或加速方法，与"轻量化"研究方向的关联非常有限。因此属于泛机器学习/强化学习方法，弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于物流/工业装箱领域的强化学习方法，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。虽然存在少量通用方法论（如候选生成、xLSTM编码器）可参考，但投入产出比很低，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：在线三维装箱问题（online 3D-BPP），即物流和工业码垛场景下的空间规划与决策。应用场景：物流、工业palletizing（托盘码垛）。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器。目标类别：三维物品装箱/码放，非遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: OPAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1) Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS)——操作引导的空闲最大空间候选生成器，在每个自由空间区域内评估多个锚点，优先选择低、支撑良好、紧凑且空间多样化的放置位置；(2) 基于xLSTM的Placement Encoder——建模几何和操作候选属性之间的依赖关系；(3) 轻量级循环核心（lightweight recurrent core）——将嵌入与当前物品和托盘状态结合，对可行动作进行排序。策略使用proximal policy optimization (PPO)训练。

Lightweight method: 摘要中仅提到"lightweight recurrent core"（轻量级循环核心），这是模型内部的一个轻量模块设计选择，用于降低循环网络的复杂度。但摘要未说明具体的模型压缩方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等），也未涉及FLOPs、参数量、延迟等部署指标。因此，轻量化信息不足，且该"轻量化"并非面向遥感卫星在轨部署场景。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT、实时推理约束、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然提到"robust inference-time performance"，但未给出具体延迟、参数量、FLOPs、显存等量化指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：BED-BPP benchmark（工业在线三维装箱基准）。评价指标：mean space utilization（平均空间利用率），达到0.49。消融实验显示：操作引导的候选生成带来15.1%的提升，学习排序带来6.3%的提升。

Experiments: 在BED-BPP基准上，OPAL达到0.49的平均空间利用率。消融实验表明：(1) 操作引导的候选生成（OG-EMS）贡献了15.1%的性能提升；(2) 学习排序（learned ranking）贡献了6.3%的提升。摘要未说明与其他基线方法的详细对比结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向基本无关，其方法（3D-BPP装箱）与目标检测任务在问题定义、输入输出、评价指标上均无直接关联。轻量化仅体现在模型内部模块设计层面，未涉及任何面向部署的模型压缩或加速技术。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测方向弱相关，但仍有少量可借鉴的通用思路：(1) "操作引导的候选生成"思想——在遥感目标检测中可类比为"先验引导的候选区域生成"，例如利用遥感目标的几何先验（如舰船的长宽比、飞机的方向性）来引导anchor或proposal生成，减少无效候选；(2) xLSTM作为序列编码器——可借鉴xLSTM结构用于遥感时序数据（如多时相变化检测）或旋转框角度序列建模；(3) 轻量级循环核心的设计思路——在轻量化检测头中可参考其将嵌入与状态结合的低复杂度循环结构。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: The online three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is a longstanding challenge in logistics and industrial palletizing. Recent learning-based methods use a learned policy to select among feasible candidate placements. Performance depends on the candidate generator and representation, especially in industrial settings where packings must be space-efficient, stable, compact, and balanced. However, prior work has mainly optimized the policy, while candidate generation and representation remain largely geometry-driven. We address this gap with OPAL, an operationally guided placement-aware learning framework for industrial online 3D-BPP which combines an Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS), an operational representation for each candidate placement, and a masked ranking policy trained with proximal policy optimization. OG-EMS evaluates multiple anchors within each free-space region and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements. An xLSTM-based Placement Encoder models dependencies among geometric and operational candidate attributes, while a lightweight recurrent core combines the resulting embeddings with the current item and pallet state to rank feasible actions. On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.

</details>


### [249] [LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Constraint Model Reformulation to Improve Solver Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28268)
*Kostis Michailidis,Dimos Tsouros,Nguyen Dang,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）通过进化框架自动对约束满足问题（CSP）的声明式模型进行性能导向的重构优化，提出基于最大边际相关性（MMR）的Profile-Diverse Retention（PDR）策略来保留行为多样化的历史尝试，从而提升模型重构后的求解速度。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于组合优化问题（combinatorial problems）中的约束模型自动重构，属于运筹优化与LLM自动化方法设计（Automatic Heuristic Design）领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等任何遥感相关场景，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等模型轻量化方法。唯一可能的间接关联是"性能优化"这一抽象概念，但与本课题的具体技术栈完全脱节。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于组合优化与LLM自动化建模领域。除非对"LLM驱动的自动化搜索框架"这一抽象方法论感兴趣，否则不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：约束满足问题（Constraint Satisfaction Problem, CSP）的声明式模型自动重构与性能优化。应用场景：工业组合优化应用中的约束建模与求解。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 核心框架为基于LLM的进化式模型重构框架，借鉴Automatic Heuristic Design（AHD）思想。LLM作为proposer提出候选模型重构方案，通过后端solver验证和基准测试。提出Profile-Diverse Retention（PDR）策略，利用Maximal Marginal Relevance（MMR）对实例级运行时向量（instance-level runtime vectors）进行行为多样性保留。摘要未说明具体LLM型号、solver类型或网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及模型轻量化方法。本文的"性能优化"针对的是约束模型的求解效率（runtime speedup），而非神经网络模型的压缩或加速。不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。其优化目标是CSP求解器的held-out speedup，与神经网络推理部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CSPLib中的8个标准约束满足问题（eight CSPLib problems）。评价指标：held-out speedup（留出集加速比），采用基于验证集的最终模型选择（validation-based final model selection）。摘要未说明具体问题名称、求解器类型或实验硬件环境。

Experiments: 主要实验结果：(i) 迭代式模型重构可产生显著的held-out speedup；(ii) 保持保留上下文多样性的策略优于仅保留最近或最快尝试的策略；(iii) 基于验证集的选择能提升所有策略的held-out speedup。摘要未说明具体加速比数值、对比的baseline策略细节或消融实验设置。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但从研究角度看：(1) 仅针对CSPLib的8个问题，泛化性有限；(2) 依赖LLM的生成能力，重构质量受模型能力制约；(3) 未涉及任何视觉/遥感任务，无法直接迁移到目标检测场景；(4) 优化目标是求解器速度而非神经网络推理效率，方法论与本课题技术栈差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 尽管本文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但存在两个可借鉴的抽象思路：(1) 进化式搜索框架（evolutionary framework）的思想——如果未来做NAS（Neural Architecture Search）或自动剪枝策略搜索，可以借鉴"LLM作为proposer + 验证反馈循环"的自动化搜索范式；(2) 多样性保留策略（diversity retention）——在搜索轻量化模型架构或压缩策略时，保留行为多样化的候选方案（而非仅保留性能最优者）可能有助于跳出局部最优。但这些仅为方法论层面的间接启发，技术细节无法直接复用。

Abstract: Combinatorial problems appear in numerous industrial applications. A common approach is to formulate these problems as declarative constraint models that can subsequently be compiled to and solved by a range of back-end solvers. Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce correct models from natural language, but even a correct model can be expensive to solve because performance remains sensitive to modelling choices. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can automate performance-oriented model reformulation. Inspired by Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), we use an evolutionary framework in which an LLM proposes candidate reformulations that are verified and benchmarked against the user-defined baseline model. We compare AHD-adapted search strategies that control which prior attempts, instructions, and measured feedback enter each prompt. Existing retention strategies prioritize recency or performance, but do not explicitly diversify the context. To cover this gap, we introduce Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR), which applies Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to instance-level runtime vectors to retain behaviourally diverse attempts. We systematically evaluate the strategies on eight CSPLib problems using validation-based final model selection. The results show that: (i) iterative reformulation can produce substantial held-out speedups; (ii) strategies that keep the retained context diverse outperform those that retain only recent or the fastest attempts; and (iii) validation-based selection improves the held-out speedup of every strategy.

</details>


### [250] [MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28272)
*Rong Wu,Daocheng Fu,Licheng Wen,Xuemeng Yang,Shu Zou,Jianbiao Mei,Yuxin Wang,Hairong Zhang,Yu Yang,Tao Hu,Cong Zhang,Botian Shi,Pinlong Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MemHarness框架，让LLM智能体基于当前情境主动重构而非机械重放检索到的历史经验，通过GRPO端到端训练提升决策能力。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）智能体的记忆增强与经验重构机制，属于自然语言处理与强化学习领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、地球观测、目标检测或模型轻量化等任何相关主题。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于LLM智能体/强化学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体决策任务（memory-augmented agent）；应用场景：ALFWorld和WebShop等文本交互环境；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: MemHarness框架包含一个统一的policy model，在每个决策步骤对检索到的历史经验进行critique和reconstruction，生成context-grounded guidance后再执行动作。训练采用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）进行端到端优化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等均未提及。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 实验在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准环境上进行，对比了纯RL（pure RL）和静态记忆增强（static memory-augmented）基线方法，并评估了out-of-distribution (OOD)场景下的鲁棒性。

Experiments: MemHarness在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著优于纯RL和静态记忆增强基线，在OOD场景下表现出较强的鲁棒性。分析表明重构目标不仅能防止negative transfer，还能在训练中作为latent guidance，从根本上提升智能体的内在推理能力。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。但可推断：论文仅验证了文本交互环境（ALFWorld、WebShop），未涉及视觉或多模态场景；未报告计算开销、推理效率等工程指标；重构机制对policy model的额外计算成本未量化。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但"基于当前情境重构而非机械重放经验"的思想在概念层面有一定启发：在遥感在轨目标检测中，若模型具备根据当前观测场景（如不同光照、云层遮挡、传感器状态）动态调整检测策略或特征提取方式的能力，可能提升泛化性。但这种借鉴非常间接，且论文本身不提供任何可复用的技术细节用于视觉检测或模型压缩。

Abstract: Retrieving past experiences has become a common strategy to enhance large language model agents. However, most existing memory-augmented agents treat retrieved experiences as static records to be replayed verbatim, injecting them into the context regardless of whether they align with the agent's current situation. This ``replay'' paradigm ignores the gap between the abstract, general nature of stored experience and the concrete, ever-changing states encountered at decision time, frequently causing negative transfer. In contrast, humans rarely recall past experiences verbatim; instead, they reorganize and adapt retrieved memories to fit the present context. Inspired by this, we propose MemHarness, a framework that equips LLM agents to actively harness and reconstruct past experiences based on the present context. At each decision step, a unified policy model critiques and reconstructs the retrieved experience conditioned on the current state, producing context-grounded guidance before acting. This reconstructive ability emerges naturally through end-to-end training with GRPO. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that MemHarness substantially outperforms pure RL and static memory-augmented baselines, demonstrating strong robustness in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that this reconstruction objective not only prevents negative transfer but also serves as latent guidance during training, fundamentally improving the agent's intrinsic reasoning capabilities.

</details>


### [251] [Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28287)
*Jens Lehmann,Andrei Aioanei,Sahar Vahdati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Tycho编码智能体系统，将ARC-AGI-3抽象推理任务形式化为参数化确定性Moore机器，通过主动抽象策略在交互中构建、测试、修复或绕过游戏模型，以提升动作效率。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛人工智能/编码智能体领域，聚焦抽象推理与技能获取（ARC-AGI-3基准），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署。仅"action efficiency"和"model construction/repair"概念在方法论层面与高效推理有间接类比意义，但整体与本研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文聚焦ARC-AGI-3抽象推理与编码智能体，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，仅"active abstraction"和"action efficiency"概念有极弱的间接启发意义，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：抽象推理与技能获取（ARC-AGI-3基准），非目标检测。应用场景：游戏规则推断与交互式问题求解。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非视觉目标检测）。

Model architecture: Tycho编码智能体系统，包含：1) 结构化历史分离机制（区分可操作观察与中间动画/关卡完成/游戏结束帧）；2) 自由形式可执行假设模型（free-form executable hypothesis）；3) 四种编排策略（orchestration policies），其中actor-requested delegation策略将模型构建委托给专门的model builder。底层使用Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 5等大语言模型作为推理引擎。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速方法。其"action efficiency"（动作效率）关注的是交互过程中的决策成本而非模型计算开销。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，不报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性指标。其"efficiency"指标为Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE)，衡量的是相对人类动作效率而非计算资源效率。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ARC-AGI-3的25个公开游戏（public games），共183个关卡（levels）。评价指标：Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE)、game-balanced first-run human-replay midrank、scored actions数量。实验设置：每个策略在匹配推理预算（matched inference budgets）下进行一次公开集运行，使用Claude Opus 4.8对比四种编排策略。

Experiments: 主要结果：1) Actor-requested delegation策略获得最高平均RHAE 88.49；2) 使用该策略时，GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡，human-replay midrank分别为98.5和100.0；3) Opus 5比官方人类基线少用61%的scored actions；4) 自动修复（automatic repair）虽能更准确复现观测转换，但RHAE仅83.07，说明"转换匹配"不等于"识别目标"或"改进下一步动作"。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感目标检测和轻量化完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2) 依赖大型闭源LLM（Claude Opus、GPT-5.6），计算成本高，与在轨轻量化需求背道而驰；3) 摘要未说明模型推理延迟、参数量等部署关键指标；4) 实验仅在25个游戏上验证，泛化性有限；5) "active abstraction"概念虽有趣，但缺乏与视觉感知或嵌入式部署的关联。

Ideas for my research: 1) "active abstraction"中"何时构建/修复/使用/绕过模型"的决策思想，可类比到在轨场景中"何时启用轻量模型vs完整模型"的自适应推理策略（如动态路由或early exit）；2) "action efficiency"概念可启发在轨目标检测中减少冗余推理次数、按需触发检测的节能策略；3) 结构化历史分离（区分关键帧与中间帧）的思想可类比遥感视频流中关键帧筛选，减少处理帧数以降低计算负担。但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and game-over frames. From this structured history, an agent can model, test, plan with, repair, or bypass a free-form executable hypothesis.
  In one matched public-set run per policy, we compare four orchestration policies on all 25 public games using Claude Opus 4.8 under matched inference budgets. Actor-requested delegation to a model builder obtains the highest observed mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), 88.49. With this selected policy, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 both reach 100.00 RHAE and complete all 183 levels. Their game-balanced first-run human-replay midranks are 98.5 and 100.0. Opus 5 uses 61% fewer scored actions than the aggregate official human baselines.
  Automatic repair after verification failures produces models that reproduce observed transitions much more accurately, yet reaches only 83.07 RHAE. Transition match indicates whether a simulator reproduces observed dynamics, not whether it has identified the objective or improves the next action. Strong play also requires deciding when to construct, repair, use, or bypass a model. We call this joint problem active abstraction: generating a testable model from costly interaction and deciding when acquiring or using it is worth its cost.

</details>


### [252] [One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28317)
*Cesare Zavattari,Alessandro Tommasi,Giuseppe Prencipe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限审计预算下，单个人类如何审计多个LLM智能体（基于自我报告置信度排序审计），通过两级高斯copula建模有噪声的预算受限检查，并给出置信度校准失效阈值δ*的定量判据。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文主题是LLM智能体审计与人类监督（AI alignment/oversight），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测或遥感场景理解。更不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理或边缘/星上部署。属于泛机器学习/LLM安全领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向无任何直接或间接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM智能体审计与置信度校准，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，无阅读价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体审计策略优化（budgeted noisy inspection）。应用场景：人类监督多个LLM agent，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（对象是LLM agent的置信度报告）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。核心建模工具为两级高斯copula（two-level Gaussian copula），用于刻画审计噪声和agent间相关误差。评估对象为五个open-weight LLM和一个proprietary model（具体名称摘要未说明）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及任何模型压缩或加速方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等均未出现）。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。摘要未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标：核心指标为置信度校准失效阈值δ*（miscalibration threshold），以及审计策略相对随机排序的优劣比较。实验设置：在recorded traces上回放审计策略（replaying policies on recorded traces）验证排序结论。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：(1) 两个先验预期被推翻——δ*随预算缩小而上升；跨家族相关性并不低，共享难度主导而非谱系。(2) 五个open-weight LLM的置信度近乎恒定（operationally useless），点估计位于或超过翻转点但置信区间跨越该点。(3) 一个proprietary model的置信度具有信息量且落在翻转点之下。(4) 给出了"空洞监督"（vacuous oversight）的定量判据。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。但从内容看：该研究聚焦LLM审计与人类监督，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，无可借鉴的遥感/检测/轻量化技术要素。摘要也未提供模型细节、数据集细节或部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：该文关于"置信度校准"与"预算受限下的资源分配"的数学框架（budgeted noisy inspection、miscalibration threshold）在概念层面可类比于"在有限星上算力预算下如何分配检测资源"，但这一类比非常牵强，且不涉及任何遥感目标检测或模型压缩的具体技术，不建议作为参考。

Abstract: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.

</details>


### [253] [PathView-Bench: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Achieve Fine-grained Multiscale Understanding of Pathology Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28318)
*Zongyi Chen,Yu Liang,Jie Lin,Liansheng Wang*
