Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。论文评估了18个代表性MLLM（包括通用型、医学领域、病理专用模型），但未给出这些模型的具体网络结构设计。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。论文核心是基准构建与评估，而非模型压缩或加速。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：PathVU基准，由23个公开病理影像数据集构建，包含61,673张图像、308,070个样本、7,253,526个标注，覆盖28个器官。包含14个VQA-style任务。评价指标：程序化评分（programmatic scoring），涵盖区域定位（region localization）、视觉识别（visual recognition）、数量估计（quantity estimation）、空间推理（spatial reasoning）、上下文不足判断（insufficient-context judgment）。两种视野：Region FOV（高分辨率局部区域）和Slide FOV（宏观全切片视图）。

Experiments: 评估了18个代表性MLLM（通用型、医学领域、病理专用），发现即使在先进模型上，多尺度病理图像的细粒度视觉任务仍存在显著局限。摘要未给出具体数值对比结果。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于医学影像领域。2. 摘要未说明评估模型的具体性能数值、计算开销或部署指标。3. 基准聚焦于病理图像，其多尺度视觉理解评估框架难以直接迁移到遥感场景。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但其"多尺度视觉理解评估"思想有一定启发：1. 可借鉴其"程序化评分"（programmatic scoring）思路，为遥感小目标检测设计确定性、可复现的评估协议，避免主观评分。2. 其Region FOV与Slide FOV的双视野设计，可类比遥感中的"局部高分辨率区域"与"全局场景"多尺度理解，对遥感多尺度目标检测的评估框架设计有参考价值。3. 其"上下文不足判断"（insufficient-context judgment）任务思想，可启发遥感在轨检测中"信息不足时主动判断"的可靠性设计。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to analyze pathology images. However, dominant multimodal benchmarks in pathology mainly score final diagnostic answers, captions, or reports. These evaluations provide limited insight into whether a model understands the multiscale visual content needed for pathology reasoning and decision-making. We introduce PathVU, a vision-anchored benchmark for fine-grained and multiscale visual understanding in computational pathology. Built from 23 public pathology imaging datasets with human-supervised labels and spatial annotations, PathVU evaluates MLLM understanding in two fields of view: Region FOV for high-resolution local regions and Slide FOV for macro whole-slide views. By converting raw annotations into deterministic task targets, PathVU enables programmatic scoring of region localization, visual recognition, quantity estimation, spatial reasoning, and insufficient-context judgment. The benchmark contains 14 VQA-style tasks, 61,673 images, and 308,070 samples across 28 organs and 7,253,526 annotations. Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.

</details>


### [254] [Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28330)
*Mingdai Yang,Shicheng Fan,Kejing Yu,Duohao Wang,Li Sun,Hao Peng,Philip S. Yu,Zhiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARP声誉惩罚机制和SPARC代码门控反思机制，用于抑制LLM智能体作为自主商家时在商品列表中虚构属性的行为，通过惩罚低评分说谎者来保护消费者。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文研究的是LLM智能体作为自主商家的诚实性/声誉机制设计问题，属于AI安全、机制设计、博弈论与LLM行为研究范畴，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何一项。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM智能体诚实性与声誉机制设计，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体商品列表属性虚构行为的抑制机制设计。应用场景：电商平台中自主商家（LLM agent）的诚实性治理。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。涉及CARP（reputation-penalty机制，含deadband噪声容忍和state-dependent severity）与SPARC（byte-clean code-gated reflection机制）两个机制组件，但未给出底层LLM模型的具体网络结构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化网络设计方法。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标涉及消费者福利（consumer welfare）、销售抑制效果、与perfect-information oracle的福利差距、置信区间（confidence intervals）等，但未给出具体数值或数据集名称。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验设置。主要结论包括：CARP能抑制低评分说谎者的销量同时保护诚实卖家；与SPARC配合可缩小与完美信息oracle的消费者福利差距；LLM商家在说谎无成本时会虚构，在说谎导致销量损失时会自我约束（self-interested response而非合规性）。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：研究聚焦于LLM行为经济学与机制设计，与遥感目标检测、在轨计算、模型轻量化完全无关；未涉及任何视觉任务、遥感数据或嵌入式部署场景。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文中"penalty-gated self-correction"的机制设计思想（通过代价约束行为）在概念上类似于损失函数中正则项/惩罚项对模型行为的约束，但这属于非常间接的类比，实际借鉴价值极低。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.

</details>


### [255] [Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28336)
*Feng Xiong,Leyan Xue,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)，一种无标签的多模态推理蒸馏方法，通过感知-推理分离的 rollout 和 teacher-student 分歧作为互补证据，识别可纠正的感知失败并强化蒸馏。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于多模态大模型推理蒸馏方向，核心是 perception-reasoning 解耦的 on-policy distillation，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然涉及 "distillation"（知识蒸馏），但其对象是 multimodal reasoner（多模态推理器），而非遥感目标检测模型。属于泛机器学习/泛视觉方法，对遥感轻量化课题仅有方法论层面的间接借鉴意义。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关，属于多模态大模型推理蒸馏的通用方法。虽然其"感知-推理解耦"和"分歧加权蒸馏"思想对遥感检测蒸馏有一定方法论借鉴意义，但场景差异大、模型规模不匹配、无部署指标，优先级较低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多模态推理（multimodal reasoning）中的 on-policy distillation；应用场景：通用多模态大模型（VLM）的感知-推理联合优化；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器，摘要未说明具体输入模态；目标类别：不涉及具体目标检测类别，面向通用感知与推理任务。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构细节。涉及 teacher-student 蒸馏框架，学生模型规模为 2B 和 8B，教师模型规模为 8B 和 32B，属于大语言/多模态模型（LLM/VLM）体系。核心模块包括：separated perception-reasoning rollouts（感知-推理分离的轨迹采样）、mean-preserving weights（均值保持权重）、soft AND gate（由 PSR 与 teacher-student disagreement 的乘积构成）。

Lightweight method: 涉及知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），但并非面向模型压缩/轻量化的传统蒸馏。其蒸馏目标是提升多模态推理能力，通过 on-policy distillation 将大模型（32B/8B）知识迁移到小模型（8B/2B），本质上具有模型规模压缩的效果，但摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、推理速度等部署指标。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS 或边缘部署。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然蒸馏本身可视为一种模型压缩手段（32B→8B、8B→2B），但论文聚焦于推理质量提升而非部署效率，且 2B/8B 规模的多模态大模型对于星上部署而言仍过于庞大。

Datasets and metrics: 在 8 个 benchmark 上评估（摘要未列出具体数据集名称）。评价指标为 macro average（宏平均），具体指标类型摘要未说明。关键实验数据：8B→2B 蒸馏将 macro average 从 44.50（OPD baseline）提升到 47.28；32B→8B 从 56.94 提升到 61.22。消融实验：移除 PCD 使 held-out average 下降 2.22 点，移除 separated rollout 下降 0.88 点。

Experiments: 主要对比方法为 OPD（On-Policy Distillation）baseline。PCD 在 8 个 benchmark 上均优于 OPD。消融实验验证了 PCD 组件（soft AND gate）和 separated rollout 各自的贡献。摘要未说明与更多蒸馏方法的对比，也未提供感知/推理子任务的分项指标。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于通用多模态推理蒸馏；2) 摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟等部署指标，无法评估轻量化效果；3) 2B/8B/32B 规模的多模态大模型对星上部署不现实；4) 摘要未说明 PCD 是否适用于单模态（如纯视觉遥感目标检测）场景；5) 未提供在具体视觉任务（如检测、分割）上的验证，仅给出宏观 benchmark 平均分。

Ideas for my research: 1) "感知-推理分离"（perception-reasoning separation）的思想可迁移到遥感目标检测蒸馏中：将检测器的特征提取（感知）与检测头/分类头（推理）解耦，分别评估蒸馏信号，避免将感知错误和推理错误混为一谈；2) "teacher-student disagreement 作为蒸馏权重"的思路可借鉴：在遥感检测蒸馏中，仅对 teacher 和 student 分歧较大的样本/区域加强蒸馏，可提升蒸馏效率；3) "soft AND gate"（两个证据的乘积作为门控）可类比为：在遥感小目标检测蒸馏中，同时满足"检测失败"和"特征差异大"两个条件时才强化蒸馏，避免对困难样本的过度蒸馏；4) 均值保持权重（mean-preserving weights）的思想可用于遥感检测蒸馏中保持分类/回归目标的分布不变。

Abstract: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

</details>


### [256] [How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28367)
*Zihan Dong,Zhiyuan Ma,Zekun Wang,Yunqing Li,Zirou Liu,Ruixuan Deng,Qishi Zhan,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究计算机使用智能体（CUA）在网页浏览和桌面软件操作中的基准评测可靠性问题，提出一个涵盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告的可靠性框架，并审计了150个失败轨迹发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于计算机使用智能体（Computer-use agents）的基准评测可靠性，属于人机交互、智能体评估和软件自动化领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、地球观测、目标检测或模型压缩/加速等任何相关主题。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于CUA智能体评测领域，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：CUA（Computer-use agents）基准评测可靠性审计。应用场景：网页浏览、企业工作流、桌面软件控制。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非视觉目标检测）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。论文关注的是评测管线（task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, reporting）而非模型架构设计。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化网络设计方法。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。论文未讨论星上部署、边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 审计了150个公开的失败评分轨迹，来自5个基准（web, enterprise-workflow, desktop-control benchmarks）。指标包括FAIL判定错误率（15.3%），其中10.7%为评估器假阴性（evaluator false negatives），4.7%为损坏任务（broken tasks）。还提出了三层诊断分类法（three-tier diagnostic taxonomy）用于区分验证/反馈错误、规划错误和执行/接地错误。

Experiments: 对150个失败轨迹进行人工审计，发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的。在真实失败中，verification/feedback和planning错误占主导，而execution/grounding错误较少。单一标量成功率（single scalar success rate）无法解释失败原因。论文还将其发现与更新的长时程CUA基准关联，并推导出分阶段的CUA评测设计规则。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。摘要未涉及任何遥感、目标检测、模型轻量化或部署相关内容。该论文属于智能体评测方法论研究，对遥感在轨目标检测课题无可借鉴的技术内容。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文主题与遥感在轨目标检测无关，但其"评测可靠性"的思想有一定方法论层面的启发：在遥感目标检测模型轻量化研究中，评估指标（如mAP、FLOPs、延迟）的可靠性同样值得审视——例如，仅用单一标量指标（如mAP）可能掩盖模型在特定目标尺度、特定场景下的失败模式。但这一借鉴非常间接，不构成实质性技术参考。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.

</details>


### [257] [HyperClaim: Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for Video Misinformation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28375)
*Xiangbo Wang,Jiasheng Zhang,Xingtong Yu,Luoqiang Lei,Delvin Ce Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HyperClaim，一个判别式时序超图框架，用于视频虚假信息检测中的样本级真实性分类，通过稀疏异构超图建模查询词、证据文本与视频帧之间的高阶跨模态依赖。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视频虚假信息检测（video misinformation detection）中的样本级真实性分类（sample-level authenticity classification）。应用场景：社交媒体/新闻视频真实性判别。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器，仅涉及视频帧（frames）与文本（title/paired text）。目标类别：不涉及遥感目标类别，仅涉及"真实/虚假"二分类真实性标签。

Model architecture: HyperClaim框架包含：1) 稀疏异构超图（sparse heterogeneous hypergraph），节点覆盖query tokens、evidence tokens、sampled frames三类；2) confidence-aware filtering与source budgeting，用于构建紧凑的text-frame和short-range temporal evidence units；3) adaptive soft-incidence reasoning，配合residual text-video calibration进行推理；4) discrepancy-aware readout，聚合textual、visual、hyperedge状态。整体为判别式（discriminative）时序超图框架，不依赖生成的rationales或外部工具调用。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。虽然提到"sparse heterogeneous hypergraph"和"compact evidence units"涉及稀疏性与紧凑性，但这是针对证据单元构建的算法设计，并非面向部署的轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息，也未讨论星上/边缘部署可行性。该任务本身（视频虚假信息检测）与在轨遥感目标检测部署场景无直接关联。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：FakeSV、FakeTT、FakeVV三个视频虚假信息检测基准数据集。评价指标：accuracy（准确率），在FactGuard temporal protocol协议下分别达到83.7%（FakeSV）、82.0%（FakeTT）、87.3%（FakeVV）。实验设置：与强判别式基线（strong discriminative baselines）和推理中心基线（reasoning-centric baselines）进行对比。

Experiments: 在FactGuard temporal protocol下，HyperClaim在FakeSV、FakeTT、FakeVV上分别取得83.7%、82.0%、87.3%的准确率，优于强判别式基线和推理中心基线。此外，学习到的incidence和attention权重揭示了token级和frame级结构，说明模型具备一定的可解释性。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，属于多模态视频理解领域；2) 摘要未说明模型复杂度、推理速度、参数量等部署指标，无法评估其轻量化潜力；3) 摘要未说明超图构建的计算开销，超图推理在长视频或大规模场景下可能面临效率问题；4) 摘要未说明在遥感图像或遥感视频上的泛化能力。

Ideas for my research: 1) 超图（hypergraph）建模高阶依赖的思想可迁移到遥感多模态场景，例如遥感图像中多目标之间的高阶空间关系建模，或遥感图像+文本描述（如scene graph）的跨模态理解；2) "confidence-aware filtering"和"source budgeting"的紧凑证据单元构建思路，可类比用于遥感目标检测中筛选高置信度候选框或关键区域，减少冗余计算；3) "adaptive soft-incidence reasoning"的软关联推理机制，可借鉴用于遥感多尺度特征融合中不同尺度特征间的高阶交互建模；4) 但需注意，该论文未提供任何轻量化手段，若要在在轨场景借鉴，需自行补充剪枝/量化/蒸馏等压缩策略。

Abstract: Video misinformation detection is often approached through global multimodal fusion or free-form multimodal reasoning. Both paradigms can under-represent localized authenticity cues that arise from coupled interactions among query phrases, contextual text, and short temporal spans of frames. Because such interactions are inherently higher-order, pairwise graph formulations are insufficient to capture multi-way cross-modal dependencies, whereas hypergraphs offer a suitable representation for these relations. We propose HyperClaim, a discriminative temporal hypergraph framework for sample-level authenticity classification. Using the title or benchmark-provided paired text as a claim-like query, HyperClaim constructs a sparse heterogeneous hypergraph over query tokens, evidence tokens, and sampled frames; applies confidence-aware filtering and source budgeting to form compact text-frame and short-range temporal evidence units; performs adaptive soft-incidence reasoning with residual text-video calibration; and aggregates textual, visual, and hyperedge states through a discrepancy-aware readout. Without relying on generated rationales or external tool calls, HyperClaim preserves fine-grained cross-modal and temporal structure that global fusion tends to flatten. Under the FactGuard temporal protocol, it achieves 83.7%, 82.0%, and 87.3% accuracy on FakeSV, FakeTT, and FakeVV, respectively, outperforming strong discriminative and reasoning-centric baselines. Learned incidence and attention weights further reveal token- and frame-level structure.

</details>


### [258] [When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28384)
*Tairan Wang,Liang Zhou,Zikang Zhan,Pingchuan Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个可控实验框架，用于研究大语言模型（LLM）在相互冲突的规格说明之间如何解决偏好冲突，并通过数学基准测试和多种表示形式验证了系统性的偏好模式。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文研究的是大语言模型（LLM）在冲突规格说明下的偏好行为分析，属于自然语言处理与模型可解释性领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/加速等任何相关主题。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM冲突规格偏好分析，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM冲突规格偏好分析；应用场景：数学推理、布尔代数、代码生成、临床领域；不涉及遥感传感器或目标类别。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构，仅提及比较四种表示类型：纯自然语言（pure natural language）、形式语言（formal language）、自然化形式语言（naturalized formal language）、输入-输出示例（input-output examples）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何轻量化方法。未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、实时推理或边缘部署等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 使用可执行的数学基准测试，包含550个冲突实例，覆盖11个函数族；扩展到布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域的异构规格冲突。评价指标摘要未明确说明。

Experiments: 比较四种表示类型下的模型偏好，结果显示系统性偏好模式：Formal ≈ Naturalized Formal > Pure Natural Language > Input-Output Examples。示例效应依赖于模型能力和函数族。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化方向无关，属于LLM可解释性/偏好分析研究。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在轨智能中涉及LLM辅助的遥感解译，其冲突规格处理框架或许有参考价值，但这与本课题核心方向相距甚远。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically.
  We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

</details>


### [259] [GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28397)
*Maya Arseven,Anette Frank,Beni Egressy,Johann Higl,Moritz Plenz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于图语言模型（GLM）的检索器用于知识图谱上的检索增强生成（RAG），对比GLM、GNN和向量检索三种检索器在单跳/多跳推理及跨域泛化上的表现。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于知识图谱上的检索增强生成（RAG）与图神经网络/图语言模型检索器，属于自然语言处理与图机器学习领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能等任何遥感相关主题，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化/部署。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于NLP/图机器学习领域的RAG检索器研究，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：知识图谱上的检索增强生成（RAG）中的检索器设计；应用场景：多跳问答（multi-hop QA）、跨域泛化（out-of-domain generalization）；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 对比了三种检索器架构：(1) 基于图语言模型（GLM, graph language model）的检索器，融合图推理与语言模型语义能力；(2) 基于图神经网络（GNN）的检索器，建模图拓扑结构；(3) 传统向量检索（vector-search）基线。GLM检索器可通过微调（finetuned）提升跨域泛化能力。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计或边缘/星上部署等模型压缩或加速方法。仅提及GNN检索器具有"efficient training setup"（高效训练设置），但未给出具体轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。论文讨论的是RAG检索器的推理能力与泛化性，而非面向边缘或星上部署的优化。

Datasets and metrics: 使用了两个多跳基准数据集（multi-hop benchmarks）进行跨域（out-of-domain）评估，以及域内多跳问答数据集（in-domain multi-hop QA datasets）进行对比。具体数据集名称、评价指标（如Recall@K、Hit@K等）摘要未说明。

Experiments: 主要发现：(1) 微调后的GLM检索器在跨域泛化上表现更好，在两个多跳基准上达到SOTA；(2) 在域内多跳QA数据集上与先前工作相当，且随参数量和子图覆盖（subgraph coverage）增加呈现有前景的扩展性（scaling）；(3) GNN检索器在高效训练设置下达到更高的图覆盖（graph coverage）；(4) 向量检索基线在单跳数据集上表现最佳。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，因此局限性主要体现在：论文面向NLP/图机器学习场景，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测或模型轻量化；摘要未提供模型规模、计算开销、部署可行性等对在轨智能有用的信息；检索器设计思路（GLM vs GNN vs vector search）对遥感目标检测任务没有直接可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文中"GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup"这一结论体现了在保持性能的同时追求训练/计算效率的思路，这与轻量化研究中"在精度与效率间权衡"的理念一致。此外，GLM将图结构与语言模型语义能力融合的范式，若未来遥感领域出现"遥感场景图+语言模型"的跨模态检索/理解任务，或可参考其架构设计。但整体上对本课题（遥感在轨目标检测模型轻量化）几乎没有直接借鉴价值。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.

</details>


### [260] [QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28405)
*Jiacheng Zhou,Jinfan Lv,Ruixuan Li,Longtai Zhang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang,Lizhe Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantWAMs 是一个面向世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）的后训练量化（PTQ）框架，通过共享基异常值校准、协同训练目标显著性分析和固定干预 rollout 审计三种策略，在 W4A4 量化设置下将峰值权重-激活内存降至 FP16 的约 29%，并提供 1.4-1.6× 的块级加速。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2 分）。论文聚焦于世界动作模型（WAMs）的 post-training quantization (PTQ)，属于泛机器人/具身智能领域的模型压缩方法，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景完全无关。虽然涉及 quantization 这一轻量化技术，但目标场景是机器人操作（manipulation）和视频-动作联合预测，而非遥感目标检测。其量化方法论（如 outlier calibration、Fisher-based saliency、rollout auditing）在泛视觉/泛机器学习层面有一定借鉴意义，但并非遥感场景。

Reading priority: 2 分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向弱相关，核心场景是机器人世界动作模型。但其 PTQ 量化方法论（异常值校准、Fisher-based 精度分配、保护调度）在泛模型压缩层面有一定借鉴价值，可作为量化技术参考阅读，不建议作为主要参考文献。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）的联合未来观测与动作预测；应用场景：机器人操作（real-robot manipulation）、仿真环境（RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO）；传感器类型：视频（vision）+ 动作（action）多模态；目标类别：机器人操作任务（manipulation tasks），非遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: 评估对象为 Fast-WAM 和 LingBot-VA 两种世界动作模型架构。QuantWAMs 框架包含三个核心策略：(1) shared-basis outlier calibration——仅在坐标兼容模块间池化激活证据进行异常值校准；(2) co-training-objective saliency——从联合视频-动作梯度计算 empirical-Fisher scores，在校准稳定的层粒度上分配权重精度；(3) fixed-intervention rollout auditing——利用可达的闭环状态修订去噪步骤保护调度，不改变精度预算。

Lightweight method: 核心方法是 post-training quantization (PTQ)，具体为 W4A4 主导的量化设置（4-bit 权重和 4-bit 激活）。针对 WAMs 的迭代去噪和闭环执行特性，提出了三种量化策略：shared-basis outlier calibration（共享基异常值校准）、co-training-objective saliency（协同训练目标显著性，基于 empirical-Fisher scores 的精度分配）、fixed-intervention rollout auditing（固定干预 rollout 审计，修订去噪步骤保护调度）。不涉及 pruning、knowledge distillation、NAS。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提供了部分部署相关信息：在 W4A4 主导设置下，针对目标视频和动作块，峰值权重-激活内存降至 FP16 的约 29%，提供 1.4-1.6× 的块级速度提升。在真实机器人（AgiBot G2）上验证了三个操作任务的部署可行性。但摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、端到端延迟、显存占用绝对值、能耗等指标。由于场景是机器人而非卫星，其部署可行性结论不能直接迁移到星上部署（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT 等均未提及）。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集/基准：RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO、真实机器人操作（AgiBot G2）。评价指标：仿真环境下与 FP16 的均值差异（W4A4 设置下差异为 0.2-0.7 个百分点）；真实机器人三个操作任务的部署可行性验证。摘要未说明具体检测指标（如 mAP、IoU 等），因为该论文不涉及目标检测任务。

Experiments: 在 Fast-WAM 和 LingBot-VA 两种模型上，跨 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 和真实机器人（AgiBot G2）三个平台评估。W4A4 主导设置下仿真均值与 FP16 相差 0.2-0.7 个百分点。真实机器人实验验证了三个操作任务的部署可行性。内存降低至 FP16 的约 29%，块级加速 1.4-1.6×。摘要未说明与现有 PTQ 方法的详细对比结果和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：具体参数量、FLOPs、端到端延迟、能耗等部署指标；与现有 PTQ 方法的定量对比细节；消融实验的具体设置。核心局限在于：该工作面向世界动作模型（WAMs）和机器人操作场景，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测场景差异巨大——传感器模态（视频-动作 vs 遥感影像）、任务目标（动作预测 vs 目标检测）、部署约束（机器人实时控制 vs 星上资源受限）均不同。其量化策略（如 rollout auditing）依赖闭环执行环境，难以直接迁移到遥感检测的静态推理场景。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不同，QuantWAMs 的量化方法论对遥感在轨目标检测模型轻量化有几点可借鉴：(1) shared-basis outlier calibration 的思想——只在结构兼容的模块间共享激活统计信息，可借鉴到遥感检测网络（如 FPN 各层、backbone 与 head 之间）的量化校准中，避免跨异构模块的错误统计池化；(2) 基于 empirical-Fisher scores 的精度分配策略，可迁移到遥感检测模型中按层/按通道分配混合精度（如对关键小目标检测层保留更高精度）；(3) 对迭代/多阶段推理过程的"保护调度"思想，可类比遥感检测中的多尺度特征融合或 RPN+head 两阶段流程，对关键阶段避免过度量化；(4) W4A4 量化在保持精度（0.2-0.7 个百分点差异）的同时大幅降低内存（29%）和加速（1.4-1.6×）的结果，为星上低比特量化提供了可行性参考。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [261] [WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28418)
*Haozhe Hu,Hao Wu,Peiran Yin,Chao Han,Yunpu Ma,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WIDE 是首个端到端可微分的 token 级动态宽度剪枝框架，面向 LLM 的 prefill 和 decode 场景，通过 token 动态选择 attention-head 组和 FFN-channel 组实现细粒度计算分配，并配合剪枝-内核协同设计实现实际加速。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的剪枝与动态稀疏加速，属于泛机器学习/泛视觉方法范畴，与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测均无直接关联。但其动态剪枝思路、剪枝-内核协同设计、细粒度计算分配等思想对轻量化方法有一定借鉴意义，故评2分而非1分。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向弱相关，但其中动态剪枝和剪枝-内核协同设计的思想对轻量化方法设计有一定启发。若课题聚焦于动态/输入自适应剪枝或边缘部署优化，可快速浏览；若课题聚焦于静态剪枝、量化或遥感专用检测网络，则优先级较低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM 推理效率优化（prefill 和 decode 场景）。应用场景：大语言模型推理加速，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明具体 LLM 模型规模。

Model architecture: WIDE 框架基于 transformer 架构的 LLM，核心设计为：1) token 级动态宽度剪枝，允许每个 token 动态选择 attention-head 组和 FFN-channel 组；2) 将动态剪枝从 layer 级扩展到 neuron-block 级粒度；3) 两阶段训练 pipeline 学习 token-wise 稀疏执行模式；4) 剪枝-内核协同设计框架，将动态稀疏加速分解为 mask reordering、硬件无关的 block-level skipping、硬件相关的 intra-block skipping。

Lightweight method: 动态宽度剪枝（dynamic width pruning），属于结构化剪枝的细粒度扩展。具体包括：1) token 级动态计算分配（区别于静态结构化剪枝的 input-agnostic 分配）；2) 两阶段训练 pipeline 学习稀疏执行模式；3) 剪枝-内核协同设计（pruning-kernel co-design）实现实际加速，包括 mask reordering、block-level skipping、intra-block skipping 三级分解。不涉及量化、蒸馏或 NAS。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅报告了推理加速数据：在 50% sparsity 下，相比 SOTA 动态深度剪枝方法在 calibration-only 设置下提供 55.1% 性能提升；prefill 场景 kernel-level 加速最高 1.98x，decode 场景最高 4.95x；端到端加速分别为 1.68x（prefill）和 1.55x（decode）。这些加速数据针对 LLM 推理服务器场景，未涉及边缘/星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标包括：sparsity 水平（50%）、性能提升百分比（55.1% vs SOTA 动态深度剪枝）、kernel-level speedup（prefill 1.98x、decode 4.95x）、end-to-end acceleration（prefill 1.68x、decode 1.55x）。摘要未说明困惑度（perplexity）或下游任务准确率等质量指标的具体数值。

Experiments: 主要实验结论：1) 在 50% sparsity 下，WIDE 相比 SOTA 动态深度剪枝方法在 calibration-only 设置下提供 55.1% 性能提升；2) prefill 和 decode 推理负载下，kernel-level 加速接近理论值（最高 1.98x prefill、4.95x decode）；3) 端到端加速为 1.68x（prefill）和 1.55x（decode）。摘要未说明对比的基线方法具体名称、消融实验细节及质量保持指标。

Limitations: 1) 摘要未说明模型质量保持的具体指标（如 perplexity、下游任务准确率），无法判断剪枝后精度损失程度；2) 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存占用等关键部署指标；3) 加速数据基于 LLM 推理服务器场景，未涉及边缘/嵌入式/星上硬件；4) 动态 token 级剪枝需要运行时 mask 计算，可能引入额外开销，摘要未讨论该开销；5) 与遥感目标检测场景无直接关联，方法迁移需重新设计。

Ideas for my research: 1) 借鉴"token 级动态计算分配"思想：遥感图像中不同区域（如海面 vs 港口）对检测网络不同层的敏感度不同，可探索输入自适应的动态通道/分支剪枝，在保证小目标检测精度的同时降低计算量；2) 借鉴"剪枝-内核协同设计"框架：将动态稀疏加速分解为 mask reordering、block-level skipping、intra-block skipping 三级，可迁移到遥感检测模型在 FPGA/NPU 上的部署优化；3) 借鉴"两阶段训练 pipeline"：先学习稀疏执行模式再微调恢复精度，可用于遥感检测模型的动态剪枝训练；4) 动态宽度剪枝（而非深度剪枝）的思路可应用于遥感检测骨干网络，在保持空间分辨率（对小目标检测至关重要）的同时减少通道冗余。

Abstract: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.

</details>


### [262] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"派生特征过度信任"(DFOT)框架，研究LLM管道中派生测量值被当作直接事实使用的问题，以生理传感(PPG-ECG)为案例，定义了多个量化指标并验证了基于特权蒸馏的修复方法。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型(LLM)对派生测量值的信任评估问题，场景是生理信号(PPG/ECG)而非遥感影像，任务不是目标检测，也不涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化。属于泛机器学习/LLM可信度研究方向，与本课题弱相关甚至无关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM可信度评估与生理信号处理，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM派生特征过度信任评估与修复；应用场景：生理信号传感(PPG-ECG)；传感器类型：PPG(光电容积脉搏波)、ECG(心电图)；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。框架基于LLM管道，使用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏(privileged distillation)作为基线方法，以及PPG-only推理。具体网络架构未在摘要中给出。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提及了"privileged distillation"(特权蒸馏)作为基线方法，但这并非用于模型压缩或轻量化，而是用于利用ECG作为训练监督信号来提升PPG-only推理的可靠性。不涉及剪枝、量化、NAS、实时推理或边缘部署等轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：50,000对PPG-ECG记录，协议锁定的187患者测试集。评价指标：冲突过度信任率(COTR)、上下文诱导错误率(CIR)、正确修复率(CRR)、证据特异性修复边际(ESRM)、效用伤害率(UHR)。

Experiments: 在187患者测试集上，基线方法在四个修复和特异性端点提升了1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间不含零；UHR增加0.67个百分点(95% CI: -0.4到+1.7)。代码已开源。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显与本课题无关：不涉及遥感影像、不涉及目标检测、不涉及模型轻量化或部署优化。DFOT框架虽具有通用性，但主要面向LLM可信度评估，对遥感在轨检测的借鉴价值有限。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但有两个概念可间接借鉴：(1) "privileged distillation"思想——在遥感在轨检测中，可以利用高精度地面模型(如大模型)作为特权信息来蒸馏训练轻量星上模型，这与知识蒸馏(KD)用于轻量化目标检测的思路一致；(2) 对"派生特征过度信任"的评估框架思想——在遥感场景中，可类比思考星上模型对某些特征(如云遮挡下的检测结果)的置信度评估问题。但总体而言，本文对在轨遥感目标检测轻量化课题的直接借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [263] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出UNICON，一个基于图上下文推理的数值智能基础模型，通过in-context learning跨学科泛化，无需重训练即可逼近专家性能。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于数值智能基础模型（numerical intelligence foundation model），核心是in-context learning和跨学科泛化，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测或模型压缩/部署。属于泛机器学习/基础模型方法，与本方向弱相关（2分）。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于数值智能基础模型研究，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或模型压缩部署，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：数值智能/科学与社会系统预测建模（in-context learning on graph-based numerical systems）。应用场景：跨学科科学与社会系统预测，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用（非图像/遥感数据）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: UNICON（UNified In-Context Operator Networks）基础模型，基于图（graph-based）上下文示例进行推理，推断系统内共享的预测关系并应用于同系统查询。可与语言模型agent结合形成多模态推理框架。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节（如transformer层数、参数量等）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。模型压缩与加速不在本文讨论范围内。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。作为基础模型，通常计算开销较大，但摘要未提供任何量化数据。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及涵盖科学与社会系统、包含训练中未见过的学科（unseen disciplines），并提到training-corpus diversity对泛化的影响。

Experiments: 主要实验结论：1) 在训练中未见的学科上，同一模型无需重训练即可逼近专家性能；2) 结合语言模型agent后可超越未见学科上的SOTA专家；3) 训练语料多样性可提升对未见学科的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体对比数值。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2) 摘要未提供模型规模、计算成本、推理效率等关键工程指标；3) 未说明数值智能在图像/视觉任务上的适用性；4) 基础模型通常参数量大、推理开销高，与在轨部署的轻量化需求相悖。

Ideas for my research: 1) 虽然本文不涉及遥感目标检测，但其"in-context learning跨域泛化"思想可启发遥感小样本/跨传感器（如光学→SAR）目标检测的少样本适应研究；2) "training-corpus diversity提升泛化"的思路可借鉴到遥感多源数据（多光谱、SAR、高光谱）联合训练以增强模型泛化能力；3) 若未来考虑星上大模型/基础模型的轻量化部署，本文的数值智能框架可作为理论参考，但需配合蒸馏/量化等压缩手段。总体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [264] [Metaphor Tracer: A Theory-Informed Analysis of Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28434)
*Marc Heimann,Roxana Assadi Moghaddam,Olga Brovkina,Mark Pettifor,Lutz Goetzmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型隐藏状态如何表征单篇文本中token位置的结构性组织（aggregator与differentiator两种属性），属于计算语言学/可解释性研究，与遥感目标检测及轻量化完全无关。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1分）。论文完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能；不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测、舰船/飞机/车辆检测或遥感场景理解；也不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等轻量化或部署技术。该论文属于自然语言处理（NLP）与语言模型可解释性（interpretability）方向，研究的是语言模型hidden states对文本结构的编码，与本研究方向的遥感在轨目标检测与模型轻量化基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于NLP可解释性研究，不建议投入阅读时间。除非对语言模型内部表征有跨领域兴趣，否则对本课题无参考价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：语言模型隐藏状态的可解释性分析（token-level structural scoring）。应用场景：单篇文本结构分析、临床转录文本标注、语篇阅读追踪。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构，仅提及"three unrelated models"（三个不相关的模型）以及一个matched base/instruct pair（基础/指令微调配对模型）。核心概念为两个基于hidden states的评分属性：aggregator（衡量某token位置是否将整篇文本整合为稳定配置）和differentiator（衡量其他token是否被瞬时携带进入该token的子空间）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息，也未涉及星上或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：一个discovery text（用于冻结常数的发现文本）、一个engineered register（工程化语域，6/6 cells）、临床转录文本（psychoanalyst标记，34/36 cells）。评价指标：aggregator与differentiator评分、surprisal、attention、type-level measure对比、transfer test（类型迁移测试）。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 在三个不相关模型上验证aggregator评分在token重复时保持稳定而surprisal和attention下降；2) 在engineered register上aggregator跨边界追踪（6/6 cells）；3) 在临床转录文本上与心理分析师预先标记对照（34/36 cells）；4) transfer test显示token结构与lexical type共同迁移的模型对单篇语篇阅读效果最差，且instruct tuning提升fidelity但不改变type-transfer。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：该研究完全属于NLP/可解释性领域，与遥感、目标检测、轻量化部署无任何交集；其方法（hidden states的结构性评分）无法直接迁移到遥感目标检测任务；摘要也未提供任何计算效率或部署相关数据。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：该论文强调"relational rather than essentialist reading of hidden states"（对隐藏状态的关系性而非本质性解读），这一思想在理论上或许可类比于特征蒸馏中关注特征间关系（relational knowledge distillation）而非单点特征，但论文本身并未涉及蒸馏或遥感，迁移价值极低。

Abstract: What do a language model's hidden states say about the organization of a single text? From one forward pass, without training, we score every token position on two properties. The *aggregator* measures whether the position consolidates the whole text into a stable configuration. The *differentiator*, whether other tokens are transiently carried into its subspace as the model reads: metaphor in its root sense, transport. Constants were frozen on one discovery text; every other is confirmatory.
  The aggregator is not, in the classic sense, an information measure, nor a measure of salience. Across three unrelated models, as a signifier repeats, its surprisal and its attention drain while its aggregator score holds: the channel marks a token's place in the text. That this tracks a reading rests on independent ground truth: an engineered register the aggregator follows across its boundaries (6/6 cells), and a psychoanalyst's marking of clinical transcripts, fixed before the instrument existed, in 34/36 cells, with a graded increment above lexical controls and dissociations no type-level measure reproduces. A transfer test gives the result its shape: the model whose token structure travels with lexical type reads the singular discourse worst, and in a matched base/instruct pair tuning raises fidelity without moving type-transfer. Structural value is a property of a token's place in *this* text, not of its vector alone: a relational rather than essentialist reading of hidden states, operationalizing theory that predated the instrument.

</details>


### [265] [SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28457)
*Hongyu Chen,Liang Lin,Guangrun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR)，一种无外部反馈的多轮强化学习框架，让语言模型通过自验证作为计算控制策略，实现自适应测试时计算分配，在数学推理基准上以更少的推理轮次取得更好精度。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于大语言模型（LLM）数学推理与测试时计算分配（test-time compute）方向，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。唯一可借鉴的是其"自适应计算分配"思想——即根据输入难度动态决定是否继续推理/计算，这与在轨遥感目标检测中"根据图像复杂度自适应选择是否调用更重模型"的思路有概念上的类比，但方法本身（多轮RL、自验证、GRPO）与视觉目标检测和模型压缩完全无关。

Reading priority: 2分。与本研究方向弱相关，仅"自适应计算分配"思想有概念性借鉴价值，但方法本身（LLM多轮RL推理）与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化无直接交集。若时间紧张可跳过精读，仅浏览其自适应停止机制的设计思路即可。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：语言模型数学推理（mathematical reasoning）与自适应测试时计算分配。应用场景：通用LLM推理，非遥感/卫星场景。传感器类型：不适用（文本输入）。目标类别：数学问题求解。

Model architecture: 基于 Qwen3.5-2B 语言模型，采用多轮强化学习框架。核心模块：每轮生成"解+离散正确性判定(verdict)+置信度分数(confidence)"，当判定为Correct且置信度超过阈值时保留当前答案，否则基于自验证继续精炼。训练采用 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）在固定horizon轨迹上优化，奖励函数包含解正确性、校准感知的自验证、以及"可停止的正确状态"三部分。自适应停止仅在推理时激活。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等传统模型压缩方法。其"轻量化"体现在推理效率层面：通过自适应停止机制（adaptive stopping）减少平均推理轮次（2.99 turns vs 固定10 turns），从而降低测试时计算开销。这是一种"计算分配优化"而非模型压缩，属于推理侧效率优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提到模型为 Qwen3.5-2B（约20亿参数），平均推理轮次2.99。该模型规模对于星上部署而言仍然偏大，且LLM推理本身不适合当前在轨硬件约束。摘要未说明任何边缘/星上部署相关内容。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：7个数学推理基准（具体名称摘要未列出）。评价指标：macro-average accuracy（0.563），平均推理轮次（2.99 turns）。对比基线：标准GRPO、强多轮基线、固定预算oracle-guided score-feedback参考方法。

Experiments: 在7个数学推理基准上，SVR以平均2.99轮推理达到macro-average accuracy 0.563，超过标准GRPO、强多轮基线和固定预算的oracle-guided score-feedback参考方法，同时比固定10轮推理使用更少的轮次。摘要未提供逐数据集详细结果或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于NLP/LLM领域。2. 摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs、延迟等部署指标。3. 未提供逐数据集精度、置信度阈值选择策略、失败案例分析。4. 自适应停止的阈值如何设定、对分布漂移的鲁棒性未说明。5. 2B模型规模对在轨部署仍不现实。6. 方法依赖多轮自回归生成，推理延迟天然较高。

Ideas for my research: 1. "自适应计算分配"思想可迁移：在遥感目标检测中，可设计一个轻量级"置信度评估器"判断当前检测结果是否可靠，若不可靠则动态调用更重的检测分支或进行多尺度/多视角精炼，从而在简单场景（如均匀海面）快速返回、在复杂场景（如密集港口）投入更多计算——这与SVR的"verdict+confidence阈值控制停止"思路一致。2. 可借鉴"校准感知的自验证"概念：在检测模型中引入对预测不确定性的校准，使置信度分数更可靠地指导是否继续推理。3. 奖励函数设计思路：将"正确性+停止就绪状态"联合建模，可类比为检测任务中"精度+推理延迟"的多目标优化。4. 注意：SVR本身不提供任何模型压缩方法，需自行结合剪枝/量化/蒸馏等手段实现真正的轻量化。

Abstract: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.

</details>


### [266] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个在Lean定理证明器中验证约束规划（Constraint Programming）求解正确性的框架，涵盖公式级性质验证和求解器证书检查两个层面，实现端到端的可验证求解流程。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文主题是约束规划（Constraint Programming）的形式化验证，涉及Lean定理证明器、MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等求解器格式，属于形式化方法/程序验证领域。完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化等任何相关主题。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，属于形式化验证/约束规划领域。不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：约束规划求解的形式化验证（formal verification of constraint programming）。应用场景：调度（scheduling）、规划（planning）、配置（configuration）、验证（verification）等组合优化问题。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 框架基于Lean定理证明器构建，包含两个验证层级：(1) 公式级性质验证（formulation-level properties），如等价性（equivalence）、等可满足性（equisatisfiability）、对称性破缺约束（symmetry-breaking constraints）的正确性；(2) 求解器证书检查（solver-produced certificates），通过翻译后端（translation backends）对接MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等外部格式。不涉及神经网络模型结构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。本文不讨论任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等。摘要中提到的"reduces solver search effort"是指约束求解器的搜索开销降低，与深度学习模型轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。唯一相关的性能指标是求解器搜索开销降低因子（up to 2×10^7）和in-Lean认证耗时（最多几分钟），但这些是针对约束求解的形式化验证场景，与在轨部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。实验指标包括：求解器搜索开销降低因子（reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2×10^7）、in-Lean认证耗时（at most a few minutes for largest instances）。这些指标针对约束求解验证，不涉及目标检测的mAP、IoU、FPS等指标。

Experiments: 实验结果表明：(1) 每个问题族（problem family）只需一次参数化证明（parametric proof），可跨所有实例规模复用；(2) 验证的对称性破缺（verified symmetry breaking）可将求解器搜索开销降低最多2×10^7倍；(3) 整个in-Lean认证过程开销可控，最大实例也只需几分钟。无消融实验或对比方法信息。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显与本课题方向无关：不涉及遥感图像、目标检测、深度学习模型或任何轻量化技术。该工作属于形式化方法（formal methods）领域，其方法论（如Lean定理证明、证书验证）与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题几乎没有直接可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 对本课题的可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：该工作强调"一次参数化证明可跨实例复用"的思想，在模型轻量化中可类比为"一次训练/蒸馏得到的轻量模型可跨不同分辨率或场景复用"，但这属于非常牵强的类比。总体而言，本文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题几乎没有直接借鉴价值。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [267] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EndoCLIP 是一个面向结肠镜检查的视觉-语言基础模型，通过从 280,476 份常规检查报告中逐步恢复出 125,756 个病灶级图像-文本对进行训练，在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务上超越通用及生物医学视觉-语言编码器。

Research relevance: 1 分（基本无关）。该论文聚焦于结肠镜检查（colonoscopy）的医学影像视觉-语言基础模型，属于医学影像分析领域，与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。既非遥感/卫星场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化方法。

Reading priority: 1 分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于医学影像视觉-语言领域，不建议优先阅读。除非对视觉-语言弱监督数据构建方法有跨领域兴趣，否则可跳过。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Model architecture: EndoCLIP 采用 CLIP 架构范式（对比式视觉-语言预训练），包含图像编码器和文本编码器。摘要未说明具体的骨干网络结构（如 ViT 或 ResNet 变体）、投影头设计、对比学习损失函数细节等。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量（parameters）、FLOPs、延迟（latency）、显存占用、能耗或实时推理性能等任何部署相关信息。其应用场景为临床医学影像分析，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：125,756 个病灶级图像-文本对，从 280,476 份常规结肠镜检查报告中逐步恢复（progressively recovered）。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称，但涉及零样本（zero-shot）和线性探测（linear-probe）设置下的检索与分类性能；在良恶性分类任务上，其线性探测结果与 12 名内镜专家的盲法研究（blinded study）进行对比。

Experiments: 主要实验包括：病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成、六个多中心临床分类任务。在 zero-shot 和 linear-probe 两种设置下，EndoCLIP 均优于通用（general-purpose）和生物医学（biomedical）视觉-语言编码器。在良恶性分类上，其 linear probe 性能接近 12 名内镜专家在盲法研究中的表现。摘要未提供具体数值结果或消融实验细节。
