Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：(1) 该研究聚焦PPM领域，结论是否适用于其他领域（如遥感视觉任务）未知；(2) 未给出具体数据集规模、任务难度分布；(3) 未讨论模型部署效率、推理成本的具体量化；(4) 未涉及轻量化技术，无法为模型压缩提供直接参考。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题基本无关，但可借鉴其方法论层面的思路：(1) 对不同建模范式（经典CNN/Transformer vs 轻量模型 vs 基础模型）进行受控benchmark对比的思路，可用于评估轻量化检测模型在遥感场景下的性能-效率权衡；(2) 强调"经典模型在特定任务上仍具竞争力"的结论，提示在遥感在轨检测中不应盲目追求大模型，轻量经典模型可能仍是星上部署的更优选择；(3) 对"higher cost"的考量可类比到星上算力受限场景，需在精度与资源消耗间做系统权衡。整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) leverages event logs to forecast the future of running process instances, for instance, predicting the next activity, the remaining time until case completion, or the time to the next event. While PPM research in recent years has been dominated by deep sequence models trained from scratch, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, foundation-model approaches---particularly large language models (LLMs)---are increasingly explored for PPM. At the same time, tabular foundation models with in-context learning capabilities offer a promising alternative but have not yet been systematically benchmarked for PPM. Thus, it remains unclear whether classical sequence-based models remain competitive in this evolving landscape. This paper compares the three modeling paradigms both conceptually and empirically through a controlled benchmark across multiple datasets and prediction tasks. The results show that sequence models consistently perform best for next activity prediction, whereas tabular foundation models are competitive on temporal tasks, with LLMs usually lagging behind despite higher cost.

</details>


### [347] [Learning-Augmented and Randomized Algorithms for Line Aggregation with Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27807)
*Tianhang Lu,Runtian Ren,Shengcai Liu,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带延迟的线度量空间上的学习增强与随机化在线聚合问题，提出确定性Balance算法和随机化算法的鲁棒性与一致性理论分析。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于理论计算机科学中的在线算法（online algorithms）与学习增强算法（learning-augmented algorithms）研究，讨论的是线度量空间上的聚合问题（online aggregation with delays on a line metric），不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于理论计算机科学中的在线算法研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：在线聚合问题（online aggregation with delays）的理论算法设计。应用场景：线度量空间（line metric）上的服务调度。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 提出确定性学习增强Balance算法和随机化算法，核心是竞争比（competitive ratio）、鲁棒性（robustness）和一致性（consistency）的理论分析框架。不涉及神经网络或深度学习模型结构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文讨论的是在线算法理论，与剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法无关。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文不涉及任何部署相关指标，如参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理。

Datasets and metrics: 论文采用数值实验（numerical experiments）验证理论分析，未使用遥感或计算机视觉数据集。评价指标为竞争比（competitive ratio）、鲁棒性（robustness）和一致性（consistency）。

Experiments: 主要理论贡献包括：1) 确定性学习增强Balance算法达到(4/λ+1/λ²)-robust和(4+λ)-consistent；2) 随机化算法在对抗模型下达到(e+1)-competitive，优于确定性5-competitive的Balance基准；3) 建立了随机化在线算法竞争比的下界e，改进了此前e/(e-1)的下界；4) 结合两种思路得到随机化学习增强算法，达到(e/λ+1/λ²)-robust和(e+λ)-consistent。数值实验用于补充理论分析。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。但该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测和模型轻量化方向完全无关，属于纯理论在线算法研究，无法直接借鉴到目标检测或模型压缩任务中。

Ideas for my research: 该论文对本人课题几乎没有直接可借鉴点。唯一可能间接相关的概念是"learning-augmented"（学习增强）思想——即利用机器学习预测信息来改进在线决策算法的鲁棒性与一致性权衡，这一思路在理论上可类比于在轨场景中利用预测信息优化资源调度，但与本课题的目标检测模型轻量化方向关联极弱。

Abstract: This paper studies learning-augmented and randomized online aggregation with delays on a line metric. We consider advice given as online suggested service lengths, and evaluate the algorithms in terms of robustness and consistency. For each $λ\in (0,1]$, we first propose a deterministic learning-augmented \textsc{Balance} algorithm that is $(4/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(4+λ)$-consistent. We also propose a randomized algorithm for the problem in the classical adversarial model, which is $(e+1)$-competitive against an oblivious adversary, improving over the deterministic $5$-competitive \textsc{Balance} benchmark~\cite{bienkowski2013chain}. Notably, this competitive ratio is even lower than the lower bound of $4$ for deterministic online algorithms. Moreover, we establish a lower bound of $e$ on the competitive ratio of randomized online algorithms, improving the previous lower bound of $e/(e-1)$. Besides, we combine the two ideas and obtain a randomized learning-augmented algorithm that is $(e/λ+1/λ^2)$-robust and $(e+λ)$-consistent. Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to complement our theoretical analysis and evaluate the empirical performance of our algorithms.

</details>


### [348] [Contrastive Concept Importance: Explaining Pairwise Class Decisions Through Automatically Extracted Concept Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27904)
*Roel Visser,Isaac Roberts,Barbara Hammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对比式概念重要性（CCI）方法，用于解释黑盒模型在目标类与对照类之间的决策差异，通过符号化归因分数揭示类别对特异的模型行为。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于可解释性/模型解释（XAI）领域，聚焦于概念归因（concept attribution）和对比式解释（contrastive explanation），与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。它不涉及遥感场景、不涉及目标检测模型、也不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法。仅作为泛机器学习/泛视觉方法，对研究方向有间接参考价值。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文属于XAI领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关。仅在需要做模型可解释性分析（如诊断压缩后模型退化原因）时有一定参考价值，不建议作为核心阅读文献。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：模型可解释性（model interpretability）中的概念归因与对比式解释。应用场景：通用视觉分类任务的决策解释，非遥感场景。传感器类型：摘要未说明（使用ImageNet自然图像）。目标类别：ImageNet类别对（class pairs），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。方法基于CRAFT-style concept basis自动提取视觉概念基，对黑盒分类模型（black-box model）的logit margin进行归因。核心组件包括：概念基（concept basis）、目标类logit与对照类（foil class）logit的分解、符号化归因分数。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计或任何模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该方法本身是解释性工具，不面向星上或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ImageNet类别对（ImageNet class pairs），使用CRAFT-style concept bases。评价指标：insertion and deletion curves（插入/删除曲线）、logit-wise decomposition analysis（logit分解分析）、semantic class hierarchy（语义类别层级）。

Experiments: 实验表明：对比式概念重要性（CCI）能揭示普通概念重要性（ordinary concept importance）无法捕获的类别对特异模型行为；高度对比性的概念可对照语义超类结构（semantic superclass structure）评估其影响的是细粒度区分还是宽泛类别证据。摘要未提供具体数值结果或与基线方法的定量对比细节。

Limitations: 局限性：1）仅针对分类任务的解释，未涉及目标检测（object detection）场景；2）仅在ImageNet上验证，未在遥感图像（remote sensing）、SAR、高光谱等数据上测试；3）未讨论计算开销，作为解释方法本身可能引入额外计算负担；4）摘要未说明方法对模型规模、推理速度的影响；5）未涉及任何轻量化或部署相关考量。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的借鉴点有限但存在间接价值：1）对比式归因思想可用于分析轻量化模型（如剪枝/蒸馏后的模型）在遥感小目标检测中类别混淆（如舰船vs港口设施、飞机vs鸟类）的决策依据，帮助诊断压缩后模型性能下降的原因；2）logit margin分解方法可用于评估知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）中学生模型与教师模型在特定类别对上的行为差异；3）概念基（concept basis）思路可迁移到遥感场景，用可解释概念（如纹理、形状、光谱特征）解释轻量化模型在遥感目标上的决策，辅助模型压缩策略选择。但整体上该论文与本研究方向关联较弱，仅作为方法论参考。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations are a prevalent way to explain the decisions of complex black-box methods through semantically meaningful, human-interpretable concepts. To attribute the contribution of such concepts to a model's decisions, feature attribution methods are used to quantify how strongly each concept contributes to a model output. These attributions are typically computed for a single output class and therefore answer a non-contrastive "why P?" question. In many situations, however, such as cases of misclassification, class confusion, and low-margin predictions, the more natural question to ask is "why P rather than Q?".
  We introduce contrastive concept importance (CCI), which attributes the logit margin between a target class and a contrast, or foil, class to concepts in an automatically extracted visual concept basis. The resulting scores are signed, indicating whether a concept supports the target over the foil or the foil over the target, and can be decomposed into target-logit and foil-logit effects. This makes it possible to distinguish globally important concepts from concepts that specifically influence a class-pair distinction, including whether their effect is shared, one-sided, or directly contrastive.
  We evaluate the method on ImageNet class pairs using CRAFT-style concept bases, insertion and deletion curves, logit-wise decomposition analysis, and semantic class hierarchy. The results show that contrastive concept importance reveals class-pair-specific model behavior that is not captured by ordinary concept importance alone, and that highly contrastive concepts can be evaluated against semantic superclass structure to assess whether they affect fine-grained distinctions rather than broad category evidence.

</details>


### [349] [Class-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Counterfactual Explanation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27905)
*Muhammad Adil Saleem,Syed Ali Raza,Mary-Anne Williams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种class-aware的强化学习(RL)方法用于生成counterfactual explanations (CFEs)，在RL状态表示中加入实例的预测类别信息，以提升CFE生成的收敛速度、奖励优化和有效性。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于可解释机器学习(XAI)领域，聚焦于黑盒模型的counterfactual explanation生成，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。它既不是遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测，更不涉及模型压缩或加速。唯一可能的间接关联是：其RL状态设计思想（加入类别信息）在理论上可迁移到其他RL-based方法中，但与本课题方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦于XAI领域的counterfactual explanation生成，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速技术，阅读价值很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：counterfactual explanation (CFE) 生成，属于可解释人工智能(XAI)任务。应用场景：通用机器学习模型的可解释性增强，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用（使用7个来自不同领域的通用数据集）。目标类别：不适用（通用分类任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络结构。核心方法是基于Reinforcement Learning (RL)的CFE生成框架，关键创新在于RL状态(state)表示中同时包含：(1) 来自监督数据集predictors的特征；(2) 实例的预测类别(predicted class)。对比基线为class-blind RL（状态中不含类别信息）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及任何剪枝(pruning)、量化(quantization)、知识蒸馏(knowledge distillation)、NAS、轻量网络设计或边缘/星上部署相关方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。该工作面向可解释性而非部署优化。

Datasets and metrics: 使用7个来自不同领域、规模各异的数据集。评价指标包括：收敛速度(convergence speed)、奖励优化(reward optimization)、episode length、CFE有效性(validity)、以及SHAP和LIME值用于特征重要性分析。

Experiments: 对比class-aware RL与class-blind RL两种方法。结果显示class-aware RL在训练阶段具有更快的收敛速度、更优的奖励优化和更短的episode length，并生成显著更多有效的CFEs。SHAP和LIME分析表明实例的类别特征在RL的action-selection中始终是最具影响力的预测因子之一。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：(1) 该方法仅针对通用分类任务的可解释性，未涉及遥感目标检测场景；(2) 未讨论计算开销和部署可行性；(3) 未说明RL训练的成本和稳定性问题；(4) 未涉及检测任务（如bounding box回归、NMS等）中的可解释性。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可考虑：(1) 若未来课题涉及RL-based的检测或压缩策略（如RL-driven pruning/quantization），可借鉴"在状态表示中加入类别/任务语义信息"的设计思路，可能提升策略学习的效率和收敛速度；(2) SHAP/LIME用于分析RL决策中关键特征的方法，可迁移到分析轻量化模型压缩后哪些特征/通道对检测性能影响最大，辅助剪枝决策。但整体上该论文与本课题关联度很低。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) enhance the interpretability of black-box models by generating alternative instances with adjusted feature values that achieve a contrastive outcome. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach for CFE generation, enabling efficient exploration of counterfactual instances while ensuring control over key metrics like validity, sparsity, and proximity. Previous studies have formulated RL states exclusively using features derived from the predictors in the supervised dataset. This study explores the impact of including an instance's predicted class, alongside features derived from the predictors, in the RL state representation for generating CFEs. The hypothesis is that class-awareness enhances exploration efficiency and improves policy optimality. We compare the proposed class-aware RL method with the class-blind RL method, which is similar but excludes the instance's class information from the state representation. The comparison was conducted using seven datasets from diverse domains, varying in size. The results show that during training, class-aware RL offers benefits in terms of convergence speed, reward optimization, and episode length reduction. Moreover, it generates significantly more valid CFEs compared to class-blind RL. Finally, the instance's class-based feature consistently ranks among the most influential predictors in RL's action-selection, as shown by the SHAP and LIME values, underscoring the significance of class-awareness in RL for CFE generation. The impact is heightened clarity, faster learning, improved validity, and more effective counterfactual generation across diverse datasets.

</details>


### [350] [S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27913)
*Glenn Anta Bucagu,Thorir Mar Ingolfsson,Yawei Li,Luca Benini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出S-CEReBrO，一种面向连续脑电信号(EEG)监测的流式Transformer架构，通过Windowed Alternating Attention机制将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，保证KV cache内存恒定，支持比全自注意力长100倍、比低秩线性注意力长3倍的信号处理，并在11个下游任务中7个达到SOTA。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文面向的是Electroencephalography (EEG)脑电信号分析，属于生物医学信号处理领域，与遥感/卫星/地球观测完全无关。但论文提出的Windowed Alternating Attention机制（固定窗口注意力分解、恒定KV cache内存）在长序列高效推理和内存优化方面，对遥感视频流/长时序遥感数据的在轨实时处理具有方法论上的借鉴意义。然而它不涉及遥感目标检测，也不涉及剪枝/量化/蒸馏等经典轻量化手段，因此整体相关性较弱。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感/卫星/目标检测无直接关联，但Windowed Alternating Attention机制对长序列流式推理的内存优化思路，对遥感视频流在轨处理有一定借鉴价值。如果课题涉及遥感视频流/长时序数据的Transformer高效推理，可精读其注意力机制设计；否则仅需泛读了解思路即可。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：EEG脑电信号连续监测与下游分类任务（11个下游任务）。应用场景：连续脑电监测（continuous monitoring），非遥感场景。传感器类型：EEG电极信号（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：脑电信号相关的下游任务类别，摘要未具体说明。

Model architecture: 基于CEReBrO架构的演化版本S-CEReBrO。核心创新是Windowed Alternating Attention机制：将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口（fixed-size spatiotemporal windows），仅活动窗口需要驻留注意力图，从而保证KV cache内存恒定。属于Transformer架构，预训练数据来自>25,000小时、>12,000名受试者的记录。

Lightweight method: 该论文的轻量化思路并非传统模型压缩手段（剪枝/量化/蒸馏/NAS），而是通过注意力机制的架构级优化实现内存和计算效率提升：Windowed Alternating Attention将全局注意力分解为固定窗口注意力，使KV cache内存与信号时长解耦（恒定内存），从而支持超长序列的流式推理。相比低秩线性注意力，内存占用降低至55%，推理吞吐提升2.1倍，参数减少最多60%。这属于"高效注意力架构设计"范畴，而非经典轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明具体部署平台（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等）。但提供了关键效率指标：windowed alternating attention可处理比全自注意力长100倍、比低秩线性注意力长3倍的信号；相比低秩线性注意力，内存占用为55%，推理吞吐提升2.1倍；参数最多减少60%。这些指标表明其在内存受限场景（如边缘/星上设备）具有潜在可行性，但摘要未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗等部署数据。

Datasets and metrics: 预训练数据：>25,000小时EEG记录，来自>12,000名受试者。评估：11个下游任务，S-CEReBrO在其中7个达到state-of-the-art。摘要未说明具体数据集名称、评价指标（如准确率、F1等）的具体数值。

Experiments: 主要实验包括：(1) 缩放分析（scaling analysis）验证windowed alternating attention可处理比全自注意力长100倍、比低秩线性注意力长3倍的信号；(2) 与低秩线性注意力在长上下文上的对比：内存为55%，推理吞吐提升2.1倍；(3) 11个下游任务中7个达到SOTA，参数最多减少60%。摘要未提供消融实验细节和具体对比数值。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于生物医学信号处理领域；2. 摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗等部署指标；3. 未涉及遥感目标检测任务（如舰船/飞机/车辆检测）；4. 未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏等经典轻量化技术；5. 窗口注意力机制在遥感高分辨率图像（非时序信号）上的适用性未知；6. 摘要未说明窗口大小选择策略及其对精度的影响。

Ideas for my research: 1. **窗口化注意力思想可迁移**：遥感视频流/长时序遥感数据（如视频卫星连续观测）在轨处理时，可借鉴Windowed Alternating Attention的"固定窗口+恒定KV cache"思路，解决Transformer在长序列上的内存溢出问题，实现流式在轨推理。2. **时空窗口分解**：遥感视频目标检测中，可将时空注意力分解为固定大小的时空窗口，降低显存占用，支持连续帧流式处理。3. **内存-吞吐权衡分析**：论文展示了窗口注意力在内存和吞吐上的量化优势，这种"内存恒定"设计对星上有限显存资源极具参考价值。4. **参数效率**：60%参数减少的结论提示，通过注意力机制重构而非简单剪枝，也能获得显著的参数压缩效果。5. **预训练-微调范式**：大规模预训练+下游微调范式在遥感领域同样适用，可借鉴其多任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.

</details>


### [351] [Exact Action Values Are Not Enough: Rollout-Verified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of a Reasoning Model for Multi-Zone VAV Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27914)
*Takumi Shioda,Kohei Terashima,Tatsuo Nagai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多区域变风量（VAV）暖通空调系统的控制问题，探索用前沿推理大模型（LLM）和TD3引导的强化微调（RFT）实现无需建筑特定训练的控制，并审计了critic在rollout验证下的可靠性缺陷。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文属于建筑暖通空调（HVAC）控制领域，涉及强化学习、大模型推理和模型微调，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。唯一的间接关联在于"将大模型知识迁移到本地可部署的开源权重模型"这一思路与知识蒸馏/模型压缩有概念上的相似性，但场景和方法均非遥感目标检测。

Reading priority: 1分。本文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于建筑HVAC控制领域。虽然"大模型知识迁移到小模型"的RFT思路和critic审计方法有一定方法论借鉴价值，但整体相关性极低，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多区域变风量（VAV）暖通空调系统的控制策略优化。应用场景：建筑能源管理。传感器类型：温度、CO2浓度传感器。目标类别：不涉及目标检测，属于连续控制（continuous control）问题。

Model architecture: 涉及三类控制器：(1) 前沿推理大模型（GPT-5，LLM with inference-time computation）；(2) TD3（Twin Delayed DDPG）强化学习智能体；(3) 开源权重模型（open-weight model）经TD3引导的强化微调（RFT）。此外包含一个learned critic用于动作评分。

Lightweight method: 本文的核心轻量化思路是"知识迁移/微调"：将前沿大模型（GPT-5）的控制知识通过TD3引导的强化微调（RFT）迁移到本地可部署的开源权重模型，避免建筑特定训练。这与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）思想有概念相似性，但并非针对遥感模型的剪枝、量化或NAS。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs等具体压缩指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明具体部署指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗）。仅提及目标是"locally deployable open-weight model"，即本地可部署的开源权重模型，但未给出任何量化部署性能数据。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：基于物理的四区域仿真器（physics-based four-zone emulator），在三个夏季日进行评测。评价指标：HVAC电力消耗（electricity）、温度合规性（temperature compliance）、CO2合规性、通风裕度（ventilation margin）、五分钟预测误差（five-minute predictions vs persistence）、critic的跨时间相关性（r=0.9998）。

Experiments: 对比了五种控制器。主要结果：(1) 相对Guideline 36基线，TD3降低HVAC电力4.5%并改善温度和CO2合规；(2) GPT-5无需建筑特定训练即实现最大降耗6.2%，但降低了通风裕度；(3) RFT的critic审计发现：尽管跨时间相关性接近完美（r=0.9998），但within-state排序不可靠，critic仅在10个状态中的5个选出rollout最优动作；(4) 200步RFT未产生持续的采样动作回报提升，开源权重模型训练前后用电均高于基线，五分钟预测仍差于persistence；(5) GPT-5的转移预测远优于开源模型。结论建议在基于价值的RFT之前先进行转移误差导向的监督微调。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：模型参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟、部署硬件等关键部署信息。核心局限在于：RFT方法未能成功将大模型知识迁移到开源小模型，critic的within-state排序不可靠导致验证失效，200步RFT无持续改进。此外，实验仅在仿真环境三个夏季日进行，规模有限。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不同，本文有几个方法论上的借鉴点：(1) "大模型知识迁移到本地可部署小模型"的RFT思路，与遥感领域用大模型蒸馏到星上轻量检测模型有概念对应，但需注意critic/teacher评估的可靠性问题——本文揭示的"跨时间相关性高但within-state排序不可靠"的审计陷阱，对遥感检测蒸馏中teacher模型评估指标的选择有警示意义；(2) 强调"transition error"（转移误差）是知识迁移失败的关键，提示在遥感检测蒸馏中应关注中间特征/表征层面的对齐，而非仅关注最终输出；(3) 用rollout验证器审计teacher/critic的可靠性，可作为遥感检测模型蒸馏时验证teacher质量的参考方法。

Abstract: Multi-zone variable-air-volume control must balance thermal comfort, indoor air quality, and electricity use across several continuous actuators. Model predictive control and reinforcement learning are widely studied, but deployment typically requires building-specific modeling or training, limiting scalability. We first test whether a frontier reasoning model (an LLM trained to use additional inference-time computation) can achieve competitive VAV control from text without building-specific training. With that capability established, we then test whether TD3-guided reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) can transfer control knowledge into a locally deployable open-weight model. Five controllers are evaluated over three summer days in a physics-based four-zone emulator. Relative to a Guideline 36-based baseline, TD3 reduced HVAC electricity by 4.5% while improving temperature and CO$_2$ compliance. Without building-specific training, GPT-5 achieved the largest reduction (6.2%) but reduced the ventilation margin. For RFT, deterministic rollouts restore a saved state, apply one candidate, and follow TD3 to score each action. Auditing a learned critic against these rollouts exposed a failure hidden by its near-perfect across-time correlation ($r=0.9998$): within-state ranking was unreliable; the critic selected the rollout-best candidate in only 5 of 10 states. Even with the rollout verifier, 200 RFT steps produced no sustained improvement in sampled-action return; the open-weight controller used more electricity than the baseline before and after training, and its five-minute predictions remained worse than persistence. GPT-5 predicted transitions far better. Exact rollout scores rank sampled actions but reveal neither next-state effects nor an improvement direction. The unchanged transition errors motivate transition-focused supervised fine-tuning before value-based RFT.

</details>


### [352] [Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27928)
*Xiang Yuan,Kaiqing Lei,Zhenyu Jin,Jun Shu,Deyu Meng,Zongben Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于贝叶斯推断的域权重学习方法（Bayesian domain weighting），通过引入Gamma先验从Dirichlet分布推断多域预训练数据的最优混合权重，相比搜索式函数拟合方法更稳定高效且消耗更少数据。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）多域预训练数据的权重分配优化问题，属于自然语言处理/机器学习领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。既非遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或模型压缩/加速方法。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于LLM预训练数据配比优化方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化课题基本无关，不涉及目标检测、遥感场景或任何模型压缩/加速技术，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多域预训练数据的域权重优化（domain weighting）；应用场景：大语言模型预训练数据混合配比；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明具体领域类别。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。核心方法为贝叶斯推断框架：从Dirichlet分布推断域权重，引入Gamma先验（Gamma prior）利用观测数据学习先验信息，属于统计推断方法而非神经网络架构设计。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。该论文不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速方法。其"高效"体现在数据采样效率上（消耗更少数据即可学习最优权重），而非模型推理效率。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文面向LLM预训练阶段的数据配比优化，不涉及推理部署、星上部署、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及通过验证损失（validation losses）作为优化目标，以及对比了搜索式函数拟合方法（search-based function-fitting methods）。

Experiments: 摘要仅给出定性结论：所提方法能实现稳定且高效的域权重学习，在消耗显著更少数据的情况下识别出最优混合配比，优于搜索式函数拟合方法。未提供具体数值结果、对比表格或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。潜在问题包括：1）方法针对LLM预训练数据配比，与遥感目标检测任务无直接迁移路径；2）未报告计算开销、收敛速度等量化指标；3）未讨论在视觉/遥感数据上的泛化能力。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但存在间接启发：1）贝叶斯推断框架（Dirichlet分布 + Gamma先验）的思想可用于遥感多源数据（光学/SAR/高光谱）的融合权重自适应学习，优化多模态遥感目标检测中的模态配比；2）其"从数据直接优化权重而非依赖强结构假设"的思路，可类比于遥感检测中多任务损失权重或多尺度特征融合权重的自适应学习。但整体上与本课题（在轨目标检测模型轻量化）关联较弱。

Abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize validation losses. These methods rely on strong structural assumptions, such as rank invariance or scaling laws, which are often violated, resulting in non-negligible estimation bias. A promising approach is to directly optimize the weighting scheme from data. However, it suffers from unstable optimization trajectory and prohibitive computational overhead, limiting its potential to search better domain weights configurations. This paper presents a Bayesian domain weighting method to infer the weights from a Dirichlet distribution via introducing Gamma prior information learned from observations. Experimental results demonstrate that proposed method could achieve stable and efficient domain weights learning, and identifies optimal mixtures while consuming substantially less data than search-based function-fitting methods, revitalizing optimization-based domain weighting for large-scale applications.

</details>


### [353] [TriShield: Zero-Utility-Loss Defense Against Privacy Backdoors in Federated Language Model Fine-Tuning via Orthogonal Gradient Projection and Optimizer State Entanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27940)
*Cheng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TriShield，一种三层确定性防御机制，用于完全阻止联邦微调LLM中NeuroImprint风格的隐私后门重建攻击，在零模型效用损失和零额外通信轮次下将重建率降至0%。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于联邦学习（Federated Learning）中大型语言模型（LLM）微调的隐私安全防御，属于隐私保护与联邦学习安全领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化/部署。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于联邦学习隐私安全领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。仅当对SVD子空间投影或联邦学习场景下的模型部署感兴趣时可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：联邦微调（Federated fine-tuning）中的隐私攻击防御；应用场景：分布式LLM协作训练中的隐私保护；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明具体应用场景。

Model architecture: TriShield由三层组成：(1) Parameter Artifact Detector——在本地训练开始前识别分布式模型参数中的记忆神经元签名；(2) Stateful Virtual Iteration——强制Adam/AdamW的动量状态在虚拟步骤间不可逆地纠缠梯度，使NeuroImprint的闭式反演失效；(3) Zero-Utility Orthogonal Projection——通过SVD将本地梯度更新投影到主任务语义子空间，物理消除携带私有记忆的梯度分量。实验模型为GPT-2 (117M)和Llama-Guard-3-1B。

Lightweight method: 不涉及模型轻量化。论文关注的是隐私防御机制，而非模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏或NAS等轻量化方法。虽然提到"less than 5% additional GPU computation overhead"，但这是防御机制的计算开销，并非模型轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，不报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。仅提及防御机制带来不到5%的额外GPU计算开销。

Datasets and metrics: 实验在GPT-2 (117M)和Llama-Guard-3-1B上进行；评价指标为NeuroImprint重建率（reconstruction rate），TriShield将其降至0%；同时评估训练准确率（maintaining or improving training accuracy）和额外GPU计算开销（<5%）。摘要未说明具体训练数据集。

Experiments: 实验验证TriShield在所有测试的攻击变体下将NeuroImprint重建率降至0%，同时保持或提升训练准确率，额外GPU计算开销小于5%。论文还从理论上证明经过第2、3层后，上传梯度与任何单个训练样本之间的互信息为零。摘要未说明与现有防御方法（LDP、gradient clipping）的详细对比实验数据。

Limitations: 1. 论文聚焦联邦学习隐私安全，与遥感在轨目标检测和轻量化完全无关；2. 摘要未说明TriShield在更大规模模型或异构数据分布下的表现；3. 摘要未说明防御机制对模型收敛速度、通信效率的影响细节；4. 摘要未说明该方法是否适用于非LLM架构（如CNN目标检测模型）。

Ideas for my research: 虽然该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但存在一些间接可借鉴的思维：1. SVD正交投影的思想——在遥感目标检测模型轻量化中，可利用SVD对特征图或权重矩阵进行低秩分解，实现模型压缩；2. 梯度/参数子空间分析的方法论——可用于分析轻量化剪枝/蒸馏过程中哪些参数分量对检测精度贡献最大，指导结构化剪枝策略。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enables collaborative training without exposing raw data. However, a recent attack, NeuroImprint [1] (arXiv:2606.20553), demonstrates that a malicious parameter server can corrupt a PEFT adapter into a privacy backdoor: by assigning a dedicated memorization neuron to each training sample and ensuring each neuron updates at most once, the server can analytically reconstruct 59\%--79\% of client training data with high semantic fidelity. Existing defenses---including local differential privacy (LDP) [8] and gradient clipping---either fail against this attack or impose unacceptable utility degradation. We present \textbf{TriShield}, a three-layer deterministic defense that completely prevents NeuroImprint-style reconstruction with \textbf{zero model utility loss} and \textbf{no additional communication rounds}. TriShield consists of: (1) a \textbf{Parameter Artifact Detector} that identifies memory-neuron signatures in distributed model parameters before local training begins; (2) a \textbf{Stateful Virtual Iteration} mechanism that forces Adam/AdamW's momentum state to irreversibly entangle gradients across virtual steps, invalidating NeuroImprint's closed-form inversion; and (3) a \textbf{Zero-Utility Orthogonal Projection} operator that projects all local gradient updates onto the main-task semantic subspace computed via SVD, physically eliminating any gradient components that carry private memorization. We prove theoretically that after Layers 2 and 3, the mutual information between the uploaded gradient and any individual training sample is zero. Experiments on GPT-2 (117M) and Llama-Guard-3-1B verify that TriShield reduces NeuroImprint reconstruction rate to \textbf{0\%} across all tested attack variants, while maintaining or improving training accuracy, with less than 5\% additional GPU computation overhead.

</details>


### [354] [AutoPref: Automatic Discovery of Task-Specific Preference Objectives for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27953)
*Shengda Gu,Kai Li,Xinyi Ke,Haobo Fu,Yifan Zhang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AutoPref，首个利用LLM引导自动发现神经组合优化(NCO)偏好目标函数的框架，将偏好目标分解为成对损失程序和集合感知加权程序，通过分阶段条件搜索与行为门控在TSP、CVRP、FFSP、JSSP等组合优化问题上超越手工设计基线。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于神经组合优化(NCO)中的偏好目标函数自动发现，属于运筹优化与机器学习交叉领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等任何遥感相关场景，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等模型轻量化方法。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为神经组合优化中的偏好目标自动发现，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。仅当对LLM引导的自动化设计空间搜索方法论感兴趣时，可作为泛化启发参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：神经组合优化(NCO)中的偏好目标函数自动发现；应用场景：TSP、CVRP、FFSP、JSSP等经典组合优化问题；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用（优化问题而非视觉检测）。

Model architecture: AutoPref框架将偏好目标函数分解为两个程序化组件：(1) pairwise loss program——定义从每对解中提取的学习信号；(2) set-aware weighting program——决定每对解相对采样集合的贡献权重。两者组合形成统一的程序化目标空间，涵盖现有偏好目标作为特例。采用LLM引导的分阶段条件搜索策略，配合behavioral gates过滤不可行程序后再进行短时训练与评估。

Lightweight method: 不涉及模型轻量化。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计、边缘部署或实时推理等任何模型压缩与加速方法。摘要未说明。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及星上/边缘部署。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向离线训练阶段的优化目标设计，与在轨推理部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 实验在TSP、CVRP、FFSP、JSSP四个组合优化问题上进行，覆盖不同问题规模。评价指标为解的质量（如最优性差距/求解质量），具体指标名称摘要未说明。不涉及视觉数据集或检测指标（如mAP、IoU等）。

Experiments: AutoPref在TSP、CVRP、FFSP、JSSP上跨问题规模一致优于强手工设计基线，验证了自动目标发现方法的有效性与可扩展性。具体数值结果、对比方法细节和消融实验摘要未说明。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，无法直接提供遥感目标检测或轻量化方面的局限性分析。从自身领域看，摘要未说明LLM引导搜索的计算开销、搜索时间成本、对问题规模的可扩展性上限，以及自动发现的目标函数是否可解释、是否可迁移到未见过的COPs等问题。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化无直接关联，但存在一个间接的方法论借鉴点：AutoPref利用LLM引导自动搜索目标函数/设计空间的思想，可类比迁移到轻量化模型设计中——例如用LLM引导自动搜索轻量化检测模型的剪枝策略、量化位宽配置或NAS搜索空间，实现面向星上部署约束（如FLOPs、延迟、能耗）的自动化设计空间探索。但这种借鉴属于方法论层面的泛化启发，并非直接可复用的技术。

Abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) underpin many real-world decisions, but their exponentially large search spaces make high-quality solutions costly to obtain. Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) learns fast construction policies, typically with reinforcement learning (RL), while preference-based NCO improves sample efficiency by learning from relative solution quality. However, existing preference objectives combine two distinct design choices in manually specified, one-size-fits-all formulations: what learning signal to extract from each solution pair and how to weight each pair relative to the sampled set. We present AutoPref, the first LLM-guided framework for automated preference-objective discovery in NCO. AutoPref factorizes the objective into a pairwise loss program, which defines the learning signal, and a set-aware weighting program, which determines each pair's relative contribution. Their composition forms a unified programmatic objective space containing existing preference objectives as special cases. To make its search tractable, we introduce a staged conditional search strategy with behavioral gates that filter inadmissible programs before short-horizon training and evaluation. Across TSP, CVRP, FFSP, and JSSP, AutoPref consistently outperforms strong hand-designed baselines across problem scales, demonstrating the benefits and scalability of automated objective discovery for NCO.

</details>


### [355] [What Makes Graph Unified? Principles and Generative Sliding-Window Transformer for Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27966)
*Dongxiao He,Siqi Liu,Jitao Zhao,Yawen Li,Yi Wang,Di Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SliGFM，一种基于拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码和生成式重建的图基础模型，用于跨域图特征统一，解决异构节点特征维度与语义不一致的问题。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文聚焦于Graph Foundation Models（图基础模型）的跨域图特征统一问题，属于图学习/图神经网络领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及模型压缩或边缘部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于图基础模型领域的独立工作，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：跨域图学习（cross-domain graph learning）中的特征统一（feature unification）。应用场景：通用图基础模型，面向多样化的图数据域。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: SliGFM包含两个核心组件：(1) 拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码器（topology-aware sliding-window feature encoder），按拓扑平滑度对特征维度排序后，用共享滑动窗口编码器将异构特征转换为有序固定维度的特征token；(2) 平滑感知Transformer（smoothness-aware transformer），捕获节点内特征token间的可迁移关系模式；配合生成式重建目标（generative reconstruction objective）保持原始特征信息。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。该工作面向通用图学习，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。未提及具体数据集名称、评价指标或实验设置。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。未提供对比方法、消融实验或定量结果。

Limitations: 摘要仅提出概念框架和模型设计，未给出实验验证结果。此外，该工作面向通用图学习，与遥感在轨目标检测场景完全脱节，缺乏对遥感数据特性（如多光谱/高光谱特征、空间分辨率、目标尺度分布）的考虑。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能相关的思路是：如果遥感目标检测中涉及图结构建模（如场景图、目标关系图），其"拓扑感知的特征维度排序+滑动窗口编码"思想或许可用于统一不同传感器（光学/SAR）的特征表示，但这一关联非常间接。整体而言，该论文对本课题的直接可借鉴点极少。

Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose graph learning, aiming to learn reusable knowledge that generalizes across diverse graph domains and downstream tasks, reducing the need for specific model development. Achieving this goal requires reconciling the substantial heterogeneity in node features, graph structures, and semantic information across domains. Among them, heterogeneous node features constitute a fundamental input-level barrier, as their dimensionality and semantics vary substantially across datasets. Existing studies typically project or map heterogeneous node features into a fixed-dimensional space, often implicitly equating dimensional uniformity with effective feature unification. Yet dimensional consistency alone does not ensure that the unified features preserve informative semantics and capture transferable patterns that can support cross-domain knowledge transfer. To bridge this conceptual gap, we distill four desiderata for cross-domain graph feature unification: formal uniformity, cross-domain transferability, information preservation, and backbone compatibility. Guided by these principles, we propose SliGFM, a graph foundation model built upon topology-aware sliding-window feature encoding and generative reconstruction. SliGFM orders feature dimensions by topological smoothness and scans the reordered features with a shared sliding-window feature encoder, transforming heterogeneous features into a common space of ordered fixed-dimensional feature tokens. This formulation enables a smoothness-aware transformer to capture transferable relational patterns among feature tokens within each node, while the generative reconstruction objective encourages preservation of the original feature information.

</details>


### [356] [Beyond Binary Rewards: A Comparative Study of Reward Design for Reinforcement Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27968)
*Efstratios Zaradoukas,Davide Gabrielli,Bardh Prenkaj,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究机器遗忘（machine unlearning）中的奖励函数设计，提出指数奖励和PageRank启发奖励两种新的奖励函数，在RWKU基准上实现比二元奖励快3倍的遗忘收敛速度。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文属于泛机器学习/大语言模型领域，研究的是machine unlearning（机器遗忘）问题，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。虽然"unlearning"在概念上涉及模型参数的高效更新，但研究对象是语言模型而非遥感目标检测模型，且不涉及任何轻量化方法（pruning/quantization/distillation等）。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于大语言模型隐私合规领域。除非对"奖励/损失函数设计"的通用方法论感兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：machine unlearning（机器遗忘），即在已训练的语言模型中选择性移除特定知识。应用场景：隐私合规（GDPR、EU AI Act）。传感器类型：不适用（文本/语言模型）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。研究基于Reinforcement Unlearning (RUL)框架，将unlearning重构为Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)问题，即用强化学习优化模型输出上的可验证奖励。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及传统轻量化方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等）。本文的"效率"体现在遗忘收敛速度（3× faster），而非模型压缩或推理加速。与在轨部署所需的模型轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。本文面向语言模型训练/微调阶段，而非推理部署阶段。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) benchmark。评价指标：forgetting performance（遗忘性能）、general model utility（通用模型效用）、收敛速度（3× faster）。

Experiments: 在RWKU基准上对比了两种新奖励函数（exponential reward和PageRank-inspired reward）与baseline二元稀疏奖励（binary reward）。结果表明两种新奖励均一致优于二元设置，在达到相似遗忘性能的同时收敛速度快3倍，且保持通用模型效用。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：1）研究对象是语言模型而非视觉/遥感模型；2）不涉及任何遥感场景或目标检测任务；3）不涉及模型压缩或推理加速；4）奖励函数设计思路虽有一定方法论价值，但与在轨部署的硬件约束（算力、功耗、内存）完全脱节。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但有一个概念层面的启发：本文强调"reward design是效率的关键驱动因素"，这一思路在模型压缩/蒸馏场景中可类比为"loss/蒸馏目标设计是压缩效率的关键"。例如，在知识蒸馏中设计更细粒度的、基于语义重要性的蒸馏损失（类似PageRank加权思想），可能比均匀的KL散度损失更高效。此外，将"稀疏二元信号"替换为"分级连续信号"的思想，可类比于在剪枝或量化中设计更平滑的重要性评分函数。但这些仅是方法论层面的间接借鉴，与遥感在轨检测轻量化的直接关联很弱。

Abstract: Machine unlearning seeks to selectively remove specific knowledge from trained language models without full retraining, a growing necessity under privacy regulations such as GDPR and the EU AI Act. Recent work has reformulated unlearning as a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) problem, where models are optimized against verifiable rewards computed directly from their outputs. However, existing methods rely on sparse binary rewards that provide minimal learning signal, indicating only whether forbidden content was avoided, and limiting convergence speed. In this paper, we study how reward design affects unlearning efficiency within the Reinforcement Unlearning (RUL) framework. We introduce a principled reward decomposition framework that decouples verifiability from sparsity, and propose two new reward functions: an exponential reward that provides graded penalties based on the count of forbidden-concept occurrences, and a PageRank inspired reward that weights penalties by semantic importance. We conduct experiments on the Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) benchmark, demonstrating that both rewards consistently outperform the binary setting, while reaching similar forgetting performance up to $3\times$ faster and preserving general model utility. Our results show that reward design is a key driver of unlearning efficiency offering a practical path toward scalable and efficient machine unlearning.

</details>


### [357] [TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27973)
*Cong Li,Peixi Peng,Yisen Zhao,Xinyu Hu,Shudong Liu,Zhan Su,Zhuojian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TAPO（Transition-Aware Policy Optimization），一种面向LLM智能体的过渡感知策略优化框架，通过动作条件化的下一观测预测监督来增强模型对环境动态的敏感性，作为轻量即插即用模块提升现有智能体RL算法的任务性能。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于Large Language Model (LLM) agents的强化学习后训练，属于自然语言处理与通用智能体领域，不涉及remote sensing、satellite、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等模型压缩或边缘部署方法。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于LLM强化学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，仅在"辅助预测监督"和"即插即用模块"的抽象方法论层面有极弱的间接启发，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体的强化学习后训练（post-training）与策略优化。应用场景：WebShop（在线购物）和ALFWorld（具身家居任务）等文本交互环境。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非视觉目标检测）。

Model architecture: TAPO框架在共享backbone模型上交替进行策略优化（policy optimization）和过渡监督（transition supervision）。具体地，在标准RL更新之外，利用rollout数据施加action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision，即基于动作条件化的下一观测预测监督。该模块设计为plug-and-play增强模块，可集成到现有agent RL算法中。

Lightweight method: 论文声称TAPO是"computationally lightweight"的即插即用增强模块，不需要额外的专家数据、额外的采样成本或推理时开销。但这里的"lightweight"指的是训练框架的计算开销低，并非模型压缩意义上的轻量化（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等），与遥感模型轻量化部署无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。其"lightweight"仅指训练阶段的计算开销，与在轨推理部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 实验数据集：WebShop和ALFWorld。评价指标：任务性能（task performance），具体指标名称摘要未说明。实验设置：集成不同规模的基础模型（foundation models of various scales）与不同的策略优化算法（policy optimization algorithms）进行系统实验。

Experiments: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上，将TAPO与不同规模的foundation models及不同policy optimization算法结合，实验结果表明TAPO相比纯策略优化baseline一致地提升了任务性能（consistently improves task performance）。具体数值、对比方法细节和消融实验摘要未说明。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：论文完全面向LLM智能体文本交互任务，与遥感视觉目标检测场景无直接关联；其"lightweight"概念与模型压缩/边缘部署的轻量化含义不同；未提供任何遥感数据、视觉检测指标或部署性能数据。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感在轨目标检测弱相关，但存在一个可借鉴的抽象思想：TAPO通过"动作条件化的下一观测预测"作为dense supervisory signal来增强模型对环境动态的敏感性。这一"预测性辅助监督"思想可类比迁移到遥感目标检测中——例如在检测模型训练时引入对下一帧/下一时刻场景变化的预测性辅助任务，增强模型对时序环境动态的建模能力（适用于视频卫星或连续观测场景）。此外，其"plug-and-play、无需额外采样成本"的模块化设计思路，对在轨检测模型的增量式轻量化改进（如在不改变推理结构的前提下加入辅助训练目标）有一定启发。但整体而言，该论文对遥感轻量化课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.

</details>


### [358] [Generalization Bounds on Optimal Control for Transformer Training and Wasserstein Distributional Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27975)
*Kağan Akman,Naci Saldi,Serdar Yüksel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论层面推导了使用动态规划递归训练的Transformer的有限样本泛化界，将训练问题建模为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题，并利用量化模型和Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化建立泛化保证。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文是纯理论性的机器学习泛化分析，聚焦Transformer的泛化界推导，既不涉及遥感/卫星场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化/部署。虽然文中提到"quantized model"（量化模型），但这里的量化是指对状态、动作和测度状态空间的数学量化以推导泛化界，并非工程意义上的模型量化压缩（quantization for deployment）。因此与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，仅作为泛视觉/泛机器学习理论方法具有极弱参考价值。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文为纯理论Transformer泛化分析，与遥感、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联，对课题无实质借鉴价值，仅当对Transformer泛化理论或分布鲁棒优化感兴趣时可作背景阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：Transformer泛化理论分析（generalization bounds）。应用场景：非遥感，纯理论机器学习。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 研究对象为Transformer，采用"doubly lifted, measure-valued formulation"（双重提升、测度值公式化）描述Transformer动力学，将数据集视为经验输入-输出测度对上的概率律，训练问题被解释为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题（finite-horizon Markovian control problem）。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提到的"quantized model"是对状态（state）、动作（action）和测度状态空间（measure-state spaces）进行数学量化以推导泛化界，属于理论分析工具，并非模型压缩/加速方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。摘要未说明任何面向部署的轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息，属于纯理论分析。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。本文为理论推导，未提及任何实验数据集或评价指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。本文为纯理论工作，未提及实验对比或消融实验。主要贡献为：1) 将Transformer训练建模为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题；2) 通过量化模型推导显式有限样本泛化界；3) 将泛化界与Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化（distributionally robust optimization）建立联系。

Limitations: 1) 纯理论论文，无实验验证，泛化界的实际紧致性和可操作性未知；2) 摘要中的"quantization"是数学空间量化而非工程模型量化，容易被误读为轻量化方法；3) 与遥感、目标检测、在轨部署等应用场景完全脱节；4) 泛化界推导基于Lipschitz稳定性估计和有限度量空间经验律的集中不等式，对实际深度网络训练的指导意义有限。

Ideas for my research: 1) 本文的Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化框架可作为理论参考，若未来研究轻量化模型在数据分布偏移（如不同遥感传感器、不同光照/天气条件）下的鲁棒性，可借鉴其分布鲁棒控制思想；2) 其"量化模型到基模型的误差转移"思路在概念上类似于知识蒸馏中"教师-学生"误差分析，但需自行建立与蒸馏的联系；3) 总体而言，本文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低，不建议投入过多时间精读。

Abstract: We derive finite-sample generalization bounds for Transformers trained with dynamic programming recursions. Building on the doubly lifted, measure-valued formulation of Transformer dynamics, we view data sets as probability laws on pairs of empirical input-output measures, allowing us to interpret the training problem as a finite-horizon Markovian control problem. We then analyze a quantized model, derived by quantizing the state, action, and measure-state spaces, and derive explicit finite-sample generalization bounds using concentration inequalities for empirical laws on finite metric spaces together with a Lipschitz stability estimate for the value function. These bounds are transferred to the base model at the cost of an explicit approximation error. Finally, we show that the same machinery yields a distributionally robust control formulation of the training problem, connecting Transformer generalization to Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization.

</details>


### [359] [It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27987)
*Florian Fervers,Sebastian Bullinger,Christoph Bodensteiner,Michael Arens*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 einx，一种通用的张量操作符号表示法，通过向量化（vectorization）统一和简化现有张量框架（如 NumPy、einsum、einops）的复杂 API，使张量编程更易读、易写且不易出错。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于张量编程的符号表示与编程范式改进，属于编程语言/科学计算工具方向，不涉及遥感、目标检测、模型压缩或边缘部署等任何相关主题。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于编程语言/张量工具方向，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：张量操作编程范式设计（tensor programming paradigm）。应用场景：通用科学计算与深度学习框架的代码编写。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。论文提出的是 einx 张量操作符号系统，基于 vectorization（向量化）概念，将高阶操作分解为低阶操作及其向量化，用声明式、点式（pointful）表达式类比循环符号（loop notation）来表示张量操作。

Lightweight method: 不涉及模型轻量化。论文讨论的是张量编程符号的简化（将大型 API 缩减为少量基本操作），而非神经网络模型的剪枝、量化、蒸馏或 NAS 等压缩方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。einx 作为编程工具，可能间接影响代码可维护性，但与星上部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。不涉及任何数据集或评价指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验。仅提及提供了 Python 嵌入实现并集成现有张量框架，开源地址为 https://github.com/fferflo/einx。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：einx 作为编程符号工具，其价值在于代码可读性和减少 shape errors，不涉及计算效率优化或模型性能提升；且其适用范围受限于张量框架生态的接受度。

Ideas for my research: 对本课题借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：在实现轻量化模型（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏）的代码时，使用 einx 这类声明式张量符号可能提高代码可读性和减少维度错误，便于快速原型验证。但该论文本身不提供任何与遥感目标检测或模型轻量化直接相关的技术贡献。

Abstract: Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming.
  To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization.
  Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: https://github.com/fferflo/einx

</details>


### [360] [Building a User Foundation Model for the Open Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28019)
*Solal Vernier,Ivan Can Arisoy,Merwan Barlier,Blaž Škrlj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个面向开放网络实时竞价（RTB）场景的用户基础模型，通过自监督学习用户浏览历史（掩码语言建模+序列级对比学习）预训练Transformer编码器，并利用LLM-in-the-loop搜索优化预训练pipeline，在点击预测等多个下游生产任务上取得显著提升。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于电商/社交推荐/开放网络实时竞价（RTB）场景的用户建模，属于推荐系统与广告点击率预测领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等任何遥感相关任务，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等轻量化或边缘/星上部署方法。唯一可能相关的点是使用了Transformer编码器和自监督预训练，但这是泛NLP/序列建模技术，对遥感检测轻量化课题借鉴价值极低。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于推荐系统/广告领域。除非对LLM-as-optimizer自动化优化范式感兴趣，否则无需精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：用户基础模型（user foundation model）预训练与点击预测（click prediction）微调；应用场景：开放网络实时竞价（RTB）、电商与社交推荐；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：用户/广告/浏览会话，非遥感目标。

Model architecture: Transformer encoder，采用masked language modeling（MLM）和序列级对比学习（sequence-level contrastive objective）进行自监督预训练，随后在点击预测任务上微调。预训练pipeline通过LLM-in-the-loop搜索（LLM-as-optimizer范式）在可审查的代码级编辑（lifters）目录中优化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速方法，也未涉及边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。论文面向工业推荐系统部署，而非星上/边缘受限硬件环境。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：开放网络RTB场景下的用户浏览历史数据（工业生产数据），摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标：RIG（Relative Information Gain，用于生产bid win-rate模型和CTR ranker）、CTR（点击率）、eCPC（有效每次点击成本）。实验包括7天在线A/B测试。

Experiments: 主要结果：同一encoder表示在production bid win-rate模型上+1.197% RIG，在production CTR ranker上+1.354% RIG；7天在线A/B测试确认+2.13% CTR、-1.13% eCPC（两个指标80%置信区间均排除零）。摘要未说明与基线方法的详细对比和消融实验。

Limitations: 与本研究方向（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化）完全无关。摘要未提供模型规模、计算开销、部署约束等任何与轻量化/在轨部署相关的信息。该工作面向广告推荐领域，其用户身份碎片化、会话不连续等数据特性与遥感图像数据分布毫无关联。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值极低。唯一可参考的点是：1）自监督预训练（MLM+对比学习）在数据稀缺/碎片化场景下的表征学习思路，可类比遥感小样本/无标注场景下的预训练策略；2）LLM-as-optimizer（LLM-in-the-loop搜索代码级优化）的自动化pipeline优化范式，理论上可迁移到轻量化网络结构搜索或算子级优化中，但需要大量工程改造。整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴意义很小。

Abstract: User foundation models have demonstrated strong results in e-commerce and social recommendation, but most industrial deployments assume environments where user identity is stable and persistent. Open-web real-time bidding (RTB) operates on a structurally different data distribution: user identity is fragmented and non-persistent across browsing sessions, and the availability of browsing history depends on user privacy choices. Consequently, a significant portion of traffic carries no historical data, and available records often consist of relatively short, disjointed sessions. As a result, historical signals in this domain are typically represented as aggregated counters and recency buckets, leaving the sequential structure unexploited. To address this limitation, we present a user foundation model that applies self-supervised learning on user browsing histories and show that the learned representation improves multiple downstream production tasks, demonstrating the viability of this approach on the open web. We pre-train a Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and a sequence-level contrastive objective, then fine-tune it on the click prediction task. We optimize the encoder's pre-training pipeline with an LLM-in-the-loop search over a curated catalog of reviewable, code-level edits (lifters), instantiating the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm in an industrial setting. The same encoder representation yields +1.197% RIG on the production bid win-rate model and +1.354% RIG on the production CTR ranker; a 7-day live A/B test confirms +2.13% CTR, -1.13% eCPC (80% CI excluding zero on both metrics).

</details>


### [361] [Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28022)
*Yuran Wang,Zekun Wang,Bohan Zeng,Ruixu Zhang,Wenxuan Liu,Liu Yang,Yifan Dai,Yang Shi,Bozhou Li,Chengzhuo Tong,Daili Hua,Yuanxing Zhang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Flux-OPD，一种在开放式领域大语言模型训练中利用演化上下文作为训练内监督的在线偏好蒸馏（OPD）范式，通过反向KL目标分解来稳定蒸馏目标并降低上下文教师间的冲突。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的开放式领域训练与在线偏好蒸馏（Online Preference Distillation, OPD），属于自然语言处理/大模型对齐领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。虽然涉及"distillation"（蒸馏）这一与模型压缩相关的技术术语，但此处的蒸馏是LLM偏好蒸馏（preference distillation），而非面向目标检测模型的知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation for detection），目的不是模型压缩或轻量化，而是任务偏好学习。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM偏好蒸馏领域。虽然"冲突加权蒸馏"的思想在抽象层面有一定启发，但缺乏遥感场景、目标检测任务和轻量化部署的任何关联，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型（LLM）开放式领域训练中的偏好蒸馏（preference distillation）。应用场景：开放式（open-ended）任务，如对话、生成等无明确可验证奖励的领域。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 提出Flux-OPD范式，核心思想：将上下文条件教师（context-conditioned teacher）与无上下文教师（context-free teacher）之间的差异视为"上下文差异信号"（contextual difference signals），将其作为上下文修正注入无上下文教师锚点，并用冲突项（conflict term）作为指标来加权修正强度。方法基于反向KL目标（reverse KL objective）的分解分析，揭示学生被蒸馏向上下文条件教师的几何均值，且目标中存在衡量教师间冲突的冲突项。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文中的"distillation"指LLM的偏好蒸馏（preference distillation），用于任务偏好学习，而非面向模型压缩/加速的知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation for model compression）。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等轻量化或部署技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息，也未讨论星上或边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅在开放式任务（open-ended tasks）上进行实验，声称Flux-OPD优于现有OPD范式，但未给出具体数据集、指标或实验细节。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明在开放式任务上Flux-OPD优于现有OPD范式，未给出具体对比方法、消融实验或量化结果。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于LLM对齐与偏好学习领域。2. 摘要未提供数据集、指标、模型规模等实验细节。3. 摘要未说明计算开销、训练成本等实际部署考量。4. 其"蒸馏"概念与目标检测模型压缩中的知识蒸馏在目标和机制上均不同，不可直接迁移。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但存在一个可借鉴的抽象思想：论文通过分解目标函数来识别"冲突项"并据此动态调整教师监督的权重——这一"用冲突/差异信号动态加权监督"的思路，在遥感目标检测的知识蒸馏中可能有启发意义。例如，在遥感小目标检测的蒸馏中，不同尺度特征或不同教师（如大模型教师 vs 轻量教师）对学生的监督可能存在冲突，可借鉴其"以冲突程度作为监督权重指标"的思想来设计自适应蒸馏损失。但需注意，这只是方法论层面的抽象迁移，论文本身不提供任何遥感或检测相关的实现细节。

Abstract: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision. Contexts can convey such preferences, yet provide little additional supervision once distilled into the student, motivating contexts that evolve with student performance. However, directly using evolving contexts as in-training supervision results in an unstable distillation target and conflicting distributions, requiring mechanisms to stabilize target and downweight conflicts. In this paper, we analyze the effect of contexts through a decomposition of the reverse KL objective, revealing two findings: the student is distilled toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, and the objective contains a conflict term that measures conflicts among these teachers. Based on this decomposition, we propose Flux-OPD, an OPD paradigm that uses evolving contexts as in-training supervision to capture task preferences in open-ended domains. Flux-OPD treats the differences between context-conditioned and context-free teachers as contextual difference signals, injects them as contextual corrections into the context-free teacher anchor, and weights their correction strength using the conflict term as an indicator. Experiments on open-ended tasks show that Flux-OPD outperforms existing OPD paradigms, highlighting the potential to combine teacher supervision with evolving contexts.

</details>


### [362] [Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28026)
*Xingjian Wu,Junlin Liu,Xingchen Liu,Xuhang Zhu,Jianing Wang,Linsen Guo,Xiaoyu Li,Xuezhi Cao,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对比强化策略优化（CRPO），从对比学习视角重构智能体自蒸馏（OPSD），利用预测熵区分正负位置以保留可靠的细粒度优化信号，提升长程交互中的训练稳定性与泛化能力。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的后训练优化方法，涉及Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)、On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)和对比学习，属于自然语言处理与强化学习领域。与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关；不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等遥感目标检测任务；也不涉及pruning、quantization、NAS、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等轻量化或部署技术。唯一可能的间接关联是"self-distillation"（自蒸馏）这一概念在模型压缩/轻量化中也有应用，但本文的蒸馏对象是LLM训练过程而非模型压缩，借鉴意义有限。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文面向LLM后训练优化，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。仅当对"熵引导的蒸馏监督筛选"这一思想在遥感知识蒸馏中的迁移感兴趣时，可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型（LLM）后训练优化，具体为多轮智能体（multi-turn agentic）场景下的策略优化。应用场景：推理与深度搜索（reasoning and deep-search）基准测试。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 提出Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO)，将agentic OPSD从对比学习视角重构。核心机制：利用predictive entropy（预测熵）区分positive positions（反思性探索）与negative positions（暴露偏差），进行group-wise contrast（组间对比）以保留可靠的细粒度优化信号。底层模型为LLM策略网络，具体架构细节摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及模型压缩或加速方法。虽然涉及self-distillation（自蒸馏）概念，但这里的蒸馏是作为训练策略（OPSD）而非模型轻量化手段，与pruning、quantization、NAS、知识蒸馏压缩等轻量化技术无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。且该工作面向LLM训练优化，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在13个challenging reasoning和deep-search benchmarks上进行评估。具体数据集名称、评价指标细节摘要未说明。

Experiments: CRPO在13个推理与深度搜索基准上一致优于现有reinforcement learning和self-distillation基线方法，显著提升长程交互（long-horizon interactions）中的训练稳定性与泛化能力。具体对比方法、消融实验细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。主要缺口包括：1）未提供具体数据集名称与指标数值；2）未报告计算开销与训练成本；3）未讨论该方法在视觉/遥感任务上的可迁移性；4）未涉及任何部署或轻量化考量。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可考虑以下间接启发：1）"self-distillation"中利用熵（entropy）区分可靠/不可靠监督信号的思想，或可迁移到遥感目标检测的知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）中，用于筛选teacher输出的可靠区域（如区分背景噪声与真实目标），提升蒸馏质量；2）"group-wise contrast"的对比学习思路，或可用于遥感小目标检测中的特征判别性增强。但整体上该论文与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化课题的直接关联较弱。

Abstract: Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO), which reformulates agentic OPSD from a contrastive learning perspective. By leveraging predictive entropy to distinguish between positive positions (reflective exploration) and negative positions (exposure bias), CRPO conducts group-wise contrast to preserve reliable, fine-grained optimization signals. Extensive evaluations across 13 challenging reasoning and deep-search benchmarks demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines, significantly enhancing training stability and generalization in long-horizon interactions.

</details>


### [363] [Enhancing Irregular Time Series Forecasting with Continuous-Time Modeling Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28035)
*Tianen Shen,Zhengyu Li,Yutong Li,Xiangfei Qiu,Xingjian Wu,Bin Yang,Jilin Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WrapFlow，一个面向不规则多元时间序列预测的连续时间建模框架，通过Continuous-Time Tokenization和Residual Flow Matching实现无需数值求解器的连续时间预测。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是泛机器学习/时间序列预测方法，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或轻量化部署。虽然时间序列建模可能与遥感时序数据（如NDVI、SAR时序）有间接关联，但论文本身未涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或模型压缩/加速方法，属于泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦不规则时间序列预测，与遥感在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或模型压缩方法，仅可作为泛机器学习方法泛读，不建议深入精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：不规则多元时间序列预测（irregular multivariate time series forecasting）。应用场景：healthcare monitoring、human activity recognition、environmental sensing。传感器类型：摘要未说明（推测为通用时序传感器）。目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: WrapFlow框架包含两部分：(1) 输入侧：Continuous-Time Tokenization，直接编码原始观测事件，通过gap-aware tokens显式建模长未观测区间，生成连续时间token后送入标准Transformer backbone捕获长程时序依赖；(2) 输出侧：Residual Flow Matching，一种simulation-free训练范式，学习围绕base predictions的条件残差向量场，训练时避免数值求解器模拟和反向传播。

Lightweight method: 摘要未明确涉及传统轻量化方法（pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。但Residual Flow Matching采用simulation-free训练范式，推理时仅需少量固定rollout steps，避免了ODE数值求解器的计算开销，这在一定程度上降低了推理计算成本，可视为一种计算效率优化策略。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提到推理时使用少量固定rollout steps，避免了numerical solver的计算开销，暗示推理效率较高，但缺乏量化数据支撑。未涉及星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 在多个真实世界数据集上进行了实验（具体数据集名称摘要未说明），评价指标摘要未说明，仅声称达到state-of-the-art性能。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明在多个真实世界数据集上实现了state-of-the-art性能，未提供具体对比方法、消融实验或量化结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。主要缺口包括：未提供具体数据集名称和指标数值；未讨论模型参数量、计算复杂度等部署相关指标；未涉及遥感场景验证；未讨论与目标检测任务的关联。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但仍有少量可借鉴思路：(1) Continuous-Time Tokenization中对不规则采样/缺失数据的gap-aware编码思想，可迁移到遥感卫星多时相观测中因云遮挡、重访周期不规则导致的数据缺失问题；(2) simulation-free的Flow Matching训练范式，其"避免数值求解器、减少推理rollout步数"的思路与轻量化部署中降低推理开销的目标一致，可借鉴其"用少量固定推理步数换取高质量预测"的设计哲学；(3) 残差向量场围绕base prediction学习的思想，可类比于知识蒸馏中"学生网络学习教师网络的残差"的思路。但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Irregular multivariate time series are widely encountered in applications such as healthcare monitoring, human activity recognition, and environmental sensing. Their core challenges stem from asynchronous observations, non-uniform sampling intervals, and the fact that temporal patterns themselves carry critical dynamic information. Existing approaches either rely on discretization-based preprocessing (e.g., interpolation, imputation, or aggregation), which disrupts the underlying continuous-time semantics, or adopt continuous-time modeling via ODE-based frameworks, which typically require specialized architectures and incur substantial computational overhead due to numerical solvers. To address these limitations, we propose WrapFlow, a continuous-time modeling framework for irregular time series forecasting. On the input side, WrapFlow introduces Continuous-Time Tokenization, which directly encodes raw observation events and explicitly models long unobserved intervals via gap-aware tokens. The resulting continuous-time tokens are then processed by a standard Transformer backbone to capture long-range temporal dependencies. On the output side, we develop a simulation-free training paradigm for Residual Flow Matching, which learns conditional residual vector fields around base predictions while avoiding numerical-solver simulation and backpropagation during training. This design enables high-quality continuous forecasting using only a small number of fixed rollout steps at inference. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that WrapFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [364] [Learning features from Newton's algorithm: a way to accelerate nonlinear parametrized PDE solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28036)
*Rémy Vallot,Florian de Vuyst,Thibault Dairay,Mathilde Mougeot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种两阶段Newton初值猜测策略，通过参数空间采样和预计算解数据库学习特征，用回归模型预测代理解近似，再通过GMRES残差最小化修正，最终作为高保真Newton法初值以加速非线性方程组求解。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。该论文聚焦于数值计算领域中的非线性方程组求解加速问题，属于科学计算/数值分析范畴，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能等遥感相关主题，也不涉及object detection、目标检测、轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏等任何与本研究方向相关的技术。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于数值计算/科学计算领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：非线性方程组（PDE离散后）的数值求解加速。应用场景：大规模非线性科学计算问题。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感场景）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 两阶段Newton初值猜测框架：1) 构建两个互补的降维空间——解特征空间（由收敛状态构建）和修正搜索方向特征空间（由中间Newton增量构建）；2) 用回归模型预测代理解近似；3) 基于GMRES的残差最小化修正；4) 将结果作为高保真Newton法初值完成收敛。整体属于数值优化与降阶模型（ROM）方法，非深度学习网络架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明传统意义上的模型轻量化方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。论文的"加速"体现在减少Newton迭代次数和降低CPU时间，属于数值求解效率优化，而非神经网络模型压缩或边缘/星上部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文讨论的是CPU时间加速和Newton迭代次数减少，未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时推理或FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等部署相关信息，也未涉及星上或边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：代表性PDE问题（具体名称摘要未说明）。评价指标：Newton迭代次数、CPU时间、相对独立代理初始化的加速比（speedup）。

Experiments: 在代表性PDE问题上进行了数值实验，与独立代理初始化（standalone surrogate initialization）对比，结果显示可量化且显著的加速。具体数值结果摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关；2) 方法依赖预计算解数据库和参数空间采样，需要离线数据准备；3) 需要高保真残差场和脚本编程接口，侵入性虽弱但仍有依赖；4) 摘要未说明方法在复杂非线性问题上的泛化边界和收敛保证。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与本研究方向基本无关，但其"两阶段初值猜测+降维特征空间+回归预测"的思想在方法论层面有一定启发：1) 在遥感目标检测模型轻量化中，可借鉴"利用预计算/预训练知识构建降维特征空间"的思路，例如用知识蒸馏将大模型知识迁移到轻量学生网络；2) "残差最小化修正"思想可类比于检测模型中的refinement head或迭代式检测优化；3) 但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值非常有限。

Abstract: It is well known that Newton's method converges faster when the initial guess is closer to a root of a system of nonlinear equations. In this paper, a two-stage Newton initial guess strategy is proposed by learning features from a parameter-space sampling and a database of precomputed solutions. The method uses discrete Newton trajectories to construct two complementary reduced spaces: a solution feature space, built from converged states, and a corrective search direction feature space, built from intermediate Newton increments. For an unseen parameter, a regression model is used to predict a surrogate solution approximation. Then, in a second step, a residual-minimizing correction is computed using a dedicated GMRES-based approach. The resulting state is then used as an initial guess for the high-fidelity Newton method, which completes convergence. The corrective step is computationally inexpensive since it only requires residual evaluations and the solution of a small least-squares problem. The methodology is weakly intrusive once the high-fidelity residual fields and a script-based programming interface are available. This strategy reduces the number of Newton iterations and decreases the overall CPU time. Numerical experiments on representative PDE problems show quantifiable speedups compared with standalone surrogate initialization. Significant speedups are observed. This generic approach can be applied to a broad class of large-scale nonlinear problems.

</details>


### [365] [ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28037)
*Xingjian Wu,Xuhang Zhu,Xingchen Liu,Junlin Liu,Jianing Wang,Linsen Guo,Xiaoyu Li,Xuezhi Cao,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ClawTrack，一个面向LLM智能体多步工作流的双维度评估基准，同时衡量任务结果（Task Score）和推理过程质量（Process Score），用于归因长时程任务中的成功与失败。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于LLM-based agent的评估基准设计，属于自然语言处理/智能体评估领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩加速。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM智能体多步工作流评估（benchmark）。应用场景：通用智能体推理过程评估，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。论文核心贡献是评估框架ClawTrack，包含Task Score和Process Score双维度评估，以及Process Grader对推理轮次沿四个维度（goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, result verification）打分，由12,541条任务级rubric items锚定。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。唯一与"轻量"沾边的概念是"process-based trajectory filtering"用于post-training改进，但这属于数据筛选而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。论文不涉及星上或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ClawTrack基准，含320个任务、8个领域、25+确定性mock services，12,541条rubric items。评估对象：21个模型、16,000+次试验。指标：Task Score（任务结果）和Process Score（过程质量，含goal alignment、efficiency、information utilization、result verification四个维度）。

Experiments: 主要发现：(1) process scores能有效归因成功/失败到具体推理维度，过滤仅靠结果评估无法识别的"幸运通过"；(2) 四个维度互补，result verification是系统性瓶颈；(3) 框架对不同的judge LLM选择具有鲁棒性；(4) process-based trajectory filtering在不同模型规模上带来一致的post-training改进。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显局限包括：与遥感/目标检测/轻量化完全无关；评估对象是LLM智能体而非视觉检测模型；不涉及任何计算效率或部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接启发是"过程级评估"思想——在遥感目标检测模型轻量化中，可以类比地不仅评估最终检测精度（mAP），还评估中间过程的效率指标（如每层FLOPs、剪枝后各层敏感度），实现更细粒度的归因分析。但这属于方法论层面的泛化联想，并非直接可复用的技术。

Abstract: As LLM-based agents are deployed in complex, multi-step workflows, a critical evaluation gap has emerged: most existing benchmarks judge only final outcomes, unable to distinguish reliable reasoning from lucky success or attribute failures to specific process deficiencies, hindering attribution in long-horizon tasks.
  In this work, we present ClawTrack, a dual-assessment benchmark that simultaneously measures what an agent achieves (Task Score) and how it achieves it (Process Score). ClawTrack comprises 320 tasks across 8 domains with 25+ deterministic mock services. A Process Grader scores each reasoning turn along four dimensions (goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, and result verification), anchored by 12,541 task-specific rubric items. Evaluating 21 models over 16,000+ trials, we find that: (1) process scores effectively attribute success and failure to specific reasoning dimensions, filtering lucky passes invisible to outcome-only evaluation; (2) the four dimensions are complementary, with result verification as the systematic bottleneck; (3) the framework is robust to evaluator choice across different judge LLMs; and (4) process-based trajectory filtering yields consistent post-training improvements across model scales.

</details>


### [366] [GVR-Coder: A Visual-Feedback Framework for Structured SVG Generation in Complex Document and Meeting Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28073)
*Yiming Xu,Jihua Kang,Chunsai Du,Qifan Zhang,Wangqiu Zhou,Yiting Wu,Tianqi Li,Qi Song*

TL;DR: 提出GVR-Coder框架，通过课程式拒绝采样微调、布局约束知识、双渲染反馈强化学习以及生成-验证-修复智能体循环，实现从长文本到高质量逻辑SVG图表的自动生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Model architecture: GVR-Coder框架，包含：课程式拒绝采样微调（curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning）、布局约束知识（layout constraint knowledge）、双渲染反馈强化学习（reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback）、生成-验证-修复智能体循环（generate-verify-repair agent loop）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息，也未涉及星上（onboard）或边缘（edge）部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：DocMeetSVG-100K，一个面向文档撰写和会议纪要场景的大规模SVG数据集。评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标名称，仅提及通过实验证明GVR-Coder优于竞争基线。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明"extensive experiments demonstrate that GVR-Coder outperforms competitive baselines"，未给出具体对比方法、消融实验细节或定量结果。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。该论文聚焦文本到SVG图表生成，不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测、模型轻量化或边缘部署。摘要未提供任何可迁移到遥感在轨检测任务的技术细节。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能间接相关的点是"generate-verify-repair agent loop"这一迭代优化思想——在遥感在轨目标检测中，可类比为检测-验证-修正的闭环推理机制，用于提升小目标或旋转框检测的精度。此外，课程式训练（curriculum learning）思想也可迁移到遥感目标检测模型的训练策略中，例如由易到难地引入不同复杂度的遥感场景样本。但这些均为泛化方法论层面的间接启发，与轻量化部署无直接关联。

Abstract: In demanding professional environments and meeting review scenarios, lengthy text often imposes a high cognitive load. To facilitate efficient information communication, transforming verbose text into logically clear diagrams is essential. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) provide an effective representation for this purpose due to their editability and resolution independence. However, current research on Text-to-SVG generation remains hindered by three major challenges: (1) the scarcity of datasets for complex, logic-rich diagrams; (2) the absence of explicit layout priors, which leads to chaotic spatial arrangements; and (3) the lack of fine-grained visual feedback to validate rendered outputs and correct aesthetic defects. To address these challenges, at the data level, we introduce DocMeetSVG-100K, a large-scale SVG dataset tailored for document authoring and meeting review scenarios. At the model level, we propose GVR-Coder, a novel framework designed to generate high-quality logical diagrams from lengthy professional texts. Specifically, we adopt a curriculum-driven rejection sampling fine-tuning to progressively enhance the model's capability in modeling complex structures, while explicitly incorporating layout constraint knowledge during training. In addition, we introduce reinforcement learning from dual rendering feedback, a mechanism that provides implicit feedback through reward signals to jointly optimize structural complexity and visual aesthetics. Furthermore, we design a generate-verify-repair agent loop, which improves generation quality through explicit, fine-grained feedback and targeted refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GVR-Coder outperforms competitive baselines and reliably produces logically coherent and visually appealing diagrams. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CurryaNa/GVR-Coder.

</details>


### [367] [Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Informed Framework for Trustworthy Chemical Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28079)

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为化学性质预测，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。
