Task and scene: 任务类型：化学性质预测（chemical property prediction），包括密度、电导率、溶解度等分子性质预测。应用场景：计算化学、材料科学、药物开发。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：分子样本，非遥感目标。

Model architecture: Mixture-PINN：基于physics-informed neural network（PINN）的预测框架，将化学先验知识（chemical prior knowledge）融入数据驱动学习。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计或边缘部署等模型压缩/加速方法。Mixture-PINN属于物理信息约束的建模方法，与轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: Chem World基准：整合17个化学数据集，包含超过800,000个分子样本，覆盖密度、电导率、溶解度等性质。评价指标摘要未具体说明。

Experiments: 在Chem World基准上与现有方法对比，验证Mixture-PINN在准确性、鲁棒性和可靠性方面的有效性。具体对比方法和消融实验细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 与本研究方向（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化）完全无关。摘要未提供任何与遥感、目标检测、模型压缩或边缘部署相关的信息。此外，摘要本身也未说明Mixture-PINN的计算复杂度、推理效率或模型规模。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接启发是"将领域先验知识（如物理/化学知识）融入数据驱动模型"这一思想——在遥感目标检测中，可以考虑将遥感成像物理特性（如大气散射、传感器噪声、目标几何先验）作为约束或先验融入轻量化检测模型，以提升小目标检测精度。但整体上该论文与课题方向关联极弱。

Abstract: Chemical property prediction plays a critical role in accelerating scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and drug development. However, existing benchmarks often suffer from limited task diversity, fragmented datasets, and inconsistent evaluation protocols, making it challenging to systematically assess the reliability and generalization of AI models. In this work, we introduce Chem World, a comprehensive benchmark for chemical property prediction that integrates 17 diverse chemical datasets with over 800,000 molecular samples, covering various properties including density, electrical conductivity, solubility, and other molecular characteristics. Chem World provides a unified platform for evaluating AI models across multiple property prediction tasks. Furthermore, we propose Mixture-PINN, a physics-informed neural network based prediction framework that incorporates chemical prior knowledge into data-driven learning, improving the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of chemical property prediction. Extensive experiments on Chem World demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with existing methods. By combining large-scale standardized evaluation with physics-informed learning, Chem World establishes a foundation for developing trustworthy AI systems for computational chemistry and advancing AI-driven scientific discovery.

</details>


### [368] [From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28097)
*Tianyang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏MoE（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）中数学上等价的专家归约顺序在不同聚合语义下产生可观测不同执行结果的现象，提出数值兼容性契约概念，属于大模型推理数值稳定性研究。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于稀疏MoE大语言模型推理时的数值精度与归约顺序对输出轨迹的影响，属于LLM推理数值稳定性/可复现性研究，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或任何模型压缩/轻量化方法。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为稀疏MoE大模型推理的数值可复现性，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：稀疏MoE大语言模型推理的数值可复现性分析。应用场景：大模型推理后端与硬件兼容性。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 研究对象为DeepSeek-V4-Flash稀疏MoE模型，聚焦其局部MoE状态、聚合语义（A/B/C四种方案）、operand表示与accumulator精度分离、post-mHC边界、persistent state等内部机制。非目标检测网络架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化方法。虽然涉及FP64/FP32精度与数值精度讨论，但这是关于推理数值可复现性而非模型压缩或部署加速。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。其讨论的数值兼容性契约虽与硬件后端相关，但面向通用大模型推理而非星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。实验采用中文prompt（50个prompt），评价指标包括：continuation basins数量、structural classes数量、token级分歧（8/16/32 tokens）、192条persistent trajectories、bitwise匹配、301个下游post-mHC状态等数值一致性指标。

Experiments: 主要实验：在layer-5 fork处对比720种A-mode与B-mode归约顺序，发现A模式产生10个continuation basins，B模式产生360个结构类和11个basins；B类在中文prompt下分裂为202 layoffs、113 hiring、45 other；P32/A/B三种方案改变所有native-reference路线轨迹，而C方案保持routes、token序列和文本不变；C方案的192轨迹检查与native MoE、post-mHC、next-router、LM状态bitwise匹配；FP64重建可复现301个下游状态。

Limitations: 作者明确说明：研究建立的是"controlled causal possibility"（受控因果可能性）而非部署实际发生率；C方案的order invariance仅限评估的六项状态与调度；未涉及遥感、目标检测或任何视觉任务；未提供任何模型压缩或部署加速信息。

Ideas for my research: 与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化课题的直接借鉴点有限。可间接参考的仅有：1) 数值精度（FP32/FP64/accumulator精度）对推理结果一致性的影响，提示在星上部署时需关注低精度推理（如FP16/INT8）可能引入的数值分歧，但本文讨论的是MoE归约顺序而非量化误差；2) 对硬件后端数值兼容性的关注，可类比于FPGA/NPU上不同算子实现可能产生的结果差异。总体借鉴价值较低。

Abstract: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.

</details>


### [369] [Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28124)
*Xu Zheng,Wei Cheng,Zhuomin Chen,Mo Sha,Jingchao Ni,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IB-Forecast，一个基于信息瓶颈的可解释多变量时间序列预测框架，通过可解释掩码和周期性/残差分解实现高保真解释，同时保持与黑盒模型相当的预测精度。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文聚焦于多变量时间序列预测的可解释性（interpretable forecasting），属于泛机器学习/时间序列分析领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及模型压缩或边缘部署。仅其"信息瓶颈（information bottleneck）"和"可解释掩码"思想在方法论层面可能对轻量化网络设计有间接启发，但整体相关性很弱。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于时间序列预测可解释性方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化研究基本无关。仅"信息瓶颈稀疏化"和"零额外推理成本"两个概念有极有限的间接启发，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多变量时间序列预测（multivariate time-series forecasting）与可解释性（interpretability）。应用场景：能源（energy）、交通（transportation）、医疗健康（healthcare）等领域的预测决策。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器。目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: IB-Forecast框架将预测分解为两部分：(1) 学习到的周期性分量（learned periodic component）；(2) 基于输入token可解释掩码（explainable masks over input tokens）计算的残差分量（residual component）。采用预算约束的信息瓶颈（budget-constrained information bottleneck）进行端到端优化，使用户能直接控制解释的稀疏度（explanation sparsity）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未明确涉及传统轻量化方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS）。但"信息瓶颈"机制本质上通过约束信息流、仅需14-20%的观测数据即可实现低误差预测，在概念上具有稀疏化和计算效率优化的意味。摘要提到"at no additional inference cost"，即解释不增加推理开销，这与轻量化部署中"零额外开销"的设计目标一致。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及解释功能"at no additional inference cost"（无额外推理成本），以及仅需14-20%的观测数据即可实现低误差预测，暗示其输入稀疏化可能带来计算量的降低，但未给出具体硬件部署数据。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未明确列出具体数据集名称。评价指标方面，主要对比了预测误差（forecasting error）和解释保真度（faithfulness），并与gradient-based、occlusion-based、optimization-based三类可解释性基线方法进行了对比。实验覆盖多个数据集（"across all evaluated datasets"）。

Experiments: 实验表明：(1) IB-Forecast在预测误差上与领先的黑盒模型（leading black-box models）相当；(2) 在匹配的稀疏度预算下，其原生解释（native explanations）在所有数据集上一致优于gradient-based、occlusion-based和optimization-based基线方法；(3) 现有可解释预测器的原生解释保真度较差，而IB-Forecast能保证高解释保真度；(4) 仅需14-20%的观测数据即可实现低误差预测。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：具体数据集名称、模型参数量、计算复杂度、部署环境、与遥感/视觉任务的关联。该工作面向时间序列预测而非视觉目标检测，其"可解释掩码"和"信息瓶颈"机制在图像/遥感场景中的迁移性未经验证。此外，摘要未讨论模型在边缘/星上硬件上的实际部署可行性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测无直接关系，但其"budget-constrained information bottleneck"思想值得借鉴：(1) 可类比用于遥感目标检测中的特征稀疏化——通过信息瓶颈约束特征通道，在保持检测精度的同时减少计算量，这与轻量化目标一致；(2) "仅需14-20%观测数据"的稀疏输入思想可启发遥感图像中基于关键区域/关键token的稀疏注意力或稀疏卷积设计，减少在轨推理计算开销；(3) "解释不增加推理成本"的设计原则可迁移到星上可解释检测模型，实现"检测+可解释"零额外开销；(4) 周期性/残差分解思想可类比遥感图像中的背景/目标分解，辅助小目标检测。整体借鉴价值有限，属于方法论层面的间接启发。

Abstract: As forecasts increasingly drive decisions in fields such as energy, transportation, and healthcare, understanding the historical data behind these predictions has become as crucial as the predictions themselves. Although existing interpretable-by-design forecasters reveal their internal structures, they offer no guarantee that these structures faithfully reflect the underlying evidence driving the predictions. In contrast, while faithfulness-oriented methods explicitly verify model behavior, they are almost exclusively designed for post-hoc classification tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose IB-Forecast, an inherently interpretable multivariate time-series forecasting framework. It decomposes forecasting into a learned periodic component and a residual component computed with explainable masks over input tokens. With a budget-constrained information bottleneck, end-to-end optimization enables users to directly control explanation sparsity. With a rigorous faithfulness evaluation protocol, extensive experiments demonstrate that IB-Forecast matches the forecasting error of leading black-box models while providing faithful explanations at no additional inference cost. Furthermore, under a matched sparsity budget, these native explanations consistently surpass gradient-based, occlusion-based, and optimization-based baselines across all evaluated datasets. Ultimately, whereas the native explanations of existing interpretable forecasters exhibit poor faithfulness, IB-Forecast guarantees high explanation fidelity, requiring only 14-20% of the observations to deliver low-error predictions.

</details>


### [370] [LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28135)
*Mohand Mezmaz,Grégoire Danoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LM-GRASP，一种将GRASP元启发式算法的随机构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习任务的框架，用decoder-only Transformer作为构造策略，在Taillard PFSP基准上优于GPU-GRASP。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于组合优化（combinatorial optimization）中的置换流水车间调度问题（PFSP），属于运筹学/元启发式算法领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。同时也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉任务，更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化方法。唯一可能相关的点是使用了Transformer架构和在线学习范式，但这属于泛机器学习方法，与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向无直接借鉴关系。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于组合优化/元启发式算法领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非对"在线学习替代离线预训练"的范式迁移感兴趣，否则无需投入时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：组合优化（combinatorial optimization）中的置换流水车间调度问题（Permutation Flow Shop Scheduling Problem, PFSP）。应用场景：生产调度/运筹优化，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用（非视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 采用decoder-only Transformer作为构造策略（constructive policy），配合局部搜索（local search）作为专家oracle。整体框架为LM-GRASP混合元启发式算法，遵循learn-infer-improve迭代循环，通过行为克隆（behavioral cloning）在动态精英轨迹档案上在线训练策略。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等模型压缩或加速方法。其核心创新在于"在线训练替代离线预训练"的范式，即每个问题实例从头训练，无需大规模离线数据集，这与模型轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性指标。虽然提到GPU加速（GPU-GRASP）作为对比基线，但这是针对调度优化计算，而非在轨推理部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Taillard PFSP基准（ta51-ta60），这是组合优化领域标准benchmark。评价指标：makespan（完工时间），以makespan单位衡量优化质量。实验对比：LM-GRASP vs GPU-GRASP，LM-GRASP平均优于GPU-GRASP 28.4 makespan单位，与GPU加速相对串行执行的增益（27.2单位）相当，但标准差有重叠。

Experiments: 在Taillard PFSP基准的ta51-ta60子集上评估，该子集因一半最优解未知而最具区分度。LM-GRASP平均优于GPU-GRASP 28.4 makespan单位，效果与GPU加速带来的提升（27.2单位）相当，但统计显著性因标准差重叠而受限。摘要未说明消融实验或更多对比方法。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关，属于组合优化领域。2. 实验仅在PFSP单一基准上验证，泛化性存疑。3. 性能提升的统计显著性不足（标准差重叠）。4. 在线逐实例训练的计算开销可能较大，摘要未说明训练时间和资源消耗。5. 摘要未说明该方法在视觉/检测任务上的适用性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有两个思路可间接借鉴：1) "在线训练替代大规模离线预训练"的范式——在轨场景中数据分布可能随轨道/光照/季节漂移，在线自适应微调（online adaptation）的思路对星上模型持续学习有一定启发；2) 用局部搜索/专家策略作为监督信号训练轻量策略网络的思想，类似于知识蒸馏中"teacher-student"范式，但需要将这一思想迁移到目标检测的蒸馏框架中才有实际价值。总体而言，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required.
  We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search.
  Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.

</details>


### [371] [Search Strategies for Optimal Classification and Regression Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28170)
*Jacobus G. M. van der Linden,Mim van den Bos,Emir Demirović*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个通用的最优决策树（ODT）算法框架，统一了此前多种搜索策略，并通过实证评估18种搜索策略，在分类和回归任务上显著提升任意时刻性能和运行速度。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于最优决策树（Optimal Decision Trees）的搜索策略与可扩展性优化，属于经典机器学习/可解释模型范畴，既不涉及遥感/卫星/地球观测场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署。虽然"提升运行速度"与轻量化有一定表面关联，但本质是算法搜索效率优化，而非面向深度神经网络的模型压缩或加速。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于通用机器学习算法研究，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：最优决策树（ODT）的构建与搜索策略优化；应用场景：通用机器学习分类与回归任务；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明具体应用场景。

Model architecture: 最优决策树（Optimal Decision Trees, ODT）模型，提出一个通用算法框架，可实例化此前使用的多种搜索策略并支持定义新策略。摘要未说明具体网络结构或模块设计细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等深度学习模型压缩方法。论文的"效率提升"体现在ODT搜索算法的运行时间优化（regression任务提升一个数量级以上），属于算法层面的搜索效率改进，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然决策树本身具有可解释性和紧凑性，但论文未从部署角度讨论。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标涉及分类（classification）和回归（regression）任务的anytime performance以及runtime（运行时间）。摘要未说明具体数据集和指标细节。

Experiments: 实证评估了18种搜索策略，与state-of-the-art相比，最佳策略在分类任务上取得显著更好的anytime performance，在回归任务上运行时间提升超过一个数量级。摘要未说明具体对比方法和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：论文聚焦于ODT搜索算法本身，未涉及深度学习目标检测模型，未涉及遥感场景，未涉及任何部署相关考量。与本研究方向的关联性极弱。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在星上部署中考虑使用可解释的决策树/规则模型作为辅助决策模块（如检测结果的置信度判断、场景分类等），ODT的高效搜索策略可能有助于快速训练紧凑的可解释模型。但这一关联非常间接，不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Optimal decision trees (ODTs) are compact, interpretable machine learning models that globally optimize a given objective, but their scalability remains challenging. While recent work has proposed a variety of search strategies to improve scalability, the precise contribution of each strategy remains unclear. To address this gap, we introduce a general algorithmic framework for ODTs that instantiates previously used search strategies and enables the definition of new ones. This provides a common lens through which to understand and compare different strategies, which we use to empirically investigate the effect of 18 search strategies. Compared to the state of the art, the best strategy in our evaluation achieves significantly better anytime performance for classification, and improves runtime by more than an order of magnitude for regression.

</details>


### [372] [Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28182)
*Changjian Liu,Tianyu Wang,Xiaoxuan Deng,WenTao Zhu,Yuwei Xu,Jungqi Jin,Yong Gao,Chuan Yu,Jian Xu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReAlloc，一个用于电商平台多渠道营销预算分配的快速-慢速因果框架，通过正交教师网络提取无偏局部梯度并蒸馏给学生网络，实现支持感知的保守决策。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦电商营销预算分配（marketing budget allocation）和因果推断（causal inference），属于推荐系统/运筹优化领域，不涉及任何遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能内容。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为电商营销预算分配与因果推断，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：电商多渠道营销预算分配（budget allocation）的 uplift decision problem；应用场景：Taobao电商平台；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: ReAlloc框架包含两个核心组件：1) Orthogonal Teacher（正交教师网络），用于从短期日志中提取无偏局部梯度；2) Explanation-Guided Student（解释引导的学生网络），将教师知识蒸馏为长期时间尺度上的结构化边际场（marginal field）。整体采用 fast-slow 双时间尺度因果框架。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提及了知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）概念（教师-学生架构），但这里的蒸馏目的是将短期因果梯度迁移到长期边际场，而非用于模型压缩或加速。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向电商在线A/B测试场景，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：大规模模拟实验（simulations）及Taobao平台在线A/B测试（online A/B tests）；评价指标：pay order（支付订单量）和 income（收入）的双重提升。

Experiments: 通过大规模模拟实验和Taobao平台在线A/B测试验证，ReAlloc在pay order和income两个指标上同时取得提升。摘要未给出具体数值、对比基线或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，属于电商因果推断与预算优化领域；2) 摘要未提供模型复杂度、推理效率等部署指标；3) 摘要未说明方法在非电商场景的泛化能力。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但有两个概念层面的启发：1) 教师-学生蒸馏框架（Orthogonal Teacher → Explanation-Guided Student）在结构上类似于知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），可类比思考如何将大模型（教师）的检测知识蒸馏到轻量学生网络用于星上部署；2) "fast-slow"双时间尺度设计思路可类比遥感在轨场景中"快速推理+长期模型更新"的架构设想。但整体上该论文对遥感轻量化目标检测课题的直接可借鉴点很少。

Abstract: E-commerce platforms must allocate fixed marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize business utility. However, standard predict-then-optimize (PTO) paradigms fail in this compositional space due to observational confounding and severe extrapolation. We formulate this challenge as a simplex-constrained uplift decision problem and propose ReAlloc, a fast-slow causal framework. Specifically, an agile Orthogonal Teacher extracts unbiased local gradients from short-term logs, while an Explanation-Guided Student distills them into a structured marginal field over long-term horizons. This design enables support-aware, conservative decisions that capture cross-channel substitutions. Extensive simulations and large-scale online A/B tests on Taobao platform demonstrate that ReAlloc achieves simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income.

</details>


### [373] [Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28185)
*Mostafa Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从随机动力系统角度研究循环图神经网络（recurrent GNN）中的过平滑（oversmoothing）问题，证明在每步传播后注入高斯噪声可使隐表示形成几何遍历马尔可夫链，并给出平稳Dirichlet能量的正下界，从而在理论上保证渐近过平滑被抑制。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文主题是图神经网络（GNN）的过平滑理论分析，属于图机器学习/深度图网络的理论研究，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等轻量化或部署方法。唯一可能的间接关联是：若未来在遥感场景中采用GNN类模型（如基于图结构的遥感场景理解），该理论对防止深层GNN过平滑有参考价值，但这是非常间接且遥远的关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于图神经网络理论方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化课题基本无关。除非课题涉及GNN在遥感场景中的应用且需要解决深层GNN过平滑问题，否则无需阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图神经网络过平滑（oversmoothing）的理论分析。应用场景：通用图机器学习，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。摘要未涉及任何遥感或目标检测任务。

Model architecture: 研究对象为循环图神经网络（recurrent graph neural network），在每次传播步骤后注入独立高斯噪声，将其建模为随机动力系统。采用全局收缩假设（global contraction assumption）下的确定性更新，分析隐表示的随机演化过程。摘要未说明具体网络层数、图规模或具体GNN变体（如GCN、GAT等）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。本文不讨论pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理或边缘/星上部署等任何模型压缩或加速技术。其核心贡献是理论层面的过平滑抑制机制（随机噪声注入），而非模型压缩或部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。作为纯理论分析论文，未提供任何工程实现或部署可行性评估。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。实验部分仅在"linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks"上进行了数值实验，用于验证理论预测（stationary distribution的涌现以及Dirichlet energy对噪声强度的依赖关系）。评价指标为Dirichlet energy（用于度量过平滑程度），而非目标检测或遥感领域常用的mAP、F1、IoU等指标。

Experiments: 数值实验在linear和nonlinear两类recurrent GNN上进行，结果与理论预测高度吻合，验证了：(1) stationary distribution的涌现；(2) 极限Dirichlet energy对噪声强度的依赖关系。摘要未提供与其他过平滑抑制方法（如residual connections、normalization、graph rewiring）的实验对比数据。

Limitations: 1. 纯理论分析，缺乏大规模真实图数据上的实证验证；2. 依赖"global contraction assumption"这一较强假设，实际GNN训练中该假设未必成立；3. 噪声注入可能带来表示质量的下降或训练不稳定，摘要未讨论；4. 未讨论噪声注入对下游任务（如节点分类、图分类）性能的影响；5. 与遥感、目标检测、轻量化部署完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低。可能的间接启发包括：1) 若未来在遥感场景中采用基于图结构的模型（如将遥感图像中的目标关系建模为图），该理论对设计深层GNN防止过平滑有参考意义；2) 随机噪声注入作为一种正则化/多样性保持机制，理论上可类比于dropout等随机扰动在轻量化网络训练中的作用，但这一关联非常牵强。总体而言，不建议作为本课题的核心参考论文。

Abstract: Oversmoothing is a fundamental limitation of deep graph neural networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become increasingly similar, eventually collapsing toward a low-dimensional subspace. This phenomenon limits the effective depth of message-passing architectures and motivates the search for mechanisms that preserve representation diversity. In this paper, we study a recurrent graph neural network in which independent Gaussian noise is injected after every propagation step and analyze the resulting architecture as a stochastic dynamical system. Under a standard global contraction assumption on the deterministic update, we prove that the hidden representations form a geometrically ergodic Markov chain admitting a unique invariant probability measure. Our main theoretical result establishes an explicit positive lower bound on the expected stationary Dirichlet energy, proportional to both the noise variance and the spectral gap of the underlying graph. Consequently, the stationary representations cannot collapse onto the constant manifold, providing a rigorous guarantee that asymptotic oversmoothing is prevented in the sense of non-vanishing Dirichlet energy. Our analysis reveals persistent stochastic perturbations as a fundamentally different mechanism for combating oversmoothing, complementing existing deterministic approaches based on residual connections, normalization, and graph rewiring. Finally, numerical experiments on both linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks closely match the theoretical predictions, illustrating the emergence of a stationary distribution and the predicted dependence of the limiting Dirichlet energy on the noise intensity.

</details>


### [374] [TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28259)
*Md Joshem Uddin,Astrit Tola,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Topoformer，一种轻量级可扩展的图表示学习框架，通过Topo-Scan模块将图的拓扑结构编码为注意力友好的序列，由Transformer处理生成图级嵌入，在保持拓扑归纳偏置的同时实现并行化与高效计算。
